sesotho_text: Hapatokelula carcinoma e ka hlola e le kholo ho batho ba nang le HIV le hepatitis B kapa C e leng karolo ya tshwaetso.

english_text: All people living with HIV should be tested for hepatitis B and C.
sesotho_text: Batho bohle ba phelang le HIV ba tla tsejoa ka hepatitis B le C.

english_text: Malaria is more severe and more frequent in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Malaria e le thata le e le e ngata ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: HIV-positive pregnant women are at particularly high risk of severe malaria.
sesotho_text: Basali ba nang le HIV ba bang le HIV ba lekana le khathatso e kholo ya malaria e thata.

english_text: Insecticide-treated bed nets should be provided to all HIV-positive people in malaria-endemic areas.
sesotho_text: Tšireletso ya diatla tse nang le seriti ya ditshenyegi e swanetse seabo e fanoletswe ho batho bohle ba nang le HIV ka dikarolong tse nang le malaria.

english_text: Cotrimoxazole prophylaxis also provides some protection against malaria.
sesotho_text: Kotrimoksasoli ya prophylaxis e fana ka tlhofo e seng kae ka go feta le malaria.

english_text: Drug interactions between antimalarials and ART must be carefully considered.
sesotho_text: Tswelepele ya ditherepo tsa mmedi ya go feta le malaria le ART e swanetse e tsebje ka khotso.

english_text: Advanced HIV disease is defined as a CD4 count below 200 or the presence of an AIDS-defining illness.
sesotho_text: Bolwetse bja HIV bjo bogolo bo bja gweka e le ya di-CD4 tse fetelele ka tlase ga 200 goba tswelopele ya bolwetse bja AIDS.

english_text: People with advanced HIV disease need urgent initiation of ART and OI prophylaxis.
sesotho_text: Batho ba nang le bolwetse bja HIV bjo bogolo ba hloka ho qala ART le OI prophylaxis ka khotso.

english_text: A rapid CD4 count test should be done for all people presenting with advanced HIV disease.
sesotho_text: Tsebo ya di-CD4 e swanetse e etsoe ho batho bohle ba tswang ka bolwetse bja HIV bjo bogolo.

english_text: Cryptococcal antigen screening is recommended for all people with CD4 counts below 100.
sesotho_text: Go hlahloba Cryptococcal antigen go fane ka batho bohle ba nang le di-CD4 tse fetelele ka tlase ga 100.

english_text: People with advanced HIV disease are at high risk of death within the first three months of ART.
sesotho_text: Batho ba nang le bolwetse bja HIV bjo bogolo ba na le khatello e kholo ya lefu ka mahlong a masome a mararo a pele a ART.

english_text: A differentiated care package for advanced HIV disease includes OI screening, prophylaxis, and ART.
sesotho_text: Pakage ya tshebetso e hlokegilego ya bolwetse bja HIV bjo bogolo e akaretsa OI screening, prophylaxis, le ART.

english_text: Wasting syndrome is characterised by significant unintentional weight loss in people with HIV.
sesotho_text: Wasting syndrome e gweka e le ya kgwebo e seng kae e kgethegileng ya batho ba nang le HIV.

english_text: HIV encephalopathy causes cognitive impairment and neurological symptoms.
sesotho_text: HIV encephalopathy hahela boima ba mokelikara le masoba a neurological.

english_text: Palliative care should be integrated into HIV care for people with advanced disease.
sesotho_text: Tshebetso ya palliative e tsoa lokela ho tshehetswa ho tseba HIV bakeng sa batho ba nang le tshwaetso e pharalletseng.

english_text: Pain management is an important component of care for people with advanced HIV disease.
sesotho_text: Tshireletso ya ho thibela lefu ke karolo e eketsehileng ya tshebetso bakeng sa batho ba nang le HIV e pharalletseng.

english_text: Dolutegravir is a preferred first-line ART medicine due to its high efficacy and tolerability.
sesotho_text: Dolutegravir ke morero o ratoang o lekana la ART o tsoa ho fumana ka lebaka la tshebetso e ntle le ho e tseba.

english_text: Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate is a nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor used in first-line ART.
sesotho_text: Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate ke kabo e etsang ka mokhoa wa ho hanela nucleoside reverse transcriptase e tsoang ho tseba HIV.

english_text: Lamivudine is a well-tolerated nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor used in ART.
sesotho_text: Lamivudine ke kabo e ntle e etsang ka mokhoa wa ho hanela nucleoside reverse transcriptase e tsoang ho tseba HIV.

english_text: Efavirenz can cause neuropsychiatric side effects including vivid dreams and dizziness.
sesotho_text: Efavirenz e ka etsa masoba a mokelikara a ho se tsebe a akaretsang lithabo tse ntle le ho lala mahlo.

english_text: Nevirapine should not be started in women with CD4 counts above 250.
sesotho_text: Nevirapine ha e tsoe lokela ho qala ho batswadi ba basadi ba nang le CD4 counts ho fihla 250.

english_text: Lopinavir/ritonavir is a protease inhibitor used in second-line ART regimens.
sesotho_text: Lopinavir/ritonavir ke kabo e etsang ka mokhoa wa ho hanela protease e tsoang ho tseba HIV ho tseba second-line.

english_text: Atazanavir can cause yellowing of the skin and eyes which is harmless.
sesotho_text: Atazanavir e ka etsa lefu la letsopa le le letona la matsoho le mahlo a nang le tshiamo.

english_text: Abacavir should not be given to people who test positive for the HLA-B*5701 gene variant.
sesotho_text: Abacavir ha akgone ho fihlelwa ho batho ba nang le mofuta wa jini HLA-B*5701.

english_text: Fixed-dose combination tablets make it easier to take ART by combining multiple medicines in one pill.
sesotho_text: Tabetele e nang le mahlakore a mararo e etsa hore o e je ART ka tsela e bonolo, ka ho etsa hore diphaphathi tse ngata di kwalele motheo o le mong.

english_text: Long-acting injectable ART is a new option for people who have difficulty taking daily pills.
sesotho_text: Lenaneo la ART le etswang ke mantswe le pholile ke kgetho e ntjha kwa ao ba sa kweng ba phaphathi ba matsatsi a sile.

english_text: I have a very bad headache and stiff neck and I have HIV.
sesotho_text: Ke na le ho jala haholo lefifing mohlare o halasha, 'me ke na HIV.

english_text: I have white patches in my mouth and it is painful to eat.
sesotho_text: Ke na le mefuta e mesweu ka mahlakoreng, 'me ke hloka ho ja.

english_text: I have been losing weight even though I am eating well.
sesotho_text: Ke qetile kgarebe, leha ke sa ja sentle.

english_text: I have purple spots on my skin that are not going away.
sesotho_text: Ke na mefuta e bulosi ka mmeleng, e sa tsamaee.

english_text: I have HIV and I am also coughing with blood.
sesotho_text: Ke na HIV, 'me ke lema ka mahlakoreng.

english_text: I have been having night sweats and losing weight for two months.
sesotho_text: Ke bile le molapo oa bosiu le ho lahleheloa ke boima ka likhoeli tse peli.

english_text: I am HIV-positive and I am seven months pregnant.
sesotho_text: Ke na le HIV mme ke ima likhoeli tse supileng.

english_text: My baby tested positive for HIV at six weeks and I need help.
sesotho_text: Ngoana oa ka o hlahlobelitsoe HIV mme o fumane sephetho se molemo ka libeke tse tšeletseng mme ke hloka thuso.

english_text: I have HIV and my eyes have been getting blurry over the past few weeks.
sesotho_text: Ke na le HIV mme mahlo a ka a bile a fifala libeke tse fetileng tse itseng.

english_text: I have difficulty swallowing and I think it is related to my HIV.
sesotho_text: Ke na le bothata ba ho metsa mme ke nahana hore bo amana le HIV ea ka.

english_text: Differentiated service delivery models reduce the burden on health facilities.
sesotho_text: Mehlala ea fapaneng ea ho fana ka litshebeletso e fokotsa morwalo oa likamore tsa bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Multi-month dispensing of ART reduces the number of clinic visits required.
sesotho_text: Ho abela ART ka likhoeli tse ngata ka nako e le ngoe ho fokotsa palo ea litsela tsa kliniki tse hlokahalang.

english_text: Community ART distribution points bring medicines closer to people who need them.
sesotho_text: Libaka tsa phatlalatso ea ART sechabeng li tlisa meriana haufi le batho ba e hlokang.

english_text: Fast-track ART refill services are available for stable patients at many clinics.
sesotho_text: Litshebeletso tsa ho tlatsa ART ka potlako li fumaneha bakeng sa bakuli ba tsitsitseng likhlinikhing tse ngata.

english_text: Stable HIV patients on ART can collect up to three months of medicine at a time.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba HIV ba tsitsitseng ba holim'a ART ba ka kgotha meriana ea likhoeli tse tharo ka nako e le ngoe.

english_text: Patients who miss clinic appointments should be traced and supported to return to care.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba lahlehileng meeto ea kliniki ba lokela ho batlooa le ho tsheheltsoa ho khutlela tlhokomelong.

english_text: Loss to follow-up from HIV care is a major challenge in many countries.
sesotho_text: Ho lahlehela ho latela tlhokomelo ea HIV ke mathata a maholo linaheng tse ngata.

english_text: Electronic health records improve the tracking and management of HIV patients.
sesotho_text: Lirekhoto tsa bophelo bo botle tsa elektroniki li ntlafatsa ho latela le ho laola bakuli ba HIV.

english_text: HIV programme data should be used to improve the quality of care.
sesotho_text: Data ea lenaneo la HIV e lokela ho sebelisoa ho ntlafatsa boleng ba tlhokomelo.

english_text: Integration of HIV services with other health services improves access and efficiency.
sesotho_text: Ho kopanya litshebeletso tsa HIV le litshebeletso tse ling tsa bophelo bo botle ho ntlafatsa phihlello le bokgoni.

english_text: Broadly neutralising antibodies are being studied as a potential HIV treatment and prevention tool.
sesotho_text: Li-antibody tse phanyolang ka bophara li ithutoa e le sesebelisoa se ka khonehang sa phekolo le thibelo ea HIV.

english_text: HIV cure research aims to eliminate the virus from the body completely.
sesotho_text: Lipatlisiso tsa pholo ea HIV li ikemiseditse ho felisa vaerase 'meleng ka botlalo.

english_text: The HIV reservoir consists of cells that harbour dormant HIV and are not eliminated by ART.
sesotho_text: Polokelo ea HIV e bopiloe ke lisele tse bolokang HIV e robetseng mme e sa felisoe ke ART.

english_text: Shock and kill strategies aim to activate latent HIV so it can be eliminated.
sesotho_text: Maano a shock le kill a ikemiseditse ho vuseletsa HIV e patileng hore e tle e felisoe.

english_text: Gene therapy approaches are being explored as a potential HIV cure strategy.
sesotho_text: Mekhoa ea phekolo ea gene e hlahlojoa e le leano le ka khonehang la pholo ea HIV.

english_text: An effective HIV vaccine would be the most powerful tool to end the epidemic.
sesotho_text: Ente ea HIV e sebetsang e ka ba sesebelisoa se matla ka ho fetisisa sa ho felisa leruo la lefu.

english_text: Several HIV vaccine candidates are currently in clinical trials.
sesotho_text: Liente tse ling tse ling tsa HIV li se li le ho lekoa lihlahlobong tsa kliniki hona joale.

english_text: Lenacapavir is a long-acting injectable HIV medicine given twice a year.
sesotho_text: Lenacapavir ke moriana oa HIV o kenngoa ka mesipi o sebetsang nako e telele o neoang habeli ka selemo.

english_text: Cabotegravir plus rilpivirine is a long-acting injectable ART regimen given every two months.
sesotho_text: Cabotegravir hammoho le rilpivirine ke leano la ART la ho kenngoa ka mesipi le sebetsang nako e telele le neoang likhoeli tse peli le tse peli.

english_text: Islatravir is a novel antiretroviral being studied as part of long-acting treatment regimens.
sesotho_text: Islatravir ke antiretroviral e ncha e ithutoa e le karolo ea mananeo a phekolo a sebetsang nako e telele.

english_text: Key populations are groups at higher risk of HIV due to specific behaviours or circumstances.
sesotho_text: Sechaba se bohlokoa ke lihlopha tse leng kotsing e kholo ea HIV ka lebaka la maitshwaro kapa maemo a khethehileng.

english_text: Key populations include sex workers, men who have sex with men, transgender people, and people who inject drugs.
sesotho_text: Sechaba se bohlokoa se kenyelletsa basebetsi ba thobalano banna ba robetsanang le banna batho ba fetohang bong le batho ba kenyang meriana ka mesipi.

english_text: Key populations face stigma and discrimination that prevent them from accessing HIV services.
sesotho_text: Sechaba se bohlokoa se tobana le kekello le khethollo tse se thibelang ho fihlella litshebeletso tsa HIV.

english_text: HIV services for key populations must be non-judgmental and confidential.
sesotho_text: Litshebeletso tsa HIV bakeng sa sechaba se bohlokoa li lokela ho se ahlole mme li boloke sephiri.

english_text: Peer-led outreach programmes are effective at reaching key populations with HIV services.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a phono a etelletsoe pele ke bahlankana a sebetsa hantle ho fihla sechaba se bohlokoa ka litshebeletso tsa HIV.

english_text: Criminalisation of key populations increases HIV risk by driving them away from health services.
sesotho_text: Ho etsoa molato ha sechaba se bohlokoa ho eketsa kotsi ea HIV ka ho se khahlela ho tsoa litshebeletso tsa bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Sex workers have the right to access HIV prevention, testing, and treatment services.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba thobalano ba na le tokelo ea ho fihlella litshebeletso tsa thibelo ea HIV liteko le phekolo.

english_text: Condom distribution programmes for sex workers are an effective HIV prevention strategy.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a phatlalatso ea likhohlopo bakeng sa basebetsi ba thobalano ke leano le sebetsang la thibelo ea HIV.

english_text: Men who have sex with men are disproportionately affected by HIV in many regions.
sesotho_text: Banna ba robetsanang le banna ba angoa ke HIV ka mokgwa o sa lekanang libakeng tse ngata.

english_text: PrEP is highly recommended for men who have sex with men at high risk of HIV.
sesotho_text: PrEP e khothalletsoa haholo bakeng sa banna ba robetsanang le banna ba leng kotsing e kholo ea HIV.

english_text: Transgender women have one of the highest HIV prevalence rates of any population group.
sesotho_text: Basali ba fetohileng bong ba na le e 'ngoe ea likhato tse phahameng ka ho fetisisa tsa HIV ho lihlopha tsohle tsa sechaba.

english_text: HIV services for transgender people should be integrated with gender-affirming care.
sesotho_text: Litshebeletso tsa HIV bakeng sa batho ba fetohang bong li lokela ho kopanyoa le tlhokomelo e netefatsang bong.

english_text: Needle and syringe programmes reduce HIV transmission among people who inject drugs.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a mesipi le li-syringe a fokotsa phetisetso ea HIV ho batho ba kenyang meriana ka mesipi.

english_text: Opioid substitution therapy reduces HIV risk in people who inject drugs.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea ho nka sebaka sa opioid e fokotsa kotsi ea HIV ho batho ba kenyang meriana ka mesipi.

english_text: People in prisons and closed settings have higher HIV prevalence than the general population.
sesotho_text: Batho ba khotsofatsong le libakeng tse koalehileng ba na le palo e phahameng ea HIV ho feta sechaba ka kakaretso.

english_text: HIV testing and ART must be available in all prisons and detention centres.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa HIV le ART li lokela ho fumaneha likotsofatsong tsohle le lisentareng tsa ho tshoareloa.

english_text: Migrants and refugees may face barriers to accessing HIV services.
sesotho_text: Baahi ba fetang le baphaphathehi ba ka tobana le meqoqo ea ho fihlella litshebeletso tsa HIV.

english_text: HIV services should be accessible to all people regardless of nationality or immigration status.
sesotho_text: Litshebeletso tsa HIV li lokela ho fumaneha ho batho bohle ntle le ho sheba bochaba kapa boemo ba ho fallela naheng.

english_text: Homeless people living with HIV face particular challenges in maintaining ART adherence.
sesotho_text: Batho ba hlokang ntlo ba phelang le HIV ba tobana le mathata a khethehileng ho boloka ho latela ART.

english_text: Integrated social support is essential for homeless people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso e kopaneng ea sechaba e bohlokoa bakeng sa batho ba hlokang ntlo ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Women and girls account for more than half of all people living with HIV in sub-Saharan Africa.
sesotho_text: Basali le banana ba bua karolo e fetang halofo ea batho bohle ba phelang le HIV Afrika e ka tlase ho Sahara.

english_text: Gender inequality and power imbalances increase women's vulnerability to HIV.
sesotho_text: Ho se lekane ha bong le ho se lekane ha matla ho eketsa bokoa ba basali ho HIV.

english_text: Women often have less power to negotiate condom use with their partners.
sesotho_text: Basali hangata ba na le matla a fokolang a ho buisana ka tshebediso ea likhohlopo le balekane ba bona.

english_text: Intimate partner violence is associated with increased HIV risk in women.
sesotho_text: Tlhoriso ea molekane ea haufi e amahanngoa le kotsi e eketsehileng ea HIV ho basali.

english_text: Women who experience violence are less likely to access HIV testing and treatment.
sesotho_text: Basali ba bonang tlhoriso ba ka nna ba se fumane liteko tsa HIV le phekolo ka bonolo.

english_text: HIV programmes must address gender-based violence as part of a comprehensive response.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a HIV a lokela ho sebetsana le tlhoriso e thehiloeng holim'a bong e le karolo ea karabelo e pharalletseng.

english_text: Economic empowerment of women reduces their vulnerability to HIV.
sesotho_text: Ho matlafatsa basali ka moruo ho fokotsa bokoa ba bona ho HIV.

english_text: Men are less likely than women to test for HIV and access treatment.
sesotho_text: Banna ba ka nna ba se hlahlobeloe HIV le ho fumana phekolo ka bonolo ho feta basali.

english_text: Engaging men in HIV prevention and treatment is essential for ending the epidemic.
sesotho_text: Ho kenyelletsa banna thibelong ea HIV le phekolo ho bohlokoa bakeng sa ho felisa leruo la lefu.

english_text: Harmful gender norms that discourage men from seeking healthcare increase HIV mortality.
sesotho_text: Mekhoa ea bong e kotsi e thibelang banna ho batla tlhokomelo ea bophelo e eketsa lefu la HIV.

english_text: Access to HIV prevention, testing, and treatment is a fundamental human right.
sesotho_text: Ho fihlella thibelo ea HIV liteko le phekolo ke tokelo ea motheo ea botho.

english_text: HIV-related discrimination in healthcare settings is a violation of human rights.
sesotho_text: Khethollo e amanang le HIV libakeng tsa tlhokomelo ea bophelo ke tlolo ea litokelo tsa botho.

english_text: People living with HIV have the right to privacy and confidentiality.
sesotho_text: Batho ba phelang le HIV ba na le tokelo ea sephiri le ho bolokoa ha sephiri.

english_text: Forced HIV testing is a violation of human rights and undermines public health.
sesotho_text: Ho qobelloa ho hlahlobeloa HIV ke tlolo ea litokelo tsa botho mme ho senya bophelo bo botle ba sechaba.

english_text: People living with HIV have the right to marry and have children.
sesotho_text: Batho ba phelang le HIV ba na le tokelo ea ho nyalana le ho ba le bana.

english_text: Travel restrictions based on HIV status are discriminatory and should be abolished.
sesotho_text: Melaolelo ea ho tsamaea e thehiloeng holim'a boemo ba HIV ke khethollo mme e lokela ho fenyoa.

english_text: People living with HIV should be involved in decisions about HIV policies and programmes.
sesotho_text: Batho ba phelang le HIV ba lokela ho kenyelletsooa liqetong mabapi le maano le mananeo a HIV.

english_text: The greater involvement of people living with HIV is a core principle of the HIV response.
sesotho_text: Ho kenyelletsooa ho hoholo ha batho ba phelang le HIV ke molaotheo oa motheo oa karabelo ea HIV.

english_text: Legal protections for people living with HIV must be enforced at all levels.
sesotho_text: Tshireletso ea molao bakeng sa batho ba phelang le HIV e lokela ho phetha-phethoa maemong ohle.

english_text: Stigma reduction laws and policies create an enabling environment for the HIV response.
sesotho_text: Melao le maano a ho fokotsa kekello a theha tikoloho e khothaletsang karabelo ea HIV.

english_text: The prevalence of depression in people living with HIV is two to three times higher than in the general population.
sesotho_text: Palo ea ho nyamela ho batho ba phelang le HIV e phahame habeli ho isa ho makhetlo a mararo ho feta sechaba ka kakaretso.

english_text: Untreated depression in people living with HIV leads to poor ART adherence and worse outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho nyamela ho sa phekoluoang ho batho ba phelang le HIV ho lebisa ho ho latela ART ho fokolang le liphetho tse mpe.

english_text: Antidepressant medicines can be used safely in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Meriana ea ho loa nyamela e ka sebelisoa ka polokeho ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Cognitive behavioural therapy is effective for depression and anxiety in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea maitshwaro a mahutu e sebetsa hantle bakeng sa ho nyamela le ho tšaba ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: HIV-associated neurocognitive disorder affects thinking, memory, and concentration.
sesotho_text: Bolwetse ba neurocognitive bo amanang le HIV bo angoa ho nahana ho hopola le ho tsepamisa kelello.

english_text: ART can slow the progression of HIV-associated neurocognitive disorder.
sesotho_text: ART e ka khutsufatsa tsoelo-pele ea bolwetse ba neurocognitive bo amanang le HIV.

english_text: Screening for cognitive impairment should be part of routine HIV care.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa ho fokoleng ha mahutu ho lokela ho ba karolo ea tlhokomelo ea kamehla ea HIV.

english_text: Alcohol and substance use disorders are significantly more common in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Mafu a tšebediso ea joala le lintho tse kotsi a atile haholo ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Integrated treatment for HIV and substance use disorders improves outcomes for both conditions.
sesotho_text: Phekolo e kopaneng ea HIV le mafu a tšebediso ea lintho tse kotsi e ntlafatsa liphetho tsa maemo a mabeli.

english_text: Mindfulness-based interventions can reduce stress and improve quality of life in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Meketso e thehiloeng holim'a ho ela hloko e ka fokotsa khatello le ho ntlafatsa boleng ba bophelo ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Food insecurity is associated with poor ART adherence and worse HIV outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho hloka tšepo ea lijo ho amahanngoa le ho latela ART ho fokolang le liphetho tse mpe tsa HIV.

english_text: Nutritional support programmes improve ART initiation and retention in care.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a tshehetso ea phepo a ntlafatsa ho qala ART le ho lula tlhokomelong.

english_text: Ready-to-use therapeutic food is used to treat severe acute malnutrition in HIV-positive children.
sesotho_text: Lijo tsa phekolo tse loketse ho sebelisoa hang li sebelisoa ho phekola ho hloka phepo ho matla ho bana ba nang le HIV.

english_text: People living with HIV should avoid consuming unpasteurised dairy products.
sesotho_text: Batho ba phelang le HIV ba lokela ho hana ho ja lihlahisoa tsa lebese tse sa phethisoang.

english_text: Wash all fruits and vegetables thoroughly before eating to reduce infection risk.
sesotho_text: Tlhokomela maphelo le meroho ka tsela e nchausang pele o di ja, ho fokotsa khatla ea ho tsebana.

english_text: Cook meat and fish thoroughly to reduce the risk of foodborne infections.
sesotho_text: Papa nama le tshukudu sentle, ho fokotsa khatla ea ho tsebana ka maphelo.

english_text: People living with HIV should avoid drinking untreated water from rivers or wells.
sesotho_text: Batho ba phelang le HIV ba haele morao ho nwa metsi a sa tsosoang a ntle le noka kapa matša.

english_text: Boiling water or using a water filter can protect people living with HIV from waterborne infections.
sesotho_text: Ho tsoa metsi kapa ho sebedisa filter ya metsi ke tsela ya ho phahamisa batho ba phelang le HIV ho hlola maemo a ntle le metsi.

english_text: Selenium deficiency has been associated with faster HIV disease progression.
sesotho_text: Kgopo ya Selenium e tsejwang e le ka lebaka la ho phahamisa la HIV.

english_text: Multivitamin supplementation may benefit people living with HIV who have nutritional deficiencies.
sesotho_text: Go sebedisa vitamine vitsi e ka ba thusa batho ba phelang le HIV ba na le maphelo a sa tsoa.

english_text: Healthcare workers are at risk of occupational HIV exposure through needlestick injuries.
sesotho_text: Baahi ba tšehetso ya tšireletso ba na le tšwanelo ya ho kena HIV ka lebaka la ho robala ka di-needle.

english_text: Standard precautions must be followed by all healthcare workers to prevent HIV exposure.
sesotho_text: Tšireletso e tšoanang e swanetse e etsoe ke baahi bohle ba tšehetso ya tšireletso ho hlola HIV.

english_text: Gloves, masks, and protective eyewear reduce the risk of occupational HIV exposure.
sesotho_text: Letšo, maphoto, le di-eyewear tse tsosang tša fepa tša phahamisa tšwanelo ya ho kena HIV ya tšehetso.

english_text: All needlestick injuries must be reported immediately and PEP started within two hours.
sesotho_text: Di-robalo tsohle tsa di-needle di ha swanetse e be e romelwe ka potlako mme PEP e theoe ka masolle a mabili.

english_text: Healthcare workers who take PEP after needlestick injury should be monitored for HIV for three months.
sesotho_text: Baahi ba tšehetso ya tšireletso ba etelang PEP ka morago ga di-robalo tsa di-needle ba ha swanetse e be e lebeletswwe ho HIV ho fihlela dilemo tse tharo.

english_text: Safe disposal of sharps is a critical infection control measure in all healthcare settings.
sesotho_text: Ho tlosa di-sharps ka tsela e betere ke tsela e 'ngata ya ho fepa maemo a ntle le tšireletso ya tšehetso.

english_text: Recapping needles after use increases the risk of needlestick injury and should be avoided.
sesotho_text: Ho qeta molamo ka mora ho etsa tšoaetso ea molomo le ho fokotsa tsotsi ea tšoaetso.

english_text: Healthcare workers living with HIV have the same rights as all other employees.
sesotho_text: Baahi ba tšireletso ea bophelo ba phelang le HIV ba na le ditokelo tse tšoanang le baahi ba bang.

english_text: HIV-positive healthcare workers can continue to work in most clinical roles with appropriate precautions.
sesotho_text: Baahi ba tšireletso ea bophelo ba phelang le HIV ba ka tsamaea le mesebetsi ea bona ea kantoro ka tsela e betere.

english_text: Workplace wellness programmes should include HIV testing and support for healthcare workers.
sesotho_text: Meputso ea hlotso ea bophelo ba sebaka sa hae baahi ba tšireletso ea bophelo ba ka kena HIV testing le thuso ba baahi ba tšireletso ea bophelo.

english_text: I am a sex worker and I want to start PrEP.
sesotho_text: Ke moshanyana wa tsamaea ka noxa le ke batla ho qala PrEP.

english_text: I use drugs and I share needles and I want to be tested for HIV.
sesotho_text: Ke sebelisa mantsiboea le ke sebelisa mantsiboea a rona le ke batla ho tsejwa HIV.

english_text: I am a man who has sex with men and I need HIV prevention services.
sesotho_text: Ke monna ea nna le monna le ke hloka mesebetsi ea ho fokotsa HIV.

english_text: I was raped last night and I need PEP as soon as possible.
sesotho_text: Ke ile ka jaoa ka moso ho ja le ke hloka PEP ka potlako.

english_text: I am transgender and I need HIV treatment that works with my hormone therapy.
sesotho_text: Ke ngwaneso le ke hloka tšireletso ea HIV e tla sebetsana le mantsiboea a ka.

english_text: I feel very depressed since I found out I have HIV.
sesotho_text: Ke ikutloa ke lebala kaha ke fumane hore ke na le HIV.

english_text: I have been thinking about ending my life since my HIV diagnosis.
sesotho_text: Ke nahana ka ho qetela botjha bjale ka tšohle ke ile ka tseba hore ke na HIV.

english_text: I drink alcohol every day and I find it hard to remember to take my HIV medicine.
sesotho_text: Ke nwa bojalwa ka mong ka mong le ha ke khona feela ho tseba hore ke lwantše ditherefo tsa HIV.

english_text: I lost my job when my employer found out I have HIV.
sesotho_text: Ke ile ka tsoa mosebetsi ha moloko o mpontšang hore ke na HIV.

english_text: My husband left me when I told him I have HIV.
sesotho_text: Motho wa ka o mpontšang ha ke mo tsebisa hore ke na HIV.

english_text: Community-based organisations are essential partners in the HIV response.
sesotho_text: Makala a sechaba ke bathehi ba bohlokwa kajeno kateng tsa HIV.

english_text: People living with HIV networks advocate for the rights and needs of their members.
sesotho_text: Mabatooa a batho ba a swere le HIV a emela ka ditokelo le tšohle tse di hlokang.

english_text: HIV awareness campaigns should use culturally appropriate messages.
sesotho_text: Kemphafana tsa HIV e swanetše e sebediśwe ka melaetšo e dulweng ka setšo.

english_text: Social media can be used to reach young people with HIV prevention messages.
sesotho_text: Mediaya e sechabang e ka sebediśwa ho fihlela ba bangwe le ba HIV ka melaetšo ya ho ipatša.

english_text: Religious leaders can help reduce HIV stigma and promote testing in their communities.
sesotho_text: Baetapele ba bafetisi ba ka thusa ho tšewa HIV le ho tšweletša ho hwa ka sechabeng.

english_text: Traditional leaders play an important role in shaping community attitudes towards HIV.
sesotho_text: Baetapele ba setšo ba na le tšhemong e kholo kateng tsa ho ahlamahlama sechabeng ka HIV.

english_text: HIV education in schools should start before young people become sexually active.
sesotho_text: Thuto ea HIV esikolong ea rona e lokela ho qala pele batho ba basha ba etela ntho ea bona ea sex.

english_text: Parents and caregivers should be supported to talk to their children about HIV.
sesotho_text: Babusi le ba thusang ho thusa bana ba bona ka HIV.

english_text: HIV-positive role models can inspire others to test and start treatment.
sesotho_text: Dihlooho tse di hlokang HIV di ka thusa ba bang ba shwaetsang le ho qala tshebetso.

english_text: Celebrating World AIDS Day on December 1st raises awareness and shows solidarity.
sesotho_text: Go fetisaletswe Letsatsi la AIDS la Lehae ka la 1 December, le etsa hlokomela le ho bontšha tshepo.

english_text: ART is provided free of charge at public health facilities in many countries.
sesotho_text: ART e fumaneha a mahala kwa dikliniki tsa setshaba kantle ho dihempe tse ngata.

english_text: Out-of-pocket costs for HIV care can prevent people from accessing treatment.
sesotho_text: Tsebeletso ya HIV e ka thibela batho ba tshebetso ho fumana tshebetso.

english_text: Universal health coverage ensures that everyone can access HIV services without financial hardship.
sesotho_text: Khaloshi ya tsebeletso ya bophelo bohle e etsa hore batho bohle ba fumane tsebeletso ya HIV bonyane ba sa tsamaee ke tsebeletso.

english_text: Global Fund grants support HIV programmes in low and middle income countries.
sesotho_text: Tšehetso ya Global Fund e thusa programme ya HIV kantle ho dihempe tse kholo le tse kae.

english_text: PEPFAR is the largest bilateral HIV programme in the world.
sesotho_text: PEPFAR ke programme ya HIV e kholo ya tshebetso ya naha.

english_text: Domestic financing for HIV programmes must increase to ensure sustainability.
sesotho_text: Tshebetso ya naha ya programme ya HIV e lokela ho tswelela ho etsa hore e be le tshebetso.

english_text: Generic antiretroviral medicines have dramatically reduced the cost of HIV treatment.
sesotho_text: Ditherefu tsa antiretroviral tse sa tswalanang di fokotswe thata maemo a tshohle ho tshwaetso ya HIV.

english_text: Patent barriers can prevent access to affordable HIV medicines in low-income countries.
sesotho_text: Mehato ya patent e fela ka ho fihlella ditherefu tsa HIV tse ntle tse kenyeletsang mafolofolo a chale.

english_text: Compulsory licensing allows countries to produce or import generic HIV medicines.
sesotho_text: Layensing e sa feleng e lumella linaha ho etsa kapa ho ntshetsa pele ditherefu tsa generic tsa HIV.

english_text: Investing in HIV prevention is more cost-effective than treating advanced HIV disease.
sesotho_text: Go loma ka tshohle ho HIV ke tsela e ntle ya theko ho feta ho tshwaetsa HIV e tswetseng pele.

english_text: Cardiovascular disease is a leading cause of death in people living with HIV on long-term ART.
sesotho_text: Mafolofolo a cardiovascular ke moahi wa pele wa lefu ho batho ba phelang le HIV ka ART e elong.

english_text: HIV and chronic inflammation increase the risk of heart attack and stroke.
sesotho_text: HIV le ho se phethelwe ke mafolofolo ho oketse tshwanelo ya ho ba le heart attack le stroke.

english_text: Cholesterol levels should be monitored regularly in people on long-term ART.
sesotho_text: Maemo a cholesterol a swanetse ho tshehwa ka nako le nako ho batho ba leng ART e elong.

english_text: Blood pressure should be checked at every HIV clinic visit.
sesotho_text: Mofuta wa madi a swanetse ho tshehwa ka nako le nako ka nako ya kena sekolo sa HIV.

english_text: Smoking cessation is especially important for people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Ho tsoa ho nyola ke tsela e ntle khasa ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: People living with HIV who smoke have a significantly higher risk of lung cancer.
sesotho_text: Batho ba phelang le HIV ba nyolang ba na tshwanelo e khethehileng ya kena le kankere ya phepo.

english_text: Osteoporosis is more common in people living with HIV and should be monitored.
sesotho_text: Osteoporosis ke e 'ngoe ea tsebo ea batho ba phelang le HIV mme e tlameha ho tsebjwa.

english_text: Calcium and vitamin D supplements may be recommended for people with low bone density on ART.
sesotho_text: Suplemenete ea kalsium le vitamin D e ka kena ho hloka batho ba nang le bone density e tlase ka ART.

english_text: Frailty and premature ageing are increasingly recognised in older people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Bohlale le khothatso ya mosebetsi e tsejoa kantle le kantle ho batho ba baholo ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: People living with HIV are living longer and now face age-related health conditions.
sesotho_text: Batho ba phelang le HIV ba phela hantle mme ba emetse merero ea tsebo e amanang le mosebetsi.

english_text: Polypharmacy is a concern for older people living with HIV who take multiple medicines.
sesotho_text: Polypharmacy ke bothata ba batho ba baholo ba phelang le HIV ba otlang ditherepe lefapha tse ngata.

english_text: Drug interactions between ART and medicines for other conditions must be carefully managed.
sesotho_text: Maphutha a ditherepe kaha ART le ditherepe tsa merero e meng e tlameha ho tsebjwa ka khotso.

english_text: Diabetes is more common in people living with HIV on long-term ART.
sesotho_text: Diabetes ke e 'ngoe ea tsebo ea batho ba phelang le HIV ba nang le ART ya mafolofolo.

english_text: Blood glucose should be monitored in people on ART regimens associated with metabolic changes.
sesotho_text: Glucose ya madi e tlameha ho tsebjwa ho batho ba nang le ART regimens e amanang le metabolic changes.

english_text: Chronic kidney disease is more common in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Chronic kidney disease ke e 'ngoe ea tsebo ea batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Kidney function should be assessed before starting tenofovir-based ART.
sesotho_text: Lefapha la kidney function e tlameha ho tsebjwa pele ho qala tenofovir-based ART.

english_text: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease is increasingly common in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Tlhabiso ya mala e ebotswa ke mafura e oketsega ka bontate kwa batho ba a tsamayang le HIV.

english_text: Liver function tests should be done regularly in people on ART.
sesotho_text: Go nweng ka mafura ke go swabisiwa hapelekele ka batho ba a tsamayang le ART.

english_text: Anal cancer risk is significantly elevated in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Kaneto ya kankere ya thokwa e fetohile haholo kwa batho ba a tsamayang le HIV.

english_text: Regular anal cancer screening is recommended for HIV-positive men who have sex with men.
sesotho_text: Go nweng ka kankere ya thokwa ke go swabisiwa hapelekele kwa banna ba a tsamayang le HIV ba ba tsamayang le banna.

english_text: Living well with HIV requires taking medicines, attending clinic appointments, and maintaining a healthy lifestyle.
sesotho_text: Go tsamaya hantle le HIV go kwešiša go ja medise, go etela dipookego tsa klinik, le go hlokomela bophelo bjo bo botswa.

english_text: Many people living with HIV lead active, fulfilling, and productive lives.
sesotho_text: Batho bangata ba a tsamayang le HIV ba tsamaya, ba phela bophelo bjo bokgethwa le bo botswa.

english_text: Physical activity improves cardiovascular health and mental wellbeing in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Tšhabele ya naga e hlokomela bophelo bja madi le bophelo bja moya kwa batho ba a tsamayang le HIV.

english_text: Yoga and meditation can help reduce stress and improve quality of life for people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Yoga le meditashiona ke tša thusa go fokotsa sefahleho le go hlokomela bophelo bjo bo botswa kwa batho ba a tsamayang le HIV.

english_text: Maintaining social connections and relationships is important for mental health in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Go hlokomela tshebeletso ya batho le dikgopolo ke go lekgethwa kwa bophelo bja moya kwa batho ba a tsamayang le HIV.

english_text: People living with HIV can travel internationally but should plan ahead for medicine supplies.
sesotho_text: Batho ba a tsamayang le HIV ba ka ya lefatshe ka ntle, empa ba swanetše go rupela hapelelekele ka medise.

english_text: Carry enough ART medicine for the entire trip plus extra in case of delays.
sesotho_text: Nka tšwelepele tše ngata tsa ditherepe ya ART tša hau tša tswa lefelong la hau, le tše eketsegang, hloko-hloko ha ho na tšwanelo pele.

english_text: Keep ART medicines in your hand luggage when travelling by air.
sesotho_text: Hloka ditherepe tsa hau tsa ART ka matšwele a hau ha u tsamaya ka lefelelo.

english_text: People living with HIV should inform their doctor before receiving any live vaccines.
sesotho_text: Batho ba phelang le HIV ba tšwelaletsweng go tsebisa ngaka wa bona pele ba amogela vekse ine e tswileng.

english_text: Annual influenza vaccination is recommended for all people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Go amogela vekse ya mafelo a mmala ha ngwaga le ngwaga e tšwelaletsweng batho bohle ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Pneumococcal vaccination is recommended for people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Go amogela vekse ya Pneumokokali e tšwelaletsweng batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: COVID-19 vaccination is recommended for people living with HIV especially those with low CD4 counts.
sesotho_text: Go amogela vekse ya COVID-19 e tšwelaletsweng batho ba phelang le HIV, khaseng ba ba nang le CD4 e tlase.

english_text: People living with HIV should avoid contact with people who have active chickenpox or shingles.
sesotho_text: Batho ba phelang le HIV ba tšwelaletsweng ba se ke ba kwa le batho ba nang le mafelo a mmala a tswileng kapa shingles.

english_text: Pets can be kept by people living with HIV but hygiene precautions should be followed.
sesotho_text: Batho ba phelang le HIV ba ka ba ba le diphoofolo, empa ba tšwelaletsweng ba etsele pele tša bohloeki.

english_text: Cat litter boxes should be cleaned by someone else if you are HIV-positive with a low CD4 count.
sesotho_text: Dipate tsa kare e tšwelaletsweng e etselewe ke motho e mong, ha u le motho u nang le HIV le CD4 e tlase.

english_text: A serodiscordant couple is one where one partner has HIV and the other does not.
sesotho_text: Kopano e nang le HIV e le yane, ke yona e leng kopano le motho a nang le HIV, mme e mong a sa na HIV.

english_text: The HIV-negative partner in a serodiscordant couple can be protected by PrEP.
sesotho_text: Mong a neng a hloka HIV moetsaleng wa serodiscordant o ka ponahaloa ke PrEP.

english_text: An HIV-positive partner with an undetectable viral load cannot transmit HIV sexually.
sesotho_text: Mong a nang le HIV le viral load e sa tsotellang ha a ka kwa a tsotella HIV ka tsela ya sex.

english_text: Undetectable equals untransmittable is a scientifically proven concept.
sesotho_text: Ho ba undetectable ke untransmittable ke tsebo e tseileng e etselitsoeng ke saense.

english_text: Serodiscordant couples can have children safely with the right medical support.
sesotho_text: Basali ba serodiscordant ba ka ba na bana ka khotsoha leka ho fumana thuso ya tsebo ya mofumahali.

english_text: Assisted reproduction techniques can help serodiscordant couples conceive without HIV transmission.
sesotho_text: Tlhahiso ya ho hlahisa e ka thusa basali ba serodiscordant ho hlahisa bana ba sa neng a hloka HIV.

english_text: Regular HIV testing for the HIV-negative partner in a serodiscordant couple is important.
sesotho_text: Go lokisa HIV ka nako le nako kele kwano mong a neng a hloka HIV moetsaleng wa serodiscordant kele kwano.

english_text: Open communication between partners about HIV status and prevention is essential.
sesotho_text: Puuo e bulehang ka hare ho bashanyana ka bophelo ba HIV le ho chaba kele kwano.

english_text: Counselling for serodiscordant couples helps them navigate the emotional and practical challenges.
sesotho_text: Thuso ya mafolofolo basali ba serodiscordant e ba thusa ho tsamaya le matshwao a mofuta le a tsebo.

english_text: Serodiscordant couples should discuss their prevention strategy with their healthcare provider.
sesotho_text: Basali ba serodiscordant ba tshwanetse ho bua le morui wa tsona ka thuso ya ho chaba.

english_text: Tell your doctor about all the medicines you are taking including vitamins and herbal remedies.
sesotho_text: U ngenele morui wa hao ka ditho tsotelle tsohle tseo u di jaang, tse kang bitamin le meriana ya setso.

english_text: Write down your questions before your clinic appointment so you do not forget them.
sesotho_text: Tlhalefa dipotso tsa hao pele ho u tsamaea kwenye kantora ya mokgatlo wa bophelo hore o se ke wa lebala.

english_text: Ask your healthcare provider to explain your test results in simple language.
sesotho_text: Botsa mmusi wa bophelo hao hore a tsebise diphetogo tsa tshehetso ya hao ka puo e bonolo.

english_text: Bring a trusted friend or family member to your clinic appointment for support.
sesotho_text: Tsoela monna wa hao yo a ikemetseng kantora ya mokgatlo wa bophelo hore a o tshwarele.

english_text: Tell your healthcare provider if you are struggling to afford your medicines.
sesotho_text: Tsebisa mmusi wa bophelo hao hore o swere o nyopa ka ho reka dintho tsa hao tsa bophelo.

english_text: Report any new symptoms to your healthcare provider even if you think they are minor.
sesotho_text: Tsebisa mmusi wa bophelo hao ka diphetogo tsene tsa hao, le ha o nahana hore di nyonyohile.

english_text: Ask about community support services that can help you manage your HIV.
sesotho_text: Botsa ka mesebetsi ya thuso ya setšhaba e ka o thusang ho qoba HIV ya hao.

english_text: Your healthcare provider should treat you with respect and without judgment.
sesotho_text: Mmusi wa bophelo hao o tshwanetse go o tshwara ka kgotso le ka ho se tsotelle.

english_text: You have the right to a second opinion about your HIV treatment.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ya go botsa mmusi wa bophelo mang pele ka tšhehetso ya HIV ya hao.

english_text: Keep a record of your CD4 count and viral load results over time.
sesotho_text: Hlokomela rekoto ya nomoro ya CD4 ya hao le diphetogo tsa viral load ho tswa nako.

english_text: Traditional beliefs about HIV must be addressed sensitively in HIV education.
sesotho_text: Tshireletso ya setso ya HIV e tshwanetse go tsebiwa ka ho hloka tsotelle ho ithutelo ya HIV.

english_text: Some communities believe HIV is caused by witchcraft which can delay treatment seeking.
sesotho_text: Matswele a mang a dumela hore HIV o tsoaletsoe ke boloi, seo se ka mpolella ho theoha tshebetso.

english_text: Engaging traditional healers in HIV education can help bridge cultural gaps.
sesotho_text: Koetliso ya bang'aka ba setso ka ho ithutiwa ha HIV e ka thusa ho fokotsa sebaka sa setso.

english_text: Culturally appropriate HIV counselling improves acceptance of testing and treatment.
sesotho_text: Thibo ya khansele ya setso e oketseka kahlolo ya tshebetso le tšebetso ya HIV.

english_text: HIV messaging should be available in local languages to reach all communities.
sesotho_text: Polelo ya HIV e swanetse e arohanngwe ka dipuo tse dingwe tse tswellanang le setšhaba.

english_text: Community dialogues about HIV can change harmful attitudes and behaviours.
sesotho_text: Dialoge tsa setšhaba ka HIV di ka fetola tsitsipano e mpe tsebo e mpe.

english_text: Involving community elders in HIV programmes increases community acceptance.
sesotho_text: Ho kenyeletsa baetapele ba setšhaba ka programme ya HIV e oketseka kahlolo ya setšhaba.

english_text: HIV programmes should respect and incorporate local cultural practices where appropriate.
sesotho_text: Programme ya HIV e swanetse e tšepane le e tsamaisane ditsheho tsa setso kae e tloaelelang.

english_text: Cultural norms around masculinity can prevent men from seeking HIV testing and treatment.
sesotho_text: Mehlala ya setso ka banna e ka mpolella banna ho theoha tshebetso le tšebetso ya HIV.

english_text: Lobola and other cultural practices can sometimes increase HIV risk and need to be discussed openly.
sesotho_text: Lobola le ditsheho tse dingwe tsa setso di ka oketseka tšiamo ya HIV mme di hloka ho buiwa ka botjha.

english_text: I have been on HIV treatment for three months and I feel much stronger.
sesotho_text: Ke lekaletswe ke tshebetso ya HIV ka metshe e meraro mme ke motho yo a ntseng a le betere.

english_text: I want to know if I can take traditional medicine alongside my HIV treatment.
sesotho_text: Ke batla ho tseba ha ke ka kgona ho ja medicine ya setso ka tsela e itseng le tšhebetšo ya HIV.

english_text: I am HIV-positive and I want to get pregnant next year.
sesotho_text: Ke na HIV ebile ke batla ho hlola ka ngwaga o tlang.

english_text: My partner does not have HIV and we want to know how to stay safe.
sesotho_text: Motho wa ka ha a na HIV 'me re batla ho tseba hore re tle re etseng re se be le boloi.

english_text: I have been taking my HIV medicine but I am still losing weight.
sesotho_text: Ke dutse tšhebetšo ya HIV hantle empa ke gola kgole.

english_text: I have been on the same HIV medicine for seven years and I want to know if there are better options.
sesotho_text: Ke dutse tšhebetšo e itseng ya HIV ke yona e kgolo ka lilemo tse tlano 'me ke batla ho tseba ha ho na mabapi ao a khethehileng.

english_text: I feel embarrassed to collect my HIV medicine at the clinic near my home.
sesotho_text: Ke a shwenya ho tlorella tšhebetšo ya HIV kweneng kwa gae.

english_text: I travel for work and I need to know how to manage my HIV medicine while away.
sesotho_text: Ke ya lebala ka ntlo 'me ke hloka ho tseba hore ke tle ke etseng ke be le tšhebetšo ya HIV ha ke le teng.

english_text: My CD4 count has dropped and my doctor wants to change my treatment.
sesotho_text: Palogare ya CD4 ya ka e galele 'me ngaka ya ka e batla ho fetola tšhebetšo.

english_text: I have been having chest pain and shortness of breath and I am HIV-positive.
sesotho_text: Ke na le ho qetela ka sefubeng 'me ke na le ho tšoha 'me ke na le HIV.

english_text: I am 65 years old and I have been living with HIV for 20 years.
sesotho_text: Ke na le lilemo tse 65 mme ke phela le HIV ka lilemo tse 20.

english_text: I have HIV and I have also been diagnosed with diabetes.
sesotho_text: Ke na le HIV mme ke boetse ke fuoe bolwetse ba tsoekere.

english_text: I have HIV and high blood pressure and I take many medicines every day.
sesotho_text: Ke na le HIV le khatello e phahameng ea mali mme ke nka meriana e mengata letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: I want to join a support group for people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Ke batla ho kenela sehlopha sa tshehetso bakeng sa batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: I have been living with HIV for two years and I have not told anyone.
sesotho_text: Ke phela le HIV ka lilemo tse peli mme ha ke eso bolelle motho.

english_text: Directly observed therapy can help people who struggle with ART adherence.
sesotho_text: Phekolo e shebilloeng ka kotloloho e ka thusa batho ba tobanang le mathata a ho latela ART.

english_text: Mobile phone reminders and SMS messages can improve ART adherence.
sesotho_text: Litemoso tsa mohala le melaetsa ea SMS li ka ntlafatsa ho latela ART.

english_text: Adherence clubs bring together groups of stable HIV patients to collect medicines together.
sesotho_text: Maklabo a ho latela a koahanya lihlopha tsa bakuli ba HIV ba tsitsitseng ho kgotha meriana hammoho.

english_text: Adherence counselling should be provided at every clinic visit not just at initiation.
sesotho_text: Keletso ea ho latela e lokela ho fanoa letsetsong le leng le le leng la kliniki eseng ho qala feela.

english_text: Identifying and addressing barriers to adherence improves treatment outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho tseba le ho sebetsana le meqoqo ea ho latela ho ntlafatsa liphetho tsa phekolo.

english_text: Poverty, transport costs, and work commitments are common barriers to ART adherence.
sesotho_text: Bofuma, litšenyehelo tsa lipalangoa, le boikarabello ba mosebetsi ke meqoqo e tloaelehileng ea ho latela ART.

english_text: Stigma and fear of disclosure are significant barriers to ART adherence.
sesotho_text: Kekello le tšabo ea ho senola ke meqoqo e bohlokoa ea ho latela ART.

english_text: Side effects are one of the most common reasons people stop taking ART.
sesotho_text: Litlamorao tsa moriana ke e 'ngoe ea mabaka a atileng ka ho fetisisa ao batho ba emang ho nka ART.

english_text: Switching to a better-tolerated ART regimen can improve adherence.
sesotho_text: Ho fetohela lenanong la ART le mamelloang hantle ho ka ntlafatsa ho latela.

english_text: Peer support from other people living with HIV significantly improves ART adherence.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso ea bahlankana ho tsoa ho batho ba bang ba phelang le HIV e ntlafatsa ho latela ART haholo.

english_text: Task-shifting allows trained community health workers to support HIV care delivery.
sesotho_text: Ho fetisetsa mesebetsi e fapaneng ho lumella basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle ba sechaba ba koetlisitsoeng ho tshehetsa ho fana ka tlhokomelo ea HIV.

english_text: Nurse-initiated ART has expanded access to treatment in under-resourced settings.
sesotho_text: ART e qalilloeng ke baoki e atolositsa phihlello ea phekolo libakeng tse hlokang mehloli.

english_text: Decentralisation of HIV services brings care closer to communities.
sesotho_text: Ho abeloa ha litshebeletso tsa HIV ho tlisa tlhokomelo haufi le sechaba.

english_text: Point-of-care viral load testing reduces delays in identifying treatment failure.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha viral load sebakeng sa tlhokomelo ho fokotsa ho lieha ha ho tseba ho hloleha ha phekolo.

english_text: Digital health tools including telemedicine can support HIV care in remote areas.
sesotho_text: Lisebelisoa tsa bophelo bo botle tsa dijithale ho kenyelletsa telemedicine li ka tshehetsa tlhokomelo ea HIV libakeng tse hole.

english_text: HIV programme data should be disaggregated by age, sex, and population group.
sesotho_text: Data ea lenaneo la HIV e lokela ho aroloa ka lilemo, bong, le sehlopha sa sechaba.

english_text: Quality improvement initiatives in HIV clinics lead to better patient outcomes.
sesotho_text: Meketso ea ntlafatso ea boleng likhlinikhing tsa HIV e lebisa liphetho tse ntle tsa bakuli.

english_text: Patient satisfaction surveys help identify gaps in HIV service delivery.
sesotho_text: Lipatlisiso tsa khotsofalo ea bakuli li thusa ho tseba maqeba ho faneng ka litshebeletso tsa HIV.

english_text: HIV national strategic plans guide the response at country level.
sesotho_text: Maano a naha a leano la HIV a etelela karabelo maemong a naha.

english_text: Multi-sectoral collaboration is essential for an effective national HIV response.
sesotho_text: Tšebelisano ea likarolo tse ngata e bohlokoa bakeng sa karabelo ea naha ea HIV e sebetsang.

english_text: I have been undetectable for three years and I feel like myself again.
sesotho_text: Ke bile le viral load e sa fumaneheng ka lilemo tse tharo mme ke ikutloa ke le nna hape.

english_text: I want to tell my story to help other people living with HIV feel less alone.
sesotho_text: Ke batla ho bolela pale ea ka ho thusa batho ba bang ba phelang le HIV hore ba ikutloe ba se mong hanyane.

english_text: I did not think I would live this long after my HIV diagnosis but here I am.
sesotho_text: Ha ke a nahana hore nka phela nako e telele joalo ka mor'a ho fuoa HIV empa ke le mona.

english_text: My children do not know I have HIV and I am not sure when to tell them.
sesotho_text: Bana ba ka ha ba tsebe hore ke na le HIV mme ha ke tsebe nako eo ke tla ba bolella ka eona.

english_text: I have been healthy on ART for ten years and I still come to the clinic every three months.
sesotho_text: Ke phela hantle holim'a ART ka lilemo tse leshome mme ke ntse ke tla klinikhing likhoeli tse tharo le tse tharo.

english_text: I want to know more about the new long-acting HIV injection so I do not have to take pills every day.
sesotho_text: Ke batla ho tseba haholoanyane ka ente e ncha ea HIV e sebetsang nako e telele hore ke se ke nke lipilisi letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: I am a nurse and I have HIV and I still care for patients every day.
sesotho_text: Ke mooki mme ke na le HIV empa ke ntse ke hlokomela bakuli letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: I was diagnosed with HIV at birth and I am now 18 years old and doing well.
sesotho_text: Ke fuoe HIV ha ke tsoa tsoaloa mme joale ke na le lilemo tse 18 mme ke phela hantle.

english_text: I want to help other young people living with HIV in my community.
sesotho_text: Ke batla ho thusa bacha ba bang ba phelang le HIV sechabeng sa ka.

english_text: HIV has taught me to take care of my health and I am grateful for the treatment that keeps me alive.
sesotho_text: HIV e nthutile ho hlokomela bophelo ba ka mme ke leboha phekolo e npolokang ke phela.

english_text: ART should be initiated on the same day as HIV diagnosis whenever possible.
sesotho_text: ART e lokela ho qaloa letsatsi le leng la ho fuoa HIV neng kapa neng ha ho khoneha.

english_text: Same-day ART initiation improves early retention in HIV care.
sesotho_text: Ho qala ART letsatsi le leng le ho fuoa HIV ho ntlafatsa ho lula tlhokomelong ea HIV kapele.

english_text: Readiness assessment before ART initiation helps identify potential adherence barriers.
sesotho_text: Ho lekola boitokisetso pele ho qala ART ho thusa ho tseba meqoqo e ka khonehang ea ho latela.

english_text: Patients who understand why they take ART are more likely to adhere to treatment.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba utloisisang hore na ba nkang ART ke hobaneng ba na le monyetla o moholo oa ho latela phekolo.

english_text: Health literacy is an important factor in ART adherence.
sesotho_text: Ho tseba ho bala le ho ngola ha bophelo bo botle ke ntlha e bohlokoa ho latela ART.

english_text: Simplified ART regimens with fewer pills improve adherence.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a ART a bonolo a nang le lipilisi tse fokolang a ntlafatsa ho latela.

english_text: Once-daily ART regimens are preferred because they are easier to remember.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a ART a nkuoang habeli ka letsatsi a khahloa hobane a bonolo ho hopola.

english_text: Food requirements for ART medicines vary and patients should be counselled accordingly.
sesotho_text: Litlhoko tsa lijo bakeng sa meriana ea ART li fapana mme bakuli ba lokela ho fuoa keletso ka ho latela.

english_text: Some ART medicines must be taken with food while others can be taken on an empty stomach.
sesotho_text: Meriana e meng ea ART e lokela ho nkoa le lijo ha e meng e ka nkoa ka mala a se nang lijo.

english_text: ART medicine storage requirements should be explained to every patient at initiation.
sesotho_text: Litlhoko tsa ho boloka meriana ea ART li lokela ho hlalossoa mokuloi e mong le e mong ha a qala.

english_text: Most ART medicines should be stored at room temperature away from heat and moisture.
sesotho_text: Meriana e mengata ea ART e lokela ho bolokoa mocheso oa kamora ntle le mocheso le mongobo.

english_text: Patients should be given a treatment literacy session before starting ART.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba lokela ho fuoa sehloho sa ho tseba phekolo pele ho qala ART.

english_text: Treatment literacy helps patients understand HIV, ART, and the importance of adherence.
sesotho_text: Ho tseba phekolo ho thusa bakuli ho utloisisa HIV, ART, le bohlokoa ba ho latela.

english_text: Adherence to ART must be above 95 percent to maintain viral suppression.
sesotho_text: Ho latela ART ho lokela ho feta pesente ea 95 ho boloka ho laoloa ha vaerase.

english_text: Even one or two missed doses per month can reduce the effectiveness of ART.
sesotho_text: Le ho lahleheloa ke dose e le 'ngoe kapa tse peli ka khoeli ho ka fokotsa bokgoni ba ART.

english_text: Viral load testing should be repeated every twelve months for stable patients on ART.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha viral load ho lokela ho phindoa likhoeli tse leshome le metso e meli le metso e meli bakeng sa bakuli ba tsitsitseng holim'a ART.

english_text: A viral load above 1000 copies per millilitre after six months on ART indicates treatment failure.
sesotho_text: Viral load e fetang likopi tse sekete ka millilitre ka mor'a likhoeli tse tšeletseng holim'a ART e bontša ho hloleha ha phekolo.

english_text: Enhanced adherence counselling should be provided before switching ART regimens.
sesotho_text: Keletso e ntlafatsoeng ea ho latela e lokela ho fanoa pele ho fetohela mananeo a mang a ART.

english_text: Three sessions of enhanced adherence counselling are recommended before declaring treatment failure.
sesotho_text: Lithupelo tse tharo tsa keletso e ntlafatsoeng ea ho latela li khothalletsoa pele ho phatlalatsa ho hloleha ha phekolo.

english_text: A repeat viral load test should be done three months after enhanced adherence counselling.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea viral load e phindilloeng e lokela ho etsoa likhoeli tse tharo ka mor'a keletso e ntlafatsoeng ea ho latela.

english_text: CD4 count testing is less important once a patient is virally suppressed on ART.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha palo ea CD4 ho bohlokoa hanyane ha mokuloi a se a laoloa ke vaerase holim'a ART.

english_text: CD4 count testing remains important for patients presenting with advanced HIV disease.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha palo ea CD4 ho ntse ho bohlokoa bakeng sa bakuli ba bontšang bolwetse ba HIV bo tsoelang pele.

english_text: Point-of-care CD4 testing allows results to be available on the same day.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha CD4 sebakeng sa tlhokomelo ho lumella hore liphetho li fumanehe letsatsi le leng.

english_text: Dried blood spot samples can be used for viral load testing in remote areas.
sesotho_text: Lisampole tsa madi a omisitsoeng li ka sebelisoa ho lekoa ha viral load libakeng tse hole.

english_text: Viral load suppression rates are a key indicator of HIV programme performance.
sesotho_text: Likhato tsa ho laoloa ha viral load ke sesupo se bohlokoa sa tšebetso ea lenaneo la HIV.

english_text: Tenofovir can cause kidney damage and bone loss with long-term use.
sesotho_text: Tenofovir e ka baka kotsi ea lipitso le ho lahleheloa ha masapo ka tšebediso ea nako e telele.

english_text: Tenofovir alafenamide has fewer kidney and bone side effects than tenofovir disoproxil fumarate.
sesotho_text: Tenofovir alafenamide e na le litlamorao tse fokolang tsa lipitso le masapo ho feta tenofovir disoproxil fumarate.

english_text: Dolutegravir can cause weight gain in some patients.
sesotho_text: Dolutegravir e ka baka ho eketseha ha boima ho bakuli ba bang.

english_text: Dolutegravir should be used with caution in women of childbearing age due to neural tube defect risk.
sesotho_text: Dolutegravir e lokela ho sebelisoa ka hloko ho basali ba lilemo tsa ho tsoa le bana ka lebaka la kotsi ea bothata ba neural tube.

english_text: Efavirenz should be taken at bedtime to minimise neuropsychiatric side effects.
sesotho_text: Efavirenz e lokela ho nkoa nako ea ho robala ho fokotsa litlamorao tsa neuropsychiatric.

english_text: Nevirapine can cause a severe skin rash and liver toxicity especially in the first few weeks.
sesotho_text: Nevirapine e ka baka ho ruruha ha letlalo ho matla le kotsi ea sebete haholo libekeng tsa pele tse itseng.

english_text: Zidovudine can cause anaemia and bone marrow suppression.
sesotho_text: Zidovudine e ka baka anaemia le ho laoloa ha bone marrow.

english_text: Stavudine is no longer recommended due to serious long-term side effects.
sesotho_text: Stavudine ha e sa khothalletsoa ka lebaka la litlamorao tse matla tsa nako e telele.

english_text: Lopinavir/ritonavir can cause diarrhoea, nausea, and elevated cholesterol.
sesotho_text: Lopinavir/ritonavir e ka baka sehlohlolo, ho nyakeloa, le ho phahama ha cholesterol.

english_text: Ritonavir is used as a pharmacokinetic booster to increase levels of other protease inhibitors.
sesotho_text: Ritonavir e sebelisoa e le moqhosi oa pharmacokinetic ho eketsa maemo a li-protease inhibitor tse ling.

english_text: Voluntary medical male circumcision reduces the risk of female-to-male HIV transmission by 60 percent.
sesotho_text: Ho ritoa ha banna ka boithatelo ho fokotsa kotsi ea phetisetso ea HIV ho tsoa ho basali ho ea ho banna ka pesente ea 60.

english_text: VMMC is recommended as part of a comprehensive HIV prevention package in high-prevalence settings.
sesotho_text: VMMC e khothalletsoa e le karolo ea sephutho se pharalletseng sa thibelo ea HIV libakeng tse nang le palo e phahameng.

english_text: VMMC does not protect against HIV transmission from men to women.
sesotho_text: VMMC ha e sireletse khahlanong le phetisetso ea HIV ho tsoa ho banna ho ea ho basali.

english_text: Oral PrEP using tenofovir and emtricitabine is highly effective when taken daily.
sesotho_text: PrEP ea molomo e sebelisang tenofovir le emtricitabine e sebetsa hantle haholo ha e nkoa letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: Cabotegravir long-acting injectable PrEP is given every two months.
sesotho_text: PrEP ea Cabotegravir e kenngoa ka mesipi e sebetsang nako e telele e neoang likhoeli tse peli le tse peli.

english_text: Dapivirine vaginal ring is a PrEP option for women that releases medicine slowly over one month.
sesotho_text: Sephaphe sa dapivirine sa sebaka sa thobalano ke khetho ea PrEP bakeng sa basali se lokollang moriana butle ka khoeli e le ngoe.

english_text: PrEP should be combined with regular HIV testing and STI screening.
sesotho_text: PrEP e lokela ho kopanyoa le liteko tsa kamehla tsa HIV le ho hlahlobeloa ha mafu a fetisoang ka thobalano.

english_text: PrEP is safe and does not cause HIV resistance if a person tests negative before starting.
sesotho_text: PrEP e bolokehile mme ha e bake khakanyo ea HIV haeba motho a hlahlobelitsoe mme a fumana sephetho se senyenyane pele ho qala.

english_text: People can stop and restart PrEP based on their risk level.
sesotho_text: Batho ba ka emisa le ho qala hape PrEP ho latela boemo ba bona ba kotsi.

english_text: On-demand PrEP involves taking doses before and after sex rather than daily.
sesotho_text: PrEP ea on-demand e kenyelletsa ho nka li-dose pele le ka mora thobalano ho feta ho nka letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: PEP must be taken for exactly 28 days and must not be stopped early.
sesotho_text: PEP e lokela ho nkoa ka matsatsi a 28 ka nepo mme ha e lokela ho emisoa kapele.

english_text: PEP is not 100 percent effective and should not replace regular prevention methods.
sesotho_text: PEP ha e sebetse ka pesente ea 100 mme ha e lokela ho nka sebaka sa mekhoa ea kamehla ea thibelo.

english_text: Blood safety programmes ensure that all donated blood is tested for HIV before transfusion.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a polokeho ea mali a netefatsa hore mali ohle a fanoeng a hlahlobeloa HIV pele ho fetisetsoang.

english_text: Universal precautions protect healthcare workers and patients from HIV transmission.
sesotho_text: Liqabelo tsa bohle li sireletsa basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle le bakuli ho phetisetso ea HIV.

english_text: Sterile injection equipment should always be used to prevent HIV transmission.
sesotho_text: Lisebelisoa tsa ho kenya ka mesipi tse hloekileng li lokela ho sebelisoa kamehla ho thibela phetisetso ea HIV.

english_text: All HIV-exposed infants should receive daily nevirapine for six weeks after birth.
sesotho_text: Bana bohle ba hlahisitsoeng HIV ba lokela ho fumana nevirapine letsatsi le leng le le leng ka libeke tse tšeletseng ka mor'a ho tsoaloa.

english_text: High-risk HIV-exposed infants should receive dual prophylaxis with nevirapine and zidovudine.
sesotho_text: Bana ba hlahisitsoeng HIV ba leng kotsing e kholo ba lokela ho fumana prophylaxis ea bobeli ea nevirapine le zidovudine.

english_text: HIV-exposed infants should be given cotrimoxazole prophylaxis from six weeks of age.
sesotho_text: Bana ba hlahisitsoeng HIV ba lokela ho fuoa prophylaxis ea cotrimoxazole ho qala libeke tse tšeletseng tsa lilemo.

english_text: Cotrimoxazole prophylaxis in HIV-exposed infants can be stopped after a negative HIV test at 18 months.
sesotho_text: Prophylaxis ea cotrimoxazole ho bana ba hlahisitsoeng HIV e ka emisoa ka mor'a tlhahlobo ea HIV e senyenyane ka likhoeli tse 18.

english_text: HIV-exposed infants who are breastfeeding should be tested for HIV at every immunisation visit.
sesotho_text: Bana ba hlahisitsoeng HIV ba anyesioang ba lokela ho hlahlobeloa HIV letsetsong le leng le le leng la ente.

english_text: HIV-positive mothers should be supported to disclose their status to their partners.
sesotho_text: Bomme ba nang le HIV ba lokela ho tsheheltsoa ho senola boemo ba bona ho balekane ba bona.

english_text: Partner testing should be offered to all male partners of HIV-positive pregnant women.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa ha molekane ho lokela ho fanooa ho banna bohle ba basali ba mitsi ba nang le HIV.

english_text: HIV-negative pregnant women with HIV-positive partners should be offered PrEP.
sesotho_text: Basali ba mitsi ba se nang HIV ba nang le balekane ba nang le HIV ba lokela ho fanooa PrEP.

english_text: Retention in PMTCT care throughout pregnancy and the postnatal period is critical.
sesotho_text: Ho lula tlhokomelong ea PMTCT ho pholletsa le ho ima le nako ea ka mor'a tsoalo ho bohlokoa haholo.

english_text: Loss to follow-up in PMTCT programmes puts both mothers and babies at risk.
sesotho_text: Ho lahlehela ho latela mananeo a PMTCT ho beha bomme le bana kotsing.

english_text: Community health workers can trace mothers who miss PMTCT appointments.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle ba sechaba ba ka batla bomme ba lahlehetseng meeto ea PMTCT.

english_text: Integrating PMTCT with maternal and child health services improves uptake.
sesotho_text: Ho kopanya PMTCT le litshebeletso tsa bophelo bo botle ba bomme le bana ho ntlafatsa ho amoheloa.

english_text: Peer mother support programmes improve PMTCT outcomes.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a tshehetso ea bomme ba bahlankana a ntlafatsa liphetho tsa PMTCT.

english_text: The elimination of mother-to-child transmission of HIV is a global health target.
sesotho_text: Ho felisoa ha phetisetso ea HIV ho tsoa ho mme ho ea ho ngoana ke sepheo sa bophelo bo botle sa lefatše lohle.

english_text: Countries can achieve EMTCT validation when transmission rates fall below two percent.
sesotho_text: Linaha li ka fihlela netefatso ea EMTCT ha likhato tsa phetisetso li theohela tlase ho pesente tse peli.

english_text: Cotrimoxazole prophylaxis should be started in all people with CD4 counts below 350.
sesotho_text: Prophylaxis ea cotrimoxazole e lokela ho qaloa ho batho bohle ba nang le palo ea CD4 e tlase ho 350.

english_text: Cotrimoxazole prophylaxis can be stopped once CD4 count rises above 350 on ART.
sesotho_text: Prophylaxis ea cotrimoxazole e ka emisoa ha palo ea CD4 e phahama ho feta 350 holim'a ART.

english_text: Isoniazid preventive therapy and cotrimoxazole should be given together in people with advanced HIV.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea thibelo ea isoniazid le cotrimoxazole li lokela ho fanoa hammoho ho batho ba nang le HIV e tsoelang pele.

english_text: Fungal infections of the skin and nails are common in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Litšoaetso tsa fungal tsa letlalo le lenala li atile ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Herpes zoster or shingles is more common and more severe in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Herpes zoster kapa shingles e atile haholo ebile e matla ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Acyclovir is used to treat herpes zoster in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Acyclovir e sebelisoa ho phekola herpes zoster ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Recurrent bacterial pneumonia is an AIDS-defining illness.
sesotho_text: Pneumonia ea bakteria e phindang e phindang ke bolwetse bo hlalositsoeng ke AIDS.

english_text: Salmonella bacteraemia is more common and more severe in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Salmonella bacteraemia e atile haholo ebile e matla ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Microsporidiosis causes chronic diarrhoea in people with advanced HIV.
sesotho_text: Microsporidiosis e baka sehlohlolo sa nako e telele ho batho ba nang le HIV e tsoelang pele.

english_text: Penicilliosis is an important opportunistic infection in people with HIV in Southeast Asia.
sesotho_text: Penicilliosis ke tšoaetso e bohlokoa ea monyetla ho batho ba nang le HIV Asia ea Boroa-bochabela.

english_text: Histoplasmosis is an opportunistic fungal infection that affects people with low CD4 counts.
sesotho_text: Histoplasmosis ke tšoaetso ea fungal ea monyetla e angoa batho ba nang le palo e tlase ea CD4.

english_text: Immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome usually occurs within the first three months of ART.
sesotho_text: Syndrome ea ho bola ha tšireletso ea 'mele hangata e etsahala ka likhoeli tse tharo tsa pele tsa ART.

english_text: Mild IRIS can be managed by continuing ART and treating the underlying infection.
sesotho_text: IRIS e bonolo e ka laoloa ka ho tsoela pele ART le ho phekola tšoaetso e ka tlaase.

english_text: Severe IRIS may require corticosteroid treatment.
sesotho_text: IRIS e matla e ka hloka phekolo ea corticosteroid.

english_text: IRIS does not mean ART is failing and treatment should not be stopped.
sesotho_text: IRIS ha e bolele hore ART e hloleha mme phekolo ha e lokela ho emisoa.

english_text: The W4SS symptom screen for TB includes cough, fever, night sweats, and weight loss.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea W4SS ea matšoao a TB e kenyelletsa ho kohoa, feberu, molapo oa bosiu, le ho lahleheloa ke boima.

english_text: A negative W4SS screen in a person living with HIV indicates low risk of active TB.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea W4SS e senyenyane ho motho ea phelang le HIV e bontša kotsi e tlase ea TB e sebetsang.

english_text: CRP testing can be added to TB screening in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha CRP ho ka eketsooa ho hlahlobeloa ha TB ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Chest X-ray is an important tool for TB screening in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: X-ray ea sefuba ke sesebelisoa se bohlokoa sa ho hlahlobeloa ha TB ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: GeneXpert MTB/RIF is a rapid molecular test that diagnoses TB and detects rifampicin resistance.
sesotho_text: GeneXpert MTB/RIF ke tlhahlobo ea molecular e potlakileng e fumanang TB le ho fumana khakanyo ea rifampicin.

english_text: GeneXpert should be used as the first-line TB diagnostic test in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: GeneXpert e lokela ho sebelisoa e le tlhahlobo ea pele ea TB ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Urine lipoarabinomannan testing can diagnose TB in people with advanced HIV disease.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha lipoarabinomannan ea moroto ho ka fumana TB ho batho ba nang le bolwetse ba HIV bo tsoelang pele.

english_text: TB preventive therapy with isoniazid and rifapentine for one month is as effective as six months of isoniazid.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea thibelo ea TB ka isoniazid le rifapentine ka khoeli e le ngoe e sebetsa joaloka likhoeli tse tšeletseng tsa isoniazid.

english_text: TB preventive therapy should be given to all household contacts of TB patients who are HIV-positive.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea thibelo ea TB e lokela ho fanoa ho batho bohle ba kopanang le bakuli ba TB ba nang le HIV malapa.

english_text: People with HIV who have completed TB treatment should receive TB preventive therapy.
sesotho_text: Batho ba nang le HIV ba phethelang phekolo ea TB ba lokela ho fumana phekolo ea thibelo ea TB.

english_text: Harm reduction services for people who inject drugs include needle exchange and opioid substitution.
sesotho_text: Litshebeletso tsa ho fokotsa kotsi bakeng sa batho ba kenyang meriana ka mesipi li kenyelletsa phapano ea mesipi le ho nka sebaka sa opioid.

english_text: Harm reduction does not increase drug use and is an evidence-based HIV prevention strategy.
sesotho_text: Ho fokotsa kotsi ha ho eketse tšebediso ea meriana mme ke leano la thibelo ea HIV le thehiloeng holim'a bopaki.

english_text: Methadone and buprenorphine are opioid substitution therapies that reduce injecting and HIV risk.
sesotho_text: Methadone le buprenorphine ke diphekolo tsa ho nka sebaka sa opioid tse fokotsa ho kenya ka mesipi le kotsi ea HIV.

english_text: Drop-in centres provide HIV services to key populations in a safe and non-judgmental environment.
sesotho_text: Lisentare tsa ho kenela li fana ka litshebeletso tsa HIV ho sechaba se bohlokoa tikolohong e bolokehileng e sa ahloleng.

english_text: Outreach workers are essential for delivering HIV services to hard-to-reach populations.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba phono ba bohlokoa ho fana ka litshebeletso tsa HIV ho sechaba se thata ho fihlela.

english_text: Self-testing kits can be distributed to key populations through outreach programmes.
sesotho_text: Lisebelisoa tsa ho itlhahlobeloa li ka abela sechaba se bohlokoa ka mananeo a phono.

english_text: HIV services for sex workers should include STI screening, contraception, and violence support.
sesotho_text: Litshebeletso tsa HIV bakeng sa basebetsi ba thobalano li lokela ho kenyelletsa ho hlahlobeloa ha mafu a fetisoang ka thobalano, thibelo ea ho ima, le tshehetso ea tlhoriso.

english_text: Decriminalisation of sex work is associated with reduced HIV risk and better health outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho tlosa molato mosebetsing oa thobalano ho amahanngoa le ho fokotsa kotsi ea HIV le liphetho tse ntle tsa bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Gay and bisexual men face unique social and structural barriers to HIV care.
sesotho_text: Banna ba ratanang le banna le ba bisexual ba tobana le meqoqo e ikhethileng ea sechaba le ea sebopeho ho tlhokomelong ea HIV.

english_text: Chemsex or the use of drugs during sex increases HIV risk among men who have sex with men.
sesotho_text: Chemsex kapa tšebediso ea meriana nakong ea thobalano e eketsa kotsi ea HIV ho banna ba robetsanang le banna.

english_text: Young women aged 15 to 24 are twice as likely to acquire HIV as young men of the same age.
sesotho_text: Basali ba bacha ba lilemo tse 15 ho isa ho 24 ba na le monyetla o habeli ho fumana HIV ho feta banna ba bacha ba lilemo tse tšoanang.

english_text: Transactional sex increases HIV risk among young women in sub-Saharan Africa.
sesotho_text: Thobalano ea khoebo e eketsa kotsi ea HIV ho basali ba bacha Afrika e ka tlase ho Sahara.

english_text: Age-disparate relationships between older men and younger women drive HIV transmission.
sesotho_text: Likamano tse fapaneng ka lilemo lipakeng tsa banna ba baholo le basali ba bacha li khothaletsa phetisetso ea HIV.

english_text: Cash transfer programmes for adolescent girls reduce HIV risk.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a ho fetisetsa chelete bakeng sa banana ba bacha a fokotsa kotsi ea HIV.

english_text: Keeping girls in school reduces their vulnerability to HIV.
sesotho_text: Ho boloka banana sekolong ho fokotsa bokoa ba bona ho HIV.

english_text: Menstrual hygiene management is linked to sexual health and HIV risk in adolescent girls.
sesotho_text: Taolo ea bohloeki ba khoeli e amahanngoa le bophelo bo botle ba thobalano le kotsi ea HIV ho banana ba bacha.

english_text: Women in polygamous relationships face increased HIV risk.
sesotho_text: Basali ba likamano tsa linyaloaneng ba tobana le kotsi e eketsehileng ea HIV.

english_text: Widows and widowers may be at increased HIV risk after losing a partner to HIV.
sesotho_text: Bahlolohadi ba ka ba kotsing e eketsehileng ea HIV ka mor'a ho lahleheloa ke molekane ke HIV.

english_text: Male circumcision programmes should include HIV counselling and testing for female partners.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a ho ritoa ha banna a lokela ho kenyelletsa keletso ea HIV le liteko bakeng sa balekane ba basali.

english_text: Engaging men as allies in gender equality reduces HIV risk for women and girls.
sesotho_text: Ho kenyelletsa banna e le balekane ho lekaneng ha bong ho fokotsa kotsi ea HIV bakeng sa basali le banana.

english_text: HIV diagnosis can trigger grief, anger, denial, and fear that require professional support.
sesotho_text: Ho fuoa HIV ho ka baka maswabi, bohale, ho hana, le tšabo tse hlokang tshehetso ea boqhetseke.

english_text: The stages of adjustment to HIV diagnosis include shock, denial, anger, bargaining, and acceptance.
sesotho_text: Maemo a ho ikamahanya le ho fuoa HIV a kenyelletsa ho tšosoa, ho hana, bohale, ho phehisana, le ho amohela.

english_text: Motivational interviewing is an effective counselling approach for improving ART adherence.
sesotho_text: Lipotso tsa khothaletso ke mokoa oa keletso o sebetsang ho ntlafatsa ho latela ART.

english_text: Problem-solving therapy helps people living with HIV address practical barriers to care.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea ho rarolla mathata e thusa batho ba phelang le HIV ho sebetsana le meqoqo ea pratiki ea tlhokomelo.

english_text: Group therapy for people living with HIV reduces depression and improves quality of life.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea sehlopha bakeng sa batho ba phelang le HIV e fokotsa ho nyamela le ho ntlafatsa boleng ba bophelo.

english_text: HIV-related stigma internalisation is associated with depression and poor treatment outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho amohela kekello e amanang le HIV ho amahanngoa le ho nyamela le liphetho tse mpe tsa phekolo.

english_text: Resilience-building programmes help people living with HIV cope with adversity.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a ho aha botsitso a thusa batho ba phelang le HIV ho mamella mathata.

english_text: Social support from family and friends is a protective factor for mental health in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso ea sechaba ho tsoa ho lelapa le metsoalle ke ntlha ea tšireletso ea bophelo ba kelello ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Disclosure of HIV status to a supportive person is associated with better mental health outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho senola boemo ba HIV ho motho ea tshehelang ho amahanngoa le liphetho tse ntle tsa bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: HIV-positive people who are employed report better mental health and quality of life.
sesotho_text: Batho ba nang le HIV ba sebetsang ba bua ka bophelo bo botle ba kelello le boleng ba bophelo bo ntlafetseng.

english_text: Wasting in people living with HIV is defined as involuntary weight loss of more than ten percent.
sesotho_text: Ho fofela ha batho ba phelang le HIV ho hlalossoa e le ho lahleheloa ha boima ka ho se ikemisele ho feta leshome la pesente.
