english_text: TB is a notifiable disease in most countries, requiring healthcare providers to report all cases to health authorities.
sesotho_text: TB ke bolwetse bo tsebisahalang linaheng tse ngata, bo hloka hore bafani ba tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle ba tsebise liketsahalo tsohle mabusetong a bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Nurses are the backbone of TB care, providing diagnosis support, treatment initiation, and patient education.
sesotho_text: Baoki ke motheo oa tlhokomelo ea TB, ba fana ka tshehetso ea tlhahlobo, ho qala phekolo, le thuto ea bakuli.

english_text: Community health workers extend TB services to patients who cannot regularly attend health facilities.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle ba sechaba ba atolosa litshebeletso tsa TB ho bakuli ba ke ke ba etela likamore tsa bophelo bo botle ka mehla.

english_text: Home visits by community health workers improve TB treatment adherence and reduce loss to follow-up.
sesotho_text: Litsebeliso tsa lapeng tsa basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle ba sechaba li ntlafatsa ho latela phekolo ea TB le ho fokotsa ho lahlehela ho latela.

english_text: TB patient education should cover disease transmission, treatment duration, side effects, and the importance of adherence.
sesotho_text: Thuto ea mokuloi oa TB e lokela ho khoahela phetisetso ea bolwetse, nako ea phekolo, litlamorao, le bohlokoa ba ho latela.

english_text: Counselling at TB diagnosis should address fears, stigma, and the patient's support network.
sesotho_text: Keletso nako ea tlhahlobo ea TB e lokela ho sebetsana le litšabo, kekello, le marang-rang a tshehetso ea mokuloi.

english_text: TB treatment literacy empowers patients to understand their treatment and advocate for their own care.
sesotho_text: Ho tseba phekolo ea TB ho matlafatsa bakuli ho utloisisa phekolo ea bona le ho ipiletsa bakeng sa tlhokomelo ea bona.

english_text: TB support groups provide emotional support and practical advice for patients on treatment.
sesotho_text: Lihlopha tsa tshehetso ea TB li fana ka tshehetso ea maikutlo le keletso ea pratiki bakeng sa bakuli ba holim'a phekolo.

english_text: Defaulter tracing — following up patients who miss appointments — is a critical nursing responsibility.
sesotho_text: Ho latela bahloki ba meeto — ho latela bakuli ba lahlehetseng meeto — ke boikarabello ba bohlokoa ba booki.

english_text: TB registers must be accurately maintained to track patient outcomes and programme performance.
sesotho_text: Lirejista tsa TB li lokela ho bolokoa ka nepo ho latela liphetho tsa bakuli le tšebetso ea lenaneo.

english_text: Infection control training for all health facility staff reduces occupational TB risk.
sesotho_text: Koetliso ea taolo ea tšoaetso bakeng sa basebetsi bohle ba kamore ea bophelo bo botle e fokotsa kotsi ea TB ea mosebetsi.

english_text: TB patients should receive nutritional assessment and counselling at the start of treatment.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba TB ba lokela ho fumana tlhahlobo ea phepo le keletso qalong ea phekolo.

english_text: Weight gain during TB treatment is a positive indicator of treatment response.
sesotho_text: Ho eketseha ha boima nakong ea phekolo ea TB ke sesupo se molemo sa karabelo ea phekolo.

english_text: Energy and protein requirements are increased in TB patients due to the metabolic demands of infection.
sesotho_text: Litlhoko tsa matla le protein li eketsehile ho bakuli ba TB ka lebaka la litlhoko tsa metabolism ea tšoaetso.

english_text: Micronutrient supplementation including zinc, vitamin D, and vitamin A may support TB treatment outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho eketsa micronutrient ho kenyelletsa zinc, vitamin D, le vitamin A ho ka tshehetsa liphetho tsa phekolo ea TB.

english_text: Food insecurity is a major barrier to TB treatment adherence and should be addressed through social support.
sesotho_text: Ho hloka tšepo ea lijo ke moqoqo o moholo oa ho latela phekolo ea TB mme o lokela ho sebetsanoa le ona ka tshehetso ea sechaba.

english_text: TB patients who are severely malnourished may require therapeutic feeding alongside TB treatment.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba TB ba hlokang phepo haholo ba ka hloka ho fuoa lijo tsa phekolo hammoho le phekolo ea TB.

english_text: Vitamin D deficiency is common in TB patients and may impair immune function.
sesotho_text: Ho hloka vitamin D ho atile ho bakuli ba TB mme ho ka khathatsa tšebetso ea tšireletso ea 'mele.

english_text: Alcohol and TB have a bidirectional relationship — alcohol worsens TB and TB worsens alcohol use.
sesotho_text: Joala le TB li na le kamano ea mahlakore a mabeli — joala le mpe TB mme TB le mpe tšebediso ea joala.

english_text: Nutritional support programmes for TB patients improve treatment completion rates.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a tshehetso ea phepo bakeng sa bakuli ba TB a ntlafatsa likhato tsa ho phetela phekolo.

english_text: A balanced diet rich in fruits, vegetables, and protein supports recovery from TB.
sesotho_text: Lijo tse lekaneng tse nang le lienyane, merogo, le protein li tshehetsa ho fola ho tsoa ho TB.

english_text: Depression is common in TB patients and is associated with poor treatment adherence.
sesotho_text: Ho nyamela ho atile ho bakuli ba TB mme ho amahanngoa le ho latela phekolo ho fokolang.

english_text: Anxiety about TB diagnosis, treatment side effects, and social consequences is common.
sesotho_text: Ho tšaba ka tlhahlobo ea TB, litlamorao tsa phekolo, le litlamorao tsa sechaba ho tloaelehile.

english_text: Screening for depression and anxiety should be integrated into TB care.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa ha ho nyamela le ho tšaba ho lokela ho kopanyoa le tlhokomelo ea TB.

english_text: Psychosocial support improves mental health outcomes and treatment adherence in TB patients.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso ea psychosocial e ntlafatsa liphetho tsa bophelo ba kelello le ho latela phekolo ho bakuli ba TB.

english_text: TB patients with mental health disorders require integrated care addressing both conditions.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba TB ba nang le mafu a bophelo ba kelello ba hloka tlhokomelo e kopaneng e sebetsanang le maemo a mabeli.

english_text: The social isolation experienced by TB patients can worsen mental health and reduce quality of life.
sesotho_text: Ho ikhethela sechabeng ho bonalang ho bakuli ba TB ho ka mpe bophelo ba kelello le ho fokotsa boleng ba bophelo.

english_text: Peer support from TB survivors can reduce stigma and improve mental health in newly diagnosed patients.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso ea bahlankana ho baphonyohi ba TB e ka fokotsa kekello le ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba kelello ho bakuli ba sa tsoa fuoa bolwetse.

english_text: Healthcare workers caring for TB patients are at risk of burnout and compassion fatigue.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle ba hlokomelang bakuli ba TB ba leng kotsing ea ho lapala le ho lapala ha boikhutso.

english_text: Cognitive impairment can occur in TB meningitis survivors and requires rehabilitation support.
sesotho_text: Ho fokolehela ha mahutu ho ka etsahala ho baphonyohi ba TB meningitis mme ho hloka tshehetso ea ho busa tšebetso.

english_text: Post-traumatic stress disorder has been reported in MDR-TB survivors following prolonged treatment.
sesotho_text: Bolwetse ba khatello ka mor'a kotsi bo buelloe ho baphonyohi ba MDR-TB ka mor'a phekolo e telele.

english_text: I did not know that TB could be prevented — I wish someone had told me earlier.
sesotho_text: Ha ke a tseba hore TB e ka thibeloa — ke lakatsa hore motho a ka mpolela pele.

english_text: After I recovered from TB, I started opening my windows every day to keep the air fresh.
sesotho_text: Ka mor'a ho fola ho tsoa ho TB, ke qalile ho bula lifensetere tsa ka letsatsi le leng le le leng ho boloka moea o hloekileng.

english_text: I cover my mouth when I cough now, even when I am healthy, because I know how TB spreads.
sesotho_text: Joale ke khupetsa molomo oa ka ha ke kohoa, le ha ke phela hantle, hobane ke tseba hore TB e phatlalala joang.

english_text: My child received the BCG injection at birth and I am glad the nurse explained what it was for.
sesotho_text: Ngoana oa ka o fumanoe ente ea BCG ha a tsoaloa mme ke thabile hore mooki o hlalositsa hore e ne e le bakeng sa eng.

english_text: I was tested for latent TB because my husband had active TB, and I was given tablets to prevent it.
sesotho_text: Ke hlahlobelitsoe TB e patileng hobane monna oa ka o ne a na le TB e sebetsang, mme ke fuoe lipilisi ho e thibela.

english_text: Living with TB taught me to take care of my health and not ignore symptoms.
sesotho_text: Ho phela le TB ho nthutile ho hlokomela bophelo ba ka le ho se hane matšoao.

english_text: I tell everyone in my community that TB is curable — there is no need to be ashamed.
sesotho_text: Ke bolella bohle sechabeng sa ka hore TB e ka folisoa — ha ho na lebaka la ho hlajoa ke maswabi.

english_text: After completing TB treatment, I felt stronger and more grateful for my health than ever before.
sesotho_text: Ka mor'a ho phetela phekolo ea TB, ke ikutloa ke matla haholo mme ke leboha bophelo ba ka ho feta nako efe kafe pele.

english_text: I joined a TB support group and met others who understood exactly what I was going through.
sesotho_text: Ke kenele sehlopha sa tshehetso ea TB mme ka kopana le ba bang ba neng ba utloisisa ka nepo seo ke neng ke se ntse ke se ntse ke se kena le sona.

english_text: My faith helped me stay strong during my TB treatment journey.
sesotho_text: Tumelo ea ka e nthusitse ho lula ke matla nakong ea leeto la phekolo ea TB ea ka.

english_text: I now volunteer at the clinic to support other TB patients the way I was supported.
sesotho_text: Joale ke sebetsa ka boithatelo klinikhing ho tshehetsa bakuli ba bang ba TB tsela eo nna ke neng ke tsheheltsoa ka eona.

english_text: TB changed my life, but it also made me stronger and more compassionate towards others who are sick.
sesotho_text: TB e fetohile bophelo ba ka, empa e boetse e ntlisa matla le kutloisiso ho ba bang ba kulang.

english_text: I am proud that I never missed a single dose of my TB medication.
sesotho_text: Ke ikantse hore ha ke eso lahleheloe ke dose le e le 'ngoe ea meriana ea TB ea ka.

english_text: My doctor told me my lungs have healed well and I can live a normal life.
sesotho_text: Ngaka ea ka e mpolela hore matšoafo a ka a folile hantle mme nka phela bophelo ba kamehla.

english_text: I want other people to know that TB is not a death sentence — you can recover and live fully.
sesotho_text: Ke batla batho ba bang ho tseba hore TB ha se kahlolo ea lefu — u ka fola mme u phele ka botlalo.

english_text: The hardest part was telling my children I had TB, but they were very supportive.
sesotho_text: Karolo e thata ka ho fetisisa e ne e le ho bolella bana ba ka hore ke na le TB, empa ba ne ba tshehetsa haholo.

english_text: I eat better now than before I had TB because I learned how important nutrition is.
sesotho_text: Joale ke ja hantle ho feta pele ke na le TB hobane ke ithutile hore phepo e bohlokoa hakae.

english_text: I still get tired easily since finishing TB treatment, but the clinic says this will improve over time.
sesotho_text: Ke ntse ke lapala bonolo ho tloha ha ke phetela phekolo ea TB, empa kliniki e re sena se tla ntlafala nako e ntse e tsoela pele.

english_text: I was scared to go back to work after TB, but my employer was understanding.
sesotho_text: Ke ne ke tšaba ho khutlela mosebetsing ka mor'a TB, empa mofani oa ka oa mosebetsi o ne a utloisisa.

english_text: Every day I am healthy is a gift — TB taught me not to take my health for granted.
sesotho_text: Letsatsi le leng le le leng leo ke phelang hantle ke mpho — TB e nthutile ho se nke bophelo ba ka e le ntho e tloaelehileng.

english_text: A persistent cough lasting more than two weeks may be a sign of tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Ho kohoa ho tsoelang pele ho feta libeke tse peli ho ka ba letšoao la tuberculosis.

english_text: Night sweats that soak your clothes can be a symptom of active TB disease.
sesotho_text: Molapo oa bosiu o omisang liaparo tsa hau o ka ba letšoao la bolwetse ba TB bo sebetsang.

english_text: Unexplained weight loss is one of the classic warning signs of tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Ho lahleheloa ke boima ho sa hlalositsoeng ke e 'ngoe ea lišoaetso tsa tlhokahalo tsa kamehla tsa tuberculosis.

english_text: Coughing up blood or blood-stained sputum requires immediate medical attention.
sesotho_text: Ho kohoa mali kapa mathe a nang le mali ho hloka tlhokomelo ea ngaka hang hang.

english_text: Chest pain when breathing or coughing can indicate tuberculosis affecting the lungs.
sesotho_text: Mahloko a sefubeng ha ho hema kapa ho kohoa a ka bontša tuberculosis e angoa matšoafo.

english_text: Fatigue and general weakness are common early symptoms of tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Ho lapala le ho fokotsehela ka kakaretso ke matšoao a pele a tloaelehileng a tuberculosis.

english_text: A low-grade fever that persists for weeks can be a sign of TB infection.
sesotho_text: Feberu e tlase e tsoelang pele ka libeke e ka ba letšoao la tšoaetso ea TB.

english_text: Loss of appetite is frequently reported by patients with active tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Ho lahleheloa ke takatso ea lijo ho buelloa hangata ke bakuli ba nang le tuberculosis e sebetsang.

english_text: Swollen lymph nodes in the neck can indicate extrapulmonary tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Li-lymph node tse ruruhetse molaleng li ka bontša tuberculosis ea kantle ho matšoafo.

english_text: TB can affect organs other than the lungs, including the kidneys, spine, and brain.
sesotho_text: TB e ka angoa litho tse ling ho feta matšoafo, ho kenyelletsa lipitso, mokokotlo, le boko.

english_text: A sputum smear test is one of the most common ways to diagnose pulmonary tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea ho hlakola mathe ke e 'ngoe ea mekhoa e atileng ka ho fetisisa ea ho fumana tuberculosis ea matšoafo.

english_text: GeneXpert is a rapid molecular test that can detect TB and rifampicin resistance within two hours.
sesotho_text: GeneXpert ke tlhahlobo ea molecular ea potlako e ka fumanang TB le khakanyo ea rifampicin ka hare ho maho a mabeli.

english_text: A chest X-ray can show changes in the lungs that suggest tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: X-ray ea sefuba e ka bontša liphetoho matšoafong tse bontšang tuberculosis.

english_text: The tuberculin skin test, also called the Mantoux test, checks for TB infection.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea letlalo ea tuberculin, e bitsoa hape tlhahlobo ea Mantoux, e hlahloba tšoaetso ea TB.

english_text: A positive TB skin test does not always mean you have active TB disease.
sesotho_text: Sephetho se molemo sa tlhahlobo ea letlalo ea TB ha se bolele kamehla hore u na le bolwetse ba TB bo sebetsang.

english_text: Interferon-gamma release assays are blood tests used to diagnose latent TB infection.
sesotho_text: Li-assay tsa ho lokolla interferon-gamma ke liteko tsa mali tse sebelisoa ho fumana tšoaetso ea TB e patileng.

english_text: Drug susceptibility testing helps determine which TB medicines will work for your infection.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha ho amehela ha meriana ho thusa ho bua hore na meriana efe ea TB e tla sebetsa tšoaetsong ea hau.

english_text: Early diagnosis of tuberculosis is essential to prevent spread to others.
sesotho_text: Ho fumana tuberculosis kapele ho bohlokoa ho thibela ho phatlalala ho ba bang.

english_text: TB diagnosis in children can be challenging because they may not produce sputum easily.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea TB ho bana e ka ba thata hobane ba ka nna ba sa hlahise mathe bonolo.

english_text: Contact tracing helps identify people who may have been exposed to TB.
sesotho_text: Ho latela bakopani ho thusa ho tseba batho ba ka bang ba hlahisitsoe TB.

english_text: Standard TB treatment for drug-sensitive TB lasts six months.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea kamehla ea TB bakeng sa TB e amehang ke meriana e nka likhoeli tse tšeletseng.

english_text: The first two months of TB treatment use four drugs: isoniazid, rifampicin, pyrazinamide, and ethambutol.
sesotho_text: Likhoeli tse peli tsa pele tsa phekolo ea TB li sebelisa meriana e mene: isoniazid, rifampicin, pyrazinamide, le ethambutol.

english_text: The continuation phase of TB treatment uses isoniazid and rifampicin for four months.
sesotho_text: Nako ea ho tsoela pele ea phekolo ea TB e sebelisa isoniazid le rifampicin ka likhoeli tse nne.

english_text: Never stop taking your TB medication without consulting your healthcare provider.
sesotho_text: Le ka mohla u se ke ua emisa ho nka meriana ea TB ntle le ho buisana le mofani oa hau oa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Fixed-dose combination tablets make it easier to take all TB medicines at once.
sesotho_text: Lipilisi tsa kopano ea dose e tsitsitseng li bonofatsa ho nka meriana yohle ea TB ka nako e le ngoe.

english_text: TB medicines should be taken on an empty stomach for better absorption.
sesotho_text: Meriana ea TB e lokela ho nkoa ka mala a se nang lijo bakeng sa ho metsoa hantle.

english_text: Rifampicin can turn your urine, sweat, and tears orange — this is normal and harmless.
sesotho_text: Rifampicin e ka fetola moroto, molapo, le meokho ea hau e be orange — sena se tloaelehile mme ha se kotsi.

english_text: Isoniazid can cause peripheral neuropathy; vitamin B6 supplements help prevent this.
sesotho_text: Isoniazid e ka baka neuropathy ea maphethelo; lisebelisoa tsa vitamin B6 li thusa ho thibela sena.

english_text: Pyrazinamide can cause joint pain and elevated uric acid levels.
sesotho_text: Pyrazinamide e ka baka mahloko a maqhoa le ho phahama ha maemo a uric acid.

english_text: Ethambutol can affect vision; report any changes in eyesight to your doctor immediately.
sesotho_text: Ethambutol e ka angoa pono; tsebisa ngaka ea hau liphetoho life kapa life tsa pono hang hang.

english_text: Liver toxicity is a serious side effect of some TB medicines; avoid alcohol during treatment.
sesotho_text: Kotsi ea sebete ke tlhamorao e matla ea meriana e meng ea TB; hana joala nakong ea phekolo.

english_text: Directly Observed Treatment ensures a healthcare worker watches you take each dose.
sesotho_text: Phekolo e Shebilloeng ka Kotloloho e netefatsa hore mosebetsi oa bophelo bo botle o u sheba ha u nka dose le 'ngoe le e 'ngoe.

english_text: Video-observed therapy allows patients to take their TB medication at home via video call.
sesotho_text: Phekolo e shebilloeng ka video e lumella bakuli ho nka meriana ea TB lapeng ka video call.

english_text: Treatment supporters can be family members, community health workers, or clinic staff.
sesotho_text: Batshehetsi ba phekolo ba ka ba maloko a lelapa, basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle ba sechaba, kapa basebetsi ba kliniki.

english_text: Nutritional support during TB treatment improves treatment outcomes.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso ea phepo nakong ea phekolo ea TB e ntlafatsa liphetho tsa phekolo.

english_text: Patients with TB and diabetes need careful monitoring as both conditions affect each other.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba nang le TB le tsoekere ba hloka ho hlahlojoa ka hloko hobane maemo a mabeli a angana.

english_text: Pregnant women with TB can be safely treated; discuss the safest regimen with your doctor.
sesotho_text: Basali ba mitsi ba nang le TB ba ka phekoluoa ka polokeho; buisana le ngaka ea hau ka leano le bolokehileng ka ho fetisisa.

english_text: Children with TB are treated with the same drugs as adults but at weight-adjusted doses.
sesotho_text: Bana ba nang le TB ba phekoluoa ka meriana e tšoanang le ea batho ba baholo empa ka li-dose tse fetohileng ho latela boima.

english_text: TB treatment is free at all public health facilities in South Africa.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea TB ha e lefisoe likamoreng tsohle tsa bophelo bo botle tsa sechaba Afrika Boroa.

english_text: Drug-resistant TB develops when TB bacteria survive despite antibiotic treatment.
sesotho_text: TB e khakanyeng meriana e hlaha ha bakteria ea TB e phela le ha e phekoluoa ka li-antibiotic.

english_text: Multidrug-resistant TB is resistant to at least isoniazid and rifampicin.
sesotho_text: TB e khakanyeng meriana e mengata e khahlanong le isoniazid le rifampicin bonyane.

english_text: Extensively drug-resistant TB is resistant to more TB medicines and is harder to treat.
sesotho_text: TB e khakanyeng meriana e ngata haholo e khahlanong le meriana e mengata ea TB mme e thata ho phekola.

english_text: MDR-TB treatment can last 9 to 20 months depending on the regimen used.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea MDR-TB e ka nka likhoeli tse 9 ho isa ho tse 20 ho latela leano le sebelisitsoeng.

english_text: The BPaL regimen uses bedaquiline, pretomanid, and linezolid for highly resistant TB.
sesotho_text: Leano la BPaL le sebelisa bedaquiline, pretomanid, le linezolid bakeng sa TB e khakanyeng haholo.

english_text: Bedaquiline is a newer TB drug that works differently from older TB medicines.
sesotho_text: Bedaquiline ke moriana o mocha oa TB o sebetsang ka tsela e fapaneng ho meriana ea khale ea TB.

english_text: Delamanid is another newer drug used in the treatment of drug-resistant TB.
sesotho_text: Delamanid ke moriana o mocha o mong o sebelisoa ho phekola TB e khakanyeng meriana.

english_text: Drug-resistant TB requires treatment at a specialised TB facility.
sesotho_text: TB e khakanyeng meriana e hloka phekolo kamoreng ea TB e khethehileng.

english_text: Incomplete treatment of drug-sensitive TB is the main cause of drug resistance.
sesotho_text: Ho phekola TB e amehang ke meriana ho sa phethehe ke lebaka le leholo la khakanyo ea meriana.

english_text: Regular sputum cultures during MDR-TB treatment monitor your response to therapy.
sesotho_text: Li-culture tsa mathe tsa kamehla nakong ea phekolo ea MDR-TB li hlahloja karabelo ea hau ho phekolo.

english_text: The BCG vaccine protects infants and young children from severe forms of tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Ente ea BCG e sireletsa bana ba banyenyane le bana ba banyenyane ho mefuta e matla ea tuberculosis.

english_text: BCG vaccination is given at birth as part of the routine childhood immunisation schedule.
sesotho_text: Ente ea BCG e fanoa ha ho tsoaloa e le karolo ea leano la kamehla la ente ea bana.

english_text: TB preventive therapy reduces the risk of latent TB progressing to active disease.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea thibelo ea TB e fokotsa kotsi ea TB e patileng ea ho tsoela pele ho bolwetse bo sebetsang.

english_text: Isoniazid preventive therapy for six months is recommended for people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea thibelo ea isoniazid ka likhoeli tse tšeletseng e khothalletsoa bakeng sa batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: A three-month course of weekly isoniazid and rifapentine is an effective TB preventive regimen.
sesotho_text: Khoroso ea likhoeli tse tharo ea isoniazid le rifapentine ea beke le beke ke leano le sebetsang la thibelo ea TB.

english_text: Ventilating indoor spaces reduces the concentration of TB bacteria in the air.
sesotho_text: Ho fana ka moea libakeng tsa ka hare ho fokotsa bongata ba bakteria ea TB moeeng.

english_text: Opening windows and doors allows fresh air to dilute infectious TB particles.
sesotho_text: Ho bula lifensetere le menyako ho lumella moea o hloekileng ho fokotsa likaroloana tse fetisoang tsa TB.

english_text: Healthcare workers should wear N95 respirators when caring for TB patients.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle ba lokela ho apara li-respirator tsa N95 ha ba hlokomela bakuli ba TB.

english_text: UV germicidal irradiation can kill TB bacteria in indoor air.
sesotho_text: Ho phahamisoa ha UV ho ka bolaea bakteria ea TB moeeng oa ka hare.

english_text: Cough hygiene — covering your mouth when coughing — helps prevent TB transmission.
sesotho_text: Bohloeki ba ho kohoa — ho khupetsa molomo oa hau ha u kohoa — bo thusa ho thibela phetisetso ea TB.

english_text: Treating latent TB infection is an important strategy for eliminating tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Ho phekola tšoaetso ea TB e patileng ke leano le bohlokoa la ho felisa tuberculosis.

english_text: Household contacts of TB patients should be screened for TB infection.
sesotho_text: Batho ba kopanang le bakuli ba TB malapa ba lokela ho hlahlobeloa tšoaetso ea TB.

english_text: Children under five who are household contacts of TB patients should receive TB preventive therapy.
sesotho_text: Bana ba tlase ho lilemo tse hlano ba kopanang le bakuli ba TB malapa ba lokela ho fumana phekolo ea thibelo ea TB.

english_text: Good nutrition strengthens the immune system and reduces the risk of developing active TB.
sesotho_text: Phepo e ntle e matlafatsa tšireletso ea 'mele le ho fokotsa kotsi ea ho ba le TB e sebetsang.

english_text: Reducing overcrowding in homes and workplaces lowers the risk of TB transmission.
sesotho_text: Ho fokotsa ho tletse batho malapa le mafapheng a mosebetsi ho theohisa kotsi ea phetisetso ea TB.

english_text: Smoking increases the risk of developing active tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Ho tsuba ho eketsa kotsi ea ho ba le tuberculosis e sebetsang.

english_text: Alcohol use weakens the immune system and increases TB risk.
sesotho_text: Tšebediso ea joala e fokotsehisa tšireletso ea 'mele le ho eketsa kotsi ea TB.

english_text: Diabetes mellitus triples the risk of developing active tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Tsoekere e katisa kotsi ea ho ba le tuberculosis e sebetsang ka makhetlo a mararo.

english_text: Malnutrition is the single largest risk factor for tuberculosis globally.
sesotho_text: Ho hloka phepo ke ntlha e le 'ngoe e kholo ka ho fetisisa ea kotsi ea tuberculosis lefatšeng lohle.

english_text: HIV is the strongest known risk factor for developing active tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: HIV ke ntlha e tsebahetseng e matla ka ho fetisisa ea kotsi ea ho ba le tuberculosis e sebetsang.

english_text: The WHO four-symptom TB screen asks about cough, fever, weight loss, and night sweats.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea matšoao a mane a WHO ea TB e botsa ka ho kohoa, feberu, ho lahleheloa ke boima, le molapo oa bosiu.

english_text: People living with HIV who have TB symptoms should be tested with GeneXpert.
sesotho_text: Batho ba phelang le HIV ba nang le matšoao a TB ba lokela ho lekoa ka GeneXpert.

english_text: TB treatment should be started as soon as possible in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea TB e lokela ho qaloa kamoo ho khonehang ka potlako ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome can occur when ART is started during TB treatment.
sesotho_text: Syndrome ea ho bola ha tšireletso ea 'mele e ka etsahala ha ART e qaloa nakong ea phekolo ea TB.

english_text: Drug interactions between TB medicines and antiretrovirals require careful management.
sesotho_text: Likopano tsa meriana lipakeng tsa meriana ea TB le li-antiretroviral li hloka taolo e nang le hloko.

english_text: Rifampicin reduces the blood levels of many antiretroviral drugs.
sesotho_text: Rifampicin e fokotsa maemo a mali a meriana e mengata ea antiretroviral.

english_text: Efavirenz-based ART is preferred when treating TB and HIV simultaneously.
sesotho_text: ART e thehiloeng holim'a efavirenz e khahloa ha ho phekola TB le HIV ka nako e le ngoe.

english_text: Integrated TB and HIV services improve patient outcomes and reduce loss to follow-up.
sesotho_text: Litshebeletso tse kopaneng tsa TB le HIV li ntlafatsa liphetho tsa bakuli le ho fokotsa ho lahlehela ho latela.

english_text: TB preventive therapy is recommended for all people living with HIV who do not have active TB.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea thibelo ea TB e khothalletsoa bakeng sa batho bohle ba phelang le HIV ba se nang TB e sebetsang.

english_text: Cotrimoxazole prophylaxis reduces the risk of opportunistic infections in TB-HIV patients.
sesotho_text: Prophylaxis ea cotrimoxazole e fokotsa kotsi ea litšoaetso tsa monyetla ho bakuli ba TB-HIV.

english_text: Children with TB often have different symptoms than adults, including failure to thrive.
sesotho_text: Bana ba nang le TB hangata ba na le matšoao a fapaneng le a batho ba baholo, ho kenyelletsa ho hloleha ho hola.

english_text: Adolescents with TB may feel stigmatised and need psychosocial support.
sesotho_text: Bacha ba nang le TB ba ka ikutloa ba kekellotsoe mme ba hloka tshehetso ea psychosocial.

english_text: Older adults with TB may have atypical symptoms that delay diagnosis.
sesotho_text: Batho ba baholo ba nang le TB ba ka ba le matšoao a sa tloaelehang a liehelang tlhahlobo.

english_text: Prisoners and detainees are at high risk of TB due to overcrowding and poor ventilation.
sesotho_text: Bakotsofatsi le ba tshoareloang ba leng kotsing e phahameng ea TB ka lebaka la ho tletse batho le moea o fokolang.

english_text: Miners are at high risk of TB due to silica dust exposure and underground conditions.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba merafo ba leng kotsing e phahameng ea TB ka lebaka la ho hlahisoa lerole la silica le maemo a tlase ho mobu.

english_text: Silicosis from mining dramatically increases the risk of developing tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Silicosis e tsoang merafong e eketsa haholo kotsi ea ho ba le tuberculosis.

english_text: Homeless people face significant barriers to TB diagnosis and treatment completion.
sesotho_text: Batho ba hlokang ntlo ba tobana le meqoqo e kholo ea tlhahlobo ea TB le ho phetela phekolo.

english_text: Migrants and refugees may have higher rates of TB and face barriers to healthcare access.
sesotho_text: Baahi ba fetang le baphaphathehi ba ka ba le likhato tse phahameng tsa TB mme ba tobana le meqoqo ea phihlello ea tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Healthcare workers are at increased risk of TB exposure and should be regularly screened.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle ba leng kotsing e eketsehileng ea ho hlahisoa TB mme ba lokela ho hlahlobeloa ka mehla.

english_text: TB screening programmes in high-risk workplaces save lives and reduce transmission.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a ho hlahlobeloa ha TB mafapheng a mosebetsi a leng kotsing e phahameng a boloka bophelo le ho fokotsa phetisetso.

english_text: TB stigma can prevent people from seeking diagnosis and completing treatment.
sesotho_text: Kekello ea TB e ka thibela batho ho batla tlhahlobo le ho phetela phekolo.

english_text: Tuberculosis is a disease, not a sign of weakness or moral failure.
sesotho_text: Tuberculosis ke bolwetse, eseng letšoao la ho fokotsehela kapa ho hloleha ha boitšoaro.

english_text: Community education reduces TB stigma and encourages people to seek care.
sesotho_text: Thuto ea sechaba e fokotsa kekello ea TB le ho khothaletsa batho ho batla tlhokomelo.

english_text: TB survivors can play a powerful role in reducing stigma in their communities.
sesotho_text: Baphonyohi ba TB ba ka bua karolo e matla ho fokotsa kekello sechabeng sa bona.

english_text: Mental health support should be integrated into TB care services.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso ea bophelo ba kelello e lokela ho kopanyoa le litshebeletso tsa tlhokomelo ea TB.

english_text: Depression is common among TB patients and can negatively affect treatment adherence.
sesotho_text: Ho nyamela ho atile ho bakuli ba TB mme ho ka angoa ho latela phekolo ka tsela e mpe.

english_text: Peer support groups help TB patients stay motivated and complete their treatment.
sesotho_text: Lihlopha tsa tshehetso ea bahlankana li thusa bakuli ba TB ho lula ba khothalitsoe le ho phetela phekolo ea bona.

english_text: Disclosing your TB diagnosis to trusted family members can help you get the support you need.
sesotho_text: Ho senola tlhahlobo ea TB ea hau ho maloko a lelapa a tšepahalang ho ka u thusa ho fumana tshehetso eo u e hlokang.

english_text: Social protection measures such as food vouchers help TB patients stay on treatment.
sesotho_text: Mehato ea tšireletso ea sechaba joalo ka li-voucher tsa lijo e thusa bakuli ba TB ho lula holim'a phekolo.

english_text: Transport support for clinic visits reduces missed appointments among TB patients.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso ea lipalangoa bakeng sa litsebeliso tsa kliniki e fokotsa meeto e lahlehileng ho bakuli ba TB.

english_text: Tuberculosis is one of the top ten causes of death worldwide.
sesotho_text: Tuberculosis ke e 'ngoe ea mabaka a leshome a phahameng ka ho fetisisa a lefu lefatšeng lohle.

english_text: The WHO End TB Strategy aims to reduce TB deaths by 95 percent by 2035.
sesotho_text: Leano la WHO la ho Felisa TB le ikemiseditse ho fokotsa lifu tsa TB ka pesente ea 95 ka 2035.

english_text: Achieving the End TB targets requires addressing poverty, malnutrition, and social determinants.
sesotho_text: Ho fihlela lipheo tsa ho Felisa TB ho hloka ho sebetsana le bofuma, ho hloka phepo, le lintlha tsa sechaba.

english_text: TB notification rates have been declining globally but progress is too slow.
sesotho_text: Likhato tsa ho tsebisa TB li theohile lefatšeng lohle empa tsoelo-pele e lieha haholo.

english_text: The COVID-19 pandemic disrupted TB services and set back progress against tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Lefu la COVID-19 le phephetse litshebeletso tsa TB mme la khutlisa tsoelo-pele khahlanong le tuberculosis.

english_text: Investing in TB research and new diagnostics is critical to ending the epidemic.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahisa lichelete lipatlisisong tsa TB le litlhahlobo tse ncha ho bohlokoa ho felisa leruo la lefu.

english_text: Community health workers are essential to reaching TB patients in remote areas.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle ba sechaba ba bohlokoa ho fihlela bakuli ba TB libakeng tse hole.

english_text: Digital health tools such as SMS reminders can improve TB treatment adherence.
sesotho_text: Lisebelisoa tsa bophelo bo botle tsa dijithale joalo ka litemoso tsa SMS li ka ntlafatsa ho latela phekolo ea TB.

english_text: Universal health coverage is fundamental to ending tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Koahelo ea bophelo bo botle ea bohle ke motheo oa ho felisa tuberculosis.

english_text: I was scared when I was told I had tuberculosis, but my nurse explained everything clearly.
sesotho_text: Ke ne ke tšaba ha ke bolelloa hore ke na le tuberculosis, empa mooki oa ka o hlalositsa ntho tsohle ka boqaqo.

english_text: Taking six months of tablets every day was difficult, but I finished my treatment.
sesotho_text: Ho nka lipilisi letsatsi le leng le le leng ka likhoeli tse tšeletseng e ne e le thata, empa ke pheteletse phekolo ea ka.

english_text: My family supported me throughout my TB treatment and I am grateful.
sesotho_text: Lelapa la ka le ntshehetse nako yohle ea phekolo ea TB ea ka mme ke leboha.

english_text: I lost my job because people at work were afraid of catching TB from me.
sesotho_text: Ke lahleheloe ke mosebetsi hobane batho mosebetsing ba ne ba tšaba ho tšoaetsoa TB ke nna.

english_text: After two weeks on treatment I started feeling much better and could sleep through the night.
sesotho_text: Ka mor'a libeke tse peli holim'a phekolo ke qalile ho ikutloa ke ntlafetse haholo mme ka khona ho robala bosiu bohle.

english_text: I now tell everyone in my community to go and get tested if they have a cough.
sesotho_text: Joale ke bolella bohle sechabeng sa ka ho ea ho hlahlobeloa haeba ba na le ho kohoa.

english_text: The community health worker visited me at home every day to make sure I took my tablets.
sesotho_text: Mosebetsi oa bophelo bo botle oa sechaba o ne a etela lapeng letsatsi le leng le le leng ho netefatsa hore ke nka lipilisi tsa ka.

english_text: I was relieved when my sputum test came back negative after two months of treatment.
sesotho_text: Ke khotsofetse ha tlhahlobo ea mathe ea ka e khutlile e senyenyane ka mor'a likhoeli tse peli tsa phekolo.

english_text: Having TB and HIV at the same time was overwhelming, but the clinic team helped me cope.
sesotho_text: Ho ba le TB le HIV ka nako e le ngoe e ne e le thata haholo, empa sehlopha sa kliniki se nthusitse ho mamella.

english_text: I am now cured of tuberculosis and I feel stronger than ever before.
sesotho_text: Joale ke folisitsoe tuberculosis mme ke ikutloa ke matla ho feta nako efe kafe pele.

english_text: TB patients should sleep in a well-ventilated room, separate from other household members if possible.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba TB ba lokela ho robala kamoreng e nang le moea o lekaneng, e arohaneng le maloko a mang a lelapa haeba ho khoneha.

english_text: Infectious TB patients should avoid crowded public spaces during the first two weeks of treatment.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba TB ba fetisoang ba lokela ho hana libaka tsa sechaba tse tletse batho nakong ea libeke tse peli tsa pele tsa phekolo.

english_text: After two weeks of effective treatment, most TB patients are no longer infectious.
sesotho_text: Ka mor'a libeke tse peli tsa phekolo e sebetsang, bakuli ba bangata ba TB ha ba sa fetiseloe.

english_text: TB infection control in health facilities protects both patients and healthcare workers.
sesotho_text: Taolo ea tšoaetso ea TB likamoreng tsa bophelo bo botle e sireletsa bakuli le basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Administrative controls such as fast-tracking TB patients reduce exposure in waiting areas.
sesotho_text: Taolo ea tsamaiso joalo ka ho potlakisa bakuli ba TB e fokotsa ho hlahisoa libakeng tsa ho ema.

english_text: Environmental controls like natural ventilation are the most cost-effective TB infection control measure.
sesotho_text: Taolo ea tikoloho joalo ka moea oa tlhaho ke mohato o sebetsang ka ho fetisisa oa taolo ea tšoaetso ea TB ho latela litšenyehelo.

english_text: Respiratory protection for healthcare workers is the last line of defence against TB transmission.
sesotho_text: Tšireletso ea ho hema bakeng sa basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle ke mola oa ho qetela oa tšireletso khahlanong le phetisetso ea TB.

english_text: Cough etiquette posters in clinic waiting rooms remind patients to cover their mouths.
sesotho_text: Liforomo tsa mokhoa oa ho kohoa likamoreng tsa ho ema tsa kliniki li khumamisa bakuli ho khupetsa melumo ea bona.

english_text: Sputum collection should be done outdoors or in a well-ventilated area to reduce transmission risk.
sesotho_text: Ho kgotha mathe ho lokela ho etsoa kantle kapa sebakeng se nang le moea o lekaneng ho fokotsa kotsi ea phetisetso.

english_text: TB triage at clinic entry helps identify and separate potentially infectious patients quickly.
sesotho_text: Triage ea TB ha ho kenoa klinikhing e thusa ho tseba le ho arola bakuli ba ka fetisoang ka potlako.

english_text: Sputum smear microscopy at two months confirms whether treatment is working.
sesotho_text: Microscopy ea ho hlakola mathe ka likhoeli tse peli e netefatsa hore na phekolo e sebetsa.

english_text: A positive sputum culture at three months may indicate treatment failure.
sesotho_text: Culture ea mathe e molemo ka likhoeli tse tharo e ka bontša ho hloleha ha phekolo.

english_text: Monthly clinic visits during TB treatment allow the doctor to monitor your progress.
sesotho_text: Litsebeliso tsa kliniki tsa khoeli le khoeli nakong ea phekolo ea TB li lumella ngaka ho hlahloja tsoelo-pele ea hau.

english_text: Weight gain during TB treatment is a positive sign that the medicines are working.
sesotho_text: Ho eketseha ha boima nakong ea phekolo ea TB ke letšoao le molemo la hore meriana e sebetsa.

english_text: End-of-treatment sputum culture confirms successful cure for drug-resistant TB.
sesotho_text: Culture ea mathe ea qetelo ea phekolo e netefatsa pholo e atlehileng bakeng sa TB e khakanyeng meriana.

english_text: Post-treatment follow-up helps detect TB relapse early.
sesotho_text: Ho latela ka mor'a phekolo ho thusa ho fumana ho khutlela morao ha TB kapele.

english_text: TB relapse can occur months or years after completing treatment.
sesotho_text: Ho khutlela morao ha TB ho ka etsahala likhoeli kapa lilemo ka mor'a ho phetela phekolo.

english_text: Report any new symptoms after completing TB treatment to your healthcare provider.
sesotho_text: Tsebisa mofani oa hau oa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle matšoao afe kafe a mocha ka mor'a ho phetela phekolo ea TB.

english_text: Liver function tests should be monitored regularly during TB treatment.
sesotho_text: Liteko tsa tšebetso ea sebete li lokela ho hlahlojoa ka mehla nakong ea phekolo ea TB.

english_text: Vision testing should be done before and during ethambutol treatment.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha pono ho lokela ho etsoa pele le nakong ea phekolo ea ethambutol.

english_text: TB is a notifiable disease; all cases must be reported to the national health authorities.
sesotho_text: TB ke bolwetse bo tsebisahalang; liketsahalo tsohle li lokela ho tsebisoa mabusetong a bophelo bo botle a naha.

english_text: The National Strategic Plan guides South Africa's response to tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Leano la Naha la Leano le etelela karabelo ea Afrika Boroa ho tuberculosis.

english_text: Community-based TB care reduces the burden on health facilities and improves patient outcomes.
sesotho_text: Tlhokomelo ea TB e thehiloeng sechabeng e fokotsa morwalo oa likamore tsa bophelo bo botle le ho ntlafatsa liphetho tsa bakuli.

english_text: Task-shifting allows community health workers to support TB treatment adherence.
sesotho_text: Ho fetisetsa mesebetsi e fapaneng ho lumella basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle ba sechaba ho tshehetsa ho latela phekolo ea TB.

english_text: Electronic TB registers improve data quality and programme monitoring.
sesotho_text: Lirejista tsa TB tsa elektroniki li ntlafatsa boleng ba data le ho hlahloja lenaneo.

english_text: The treatment success rate is the key indicator of TB programme performance.
sesotho_text: Khato ea katleho ea phekolo ke sesupo se bohlokoa sa tšebetso ea lenaneo la TB.

english_text: Loss to follow-up remains a major challenge in achieving high TB treatment success rates.
sesotho_text: Ho lahlehela ho latela ho ntse ho le mathata a maholo ho fihlela likhato tse phahameng tsa katleho ea phekolo ea TB.

english_text: Tracing patients lost to follow-up is an essential part of TB programme management.
sesotho_text: Ho latela bakuli ba lahlehetseng ho latela ke karolo ea bohlokoa ea taolo ea lenaneo la TB.

english_text: Public-private partnerships expand access to TB diagnosis and treatment services.
sesotho_text: Likoporasi tsa sechaba le tsa poraefete li atolosa phihlello ea litshebeletso tsa tlhahlobo le phekolo ea TB.

english_text: Adequate funding for TB programmes is essential to achieving elimination targets.
sesotho_text: Lichelete tse lekaneng bakeng sa mananeo a TB li bohlokoa ho fihlela lipheo tsa ho felisa bolwetse.

english_text: Tuberculosis has affected humanity for thousands of years and remains a global health challenge.
sesotho_text: Tuberculosis e angoe batho ka lilemo tse likete mme e ntse e le mathata a bophelo bo botle a lefatše lohle.

english_text: Robert Koch discovered the bacterium that causes tuberculosis in 1882.
sesotho_text: Robert Koch o fumane bakteria e bakoang ke tuberculosis ka 1882.

english_text: Mycobacterium tuberculosis is the scientific name of the bacterium that causes TB.
sesotho_text: Mycobacterium tuberculosis ke lebitso la saense la bakteria e bakoang ke TB.

english_text: TB bacteria can survive in the air for several hours in poorly ventilated spaces.
sesotho_text: Bakteria ea TB e ka phela moeeng ka maho a mang libakeng tse se nang moea o lekaneng.

english_text: Not everyone exposed to TB bacteria will develop active disease.
sesotho_text: Ha se batho bohle ba hlahisitsoeng bakteria ea TB ba tla ba le bolwetse bo sebetsang.

english_text: The immune system can contain TB bacteria in an inactive state called latent TB.
sesotho_text: Tšireletso ea 'mele e ka laola bakteria ea TB boemong bo sa sebetseng bo bitsoa TB e patileng.

english_text: Approximately one quarter of the world's population has latent TB infection.
sesotho_text: E ka bang karolo e 'ngoe ho tse nne tsa baahi ba lefatše e na le tšoaetso ea TB e patileng.

english_text: Only about five to ten percent of people with latent TB will develop active disease.
sesotho_text: Batho ba mahlano ho isa ho leshome feela ho pesente ba nang le TB e patileng ba tla ba le bolwetse bo sebetsang.

english_text: World TB Day is observed on March 24th each year to raise awareness about tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Letsatsi la Lefatše la TB le phethoa ka la 24 Hlakubele selemo le selemo ho eketsa tsebo ka tuberculosis.

english_text: The theme of World TB Day reflects the global commitment to ending tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Sehlooho sa Letsatsi la Lefatše la TB se bontša boikarabello ba lefatše lohle ba ho felisa tuberculosis.

english_text: TB affects people of all ages, genders, and socioeconomic backgrounds.
sesotho_text: TB e angoa batho ba lilemo tsohle, bong bohle, le maemo ohle a moruo oa sechaba.

english_text: Men are more likely than women to develop active tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Banna ba na le monyetla o moholo ho feta basali oa ho ba le tuberculosis e sebetsang.

english_text: Young adults aged 15 to 44 bear a disproportionate share of the global TB burden.
sesotho_text: Batho ba baholo ba bacha ba lilemo tse 15 ho isa ho 44 ba rwala karolo e sa lekanang ea morwalo oa TB oa lefatše lohle.

english_text: TB can cause permanent lung damage if not treated promptly and completely.
sesotho_text: TB e ka baka kotsi ea matšoafo e sa foleng haeba e sa phekoluoe ka potlako le ka botlalo.

english_text: Tuberculous meningitis is a life-threatening form of TB that affects the brain.
sesotho_text: TB meningitis ke mofuta oa TB o kotsi ea bophelo o angoa boko.

english_text: Spinal TB, also known as Pott's disease, can cause back pain and spinal deformity.
sesotho_text: TB ea mokokotlo, e tsebahala hape e le bolwetse ba Pott, e ka baka mahloko a mokokotlo le ho senyeha ha mokokotlo.

english_text: Abdominal TB can cause pain, swelling, and digestive problems.
sesotho_text: TB ea mpa e ka baka mahloko, ho ruruha, le mathata a ho kena ha lijo.

english_text: TB of the lymph nodes is the most common form of extrapulmonary tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: TB ea li-lymph node ke mofuta o atileng ka ho fetisisa oa tuberculosis ea kantle ho matšoafo.

english_text: Miliary TB is a severe form where TB bacteria spread through the bloodstream to multiple organs.
sesotho_text: TB ea miliary ke mofuta o matla moo bakteria ea TB e phatlalatsang ka mali ho ea litho tse ngata.

english_text: With proper treatment, the vast majority of people with TB can be completely cured.
sesotho_text: Ka phekolo e nepahetseng, boholo ba batho ba nang le TB ba ka folisoa ka botlalo.

english_text: TB spreads through the air when an infected person coughs, sneezes, or speaks.
sesotho_text: TB e phatlalala ka moea ha motho ea tšoaetsoeng a kohoa, a thimola, kapa a bua.

english_text: You cannot get TB from sharing cups, plates, or cutlery with an infected person.
sesotho_text: Ha u khone ho fumana TB ka ho arolelana likomoki, lisele, kapa lisebelisoa tsa lijo le motho ea tšoaetsoeng.

english_text: You cannot get TB from shaking hands or touching surfaces.
sesotho_text: Ha u khone ho fumana TB ka ho tobana ka matsoho kapa ho ama likaroloana.

english_text: Prolonged close contact with an infectious TB patient increases the risk of transmission.
sesotho_text: Ho kopana haufi nako e telele le mokuloi oa TB ea fetisoang ho eketsa kotsi ea phetisetso.

english_text: TB transmission is more likely indoors than outdoors due to poor air circulation.
sesotho_text: Phetisetso ea TB e atile haholo ka hare ho ntlo ho feta kantle ka lebaka la ho potoloha ha moea ho fokolang.

english_text: A single infectious TB patient can infect 10 to 15 people per year if untreated.
sesotho_text: Mokuloi o le mong oa TB ea fetisoang a ka tšoaetsa batho ba 10 ho isa ho 15 selemo le selemo haeba a sa phekoluoe.

english_text: Singing and shouting can release more TB particles into the air than normal breathing.
sesotho_text: Ho bina le ho howa ho ka lokolla likaroloana tse ngata tsa TB moeeng ho feta ho hema ha kamehla.

english_text: TB is not spread through blood, sexual contact, or insect bites.
sesotho_text: TB ha e phatlalatsoe ka mali, kopano ea thobalano, kapa ho lometsooa ke likhokahane.

english_text: Bovine TB can be transmitted to humans through unpasteurised milk from infected cattle.
sesotho_text: TB ea likhomo e ka fetiseloa ho batho ka lebese le sa phethisoang ho tsoa ho likhomo tse tšoaetsoeng.

english_text: Pasteurising milk kills Mycobacterium bovis and prevents bovine TB transmission.
sesotho_text: Ho phethisa lebese ho bolaea Mycobacterium bovis le ho thibela phetisetso ea TB ea likhomo.

english_text: TB screening involves checking for symptoms, risk factors, and sometimes a chest X-ray.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa ha TB ho kenyelletsa ho hlahloba matšoao, lintlha tsa kotsi, le nako tse itseng X-ray ea sefuba.

english_text: Mass TB screening in high-burden communities helps find undiagnosed cases.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa ha TB ka bongata sechabeng se nang le morwalo o moholo ho thusa ho fumana liketsahalo tse sa fumanoe.

english_text: Active case finding brings TB testing directly to communities rather than waiting for patients to present.
sesotho_text: Ho batla liketsahalo tse sebetsang ho tlisa liteko tsa TB ka kotloloho sechabeng ho feta ho ema bakuli ba tle.

english_text: Mobile X-ray units allow TB screening to reach remote and underserved populations.
sesotho_text: Liqenehelo tsa X-ray tse tsamaelang li lumella ho hlahlobeloa ha TB ho fihlela sechaba se hole le se sa sebelisoeng hantle.

english_text: Systematic TB screening in prisons reduces transmission within correctional facilities.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa ha TB ka mokhoa o reriloeng likotsofatsong ho fokotsa phetisetso likamoreng tsa ho loka.

english_text: Workplace TB screening programmes protect employees and reduce absenteeism.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a ho hlahlobeloa ha TB mafapheng a mosebetsi a sireletsa basebetsi le ho fokotsa ho hloka mosebetsi.

english_text: TB screening at entry points such as borders helps identify cases in migrant populations.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa ha TB meeling ea ho kenela joalo ka meeling ea linaha ho thusa ho tseba liketsahalo ho sechaba sa baahi ba fetang.

english_text: School-based TB screening can identify cases among adolescents and their household contacts.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa ha TB ho thehiloeng sekolong ho ka tseba liketsahalo ho bacha le bakopani ba bona ba lelapa.

english_text: People with symptoms of TB should not wait — seek testing at your nearest clinic today.
sesotho_text: Batho ba nang le matšoao a TB ha ba lokela ho ema — batla liteko klinikhing ea hau e haufi kajeno.

english_text: Free TB testing is available at all public health clinics in South Africa.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa ha TB ha ho lefisoe ho fumaneha likhlinikhing tsohle tsa bophelo bo botle tsa sechaba Afrika Boroa.

english_text: Rifampicin is one of the most important drugs in the treatment of tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Rifampicin ke e 'ngoe ea meriana e bohlokoa ka ho fetisisa ho phekolo ea tuberculosis.

english_text: Isoniazid has been used to treat tuberculosis since the 1950s.
sesotho_text: Isoniazid e sebelisitsoe ho phekola tuberculosis ho tloha lilemong tsa bo-1950.

english_text: Pyrazinamide is most effective during the first two months of TB treatment.
sesotho_text: Pyrazinamide e sebetsa hantle ka ho fetisisa nakong ea likhoeli tse peli tsa pele tsa phekolo ea TB.

english_text: Ethambutol prevents the development of resistance to other TB drugs.
sesotho_text: Ethambutol e thibela ho hlaha ha khakanyo ho meriana e meng ea TB.

english_text: Streptomycin was the first antibiotic found to be effective against tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Streptomycin e ne e le antibiotic ea pele e fumaneoang e sebetsa khahlanong le tuberculosis.

english_text: Second-line TB drugs are used when first-line drugs cannot be used due to resistance or side effects.
sesotho_text: Meriana ea mola oa bobeli ea TB e sebelisoa ha meriana ea mola oa pele e ke ke ea sebelisoa ka lebaka la khakanyo kapa litlamorao.

english_text: Fluoroquinolones such as levofloxacin and moxifloxacin are key drugs for MDR-TB treatment.
sesotho_text: Li-fluoroquinolone joalo ka levofloxacin le moxifloxacin ke meriana ea bohlokoa bakeng sa phekolo ea MDR-TB.

english_text: Clofazimine is used in combination regimens for drug-resistant tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Clofazimine e sebelisoa mananeo a kopano bakeng sa tuberculosis e khakanyeng meriana.

english_text: Linezolid is an effective but potentially toxic drug used in highly resistant TB regimens.
sesotho_text: Linezolid ke moriana o sebetsang empa o ka kotsi o sebelisoa mananeo a TB e khakanyeng haholo.

english_text: Pretomanid is a newer TB drug approved for use in combination with bedaquiline and linezolid.
sesotho_text: Pretomanid ke moriana o mocha oa TB o amohetsoeng ho sebelisoa kopanong le bedaquiline le linezolid.

english_text: Sputum culture is the gold standard for confirming a TB diagnosis.
sesotho_text: Culture ea mathe ke sesupo sa tšimong sa ho netefatsa tlhahlobo ea TB.

english_text: TB cultures can take up to eight weeks to grow in a laboratory.
sesotho_text: Li-culture tsa TB li ka nka ho fihla libeke tse robeli ho hola laboratoreng.

english_text: Liquid culture media such as MGIT give faster results than solid media.
sesotho_text: Mecha ea culture ea metsi joalo ka MGIT e fana ka liphetho tse potlakileng ho feta mecha e thata.

english_text: Line probe assays can rapidly detect resistance to isoniazid and rifampicin.
sesotho_text: Li-assay tsa line probe li ka fumana kapele khakanyo ea isoniazid le rifampicin.

english_text: Whole genome sequencing provides the most detailed picture of TB drug resistance.
sesotho_text: Ho latelana ha genome yohle ho fana ka setšoantšo se pharalletseng ka ho fetisisa sa khakanyo ea meriana ea TB.

english_text: Urine lipoarabinomannan testing helps diagnose TB in people living with advanced HIV.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha lipoarabinomannan ea moroto ho thusa ho fumana TB ho batho ba phelang le HIV e tsoelang pele.

english_text: Stool-based TB testing is being developed for children who cannot produce sputum.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha TB ho thehiloeng holim'a manyolo ho ntšoa bakeng sa bana ba ke ke ba hlahisa mathe.

english_text: Artificial intelligence tools are being developed to read chest X-rays for TB screening.
sesotho_text: Lisebelisoa tsa kelello ea maiketsetso li ntšoa ho bala li-X-ray tsa sefuba bakeng sa ho hlahlobeloa ha TB.

english_text: Point-of-care TB diagnostics bring testing closer to patients in remote settings.
sesotho_text: Litlhahlobo tsa TB tsa sebaka sa tlhokomelo li tlisa liteko haufi le bakuli libakeng tse hole.

english_text: Rapid TB diagnostics reduce the time between symptom onset and treatment start.
sesotho_text: Litlhahlobo tsa TB tsa potlako li fokotsa nako lipakeng tsa ho qala ha matšoao le ho qala ha phekolo.

english_text: Kidney disease can affect how TB drugs are processed and may require dose adjustments.
sesotho_text: Bolwetse ba lipitso bo ka angoa hore na meriana ea TB e sebetsoa joang mme bo ka hloka ho fetola li-dose.

english_text: Liver disease complicates TB treatment because most TB drugs are processed by the liver.
sesotho_text: Bolwetse ba sebete bo noa phekolo ea TB hobane meriana e mengata ea TB e sebetsoa ke sebete.

english_text: People with TB and liver disease need close monitoring of liver function tests.
sesotho_text: Batho ba nang le TB le bolwetse ba sebete ba hloka ho hlahlojoa ka hloko ha liteko tsa tšebetso ea sebete.

english_text: Malnutrition impairs the immune response and increases the risk of TB treatment failure.
sesotho_text: Ho hloka phepo ho khathatsa karabelo ea tšireletso ea 'mele le ho eketsa kotsi ea ho hloleha ha phekolo ea TB.

english_text: Anaemia is common in TB patients and should be assessed and treated.
sesotho_text: Anaemia e atile ho bakuli ba TB mme e lokela ho hlahlojoa le ho phekoluoa.

english_text: TB can worsen blood sugar control in people with diabetes.
sesotho_text: TB e ka mpe taolo ea tsoekere ea mali ho batho ba nang le tsoekere.

english_text: People with TB and diabetes should monitor their blood sugar more frequently.
sesotho_text: Batho ba nang le TB le tsoekere ba lokela ho hlahloja tsoekere ea bona ea mali hangata haholo.

english_text: Steroid therapy is recommended for TB meningitis and pericarditis.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea steroid e khothalletsoa bakeng sa TB meningitis le pericarditis.

english_text: TB can cause pleural effusion, a build-up of fluid around the lungs.
sesotho_text: TB e ka baka pleural effusion, ho bokana ha metsi haufi le matšoafo.

english_text: TB pericarditis affects the sac surrounding the heart and requires prompt treatment.
sesotho_text: TB pericarditis e angoa saka e potileng pelo mme e hloka phekolo ea potlako.

english_text: Every person with TB has the right to dignified, respectful, and confidential care.
sesotho_text: Motho e mong le e mong ea nang le TB o na le tokelo ea tlhokomelo e nang le seriti, hlompho, le sephiri.

english_text: TB patients have the right to be informed about their diagnosis and treatment options.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba TB ba na le tokelo ea ho tsebisoa ka tlhahlobo ea bona le likhetho tsa phekolo.

english_text: Employers cannot legally dismiss an employee solely because they have tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Bafani ba mosebetsi ha ba khone ho leleka mosebetsi ka molao ka lebaka la hore a na le tuberculosis feela.

english_text: TB patients who cannot work during treatment may be eligible for social grants.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba TB ba ke ke ba sebetsa nakong ea phekolo ba ka ba le tokelo ea lithuso tsa sechaba.

english_text: Confidentiality of TB diagnosis must be maintained by all healthcare providers.
sesotho_text: Sephiri sa tlhahlobo ea TB se lokela ho bolokoa ke bafani bohle ba tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Patients have the right to refuse treatment, but the consequences should be clearly explained.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba na le tokelo ea ho hana phekolo, empa litlamorao li lokela ho hlalossoa ka boqaqo.

english_text: Children with TB have the right to continue their education during treatment.
sesotho_text: Bana ba nang le TB ba na le tokelo ea ho tsoela pele thuto ea bona nakong ea phekolo.

english_text: TB patients should be treated with compassion and without judgment.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba TB ba lokela ho phekoluoa ka kutloisiso le ntle le ho ahlola.

english_text: Involving patients in decisions about their care improves treatment adherence.
sesotho_text: Ho kenyelletsa bakuli liqetong mabapi le tlhokomelo ea bona ho ntlafatsa ho latela phekolo.

english_text: Patient support groups provide a safe space for TB patients to share their experiences.
sesotho_text: Lihlopha tsa tshehetso ea bakuli li fana ka sebaka se bolokehileng bakeng sa bakuli ba TB ho arolelana maiphihlelo a bona.

english_text: New TB vaccines are currently being tested in clinical trials around the world.
sesotho_text: Liente tse ncha tsa TB li sa ntse li lekoa lihlahlobong tsa kliniki lefatšeng lohle joale.

english_text: The M72 candidate vaccine showed promising results in a Phase 2b clinical trial.
sesotho_text: Ente ea M72 e bontšitse liphetho tse tšepehang tlhahlobong ea kliniki ea Phase 2b.

english_text: Shorter TB treatment regimens would improve adherence and reduce the burden on patients.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a khutšoanyane a phekolo ea TB a ka ntlafatsa ho latela le ho fokotsa morwalo ho bakuli.

english_text: The STREAM trial evaluated shorter regimens for multidrug-resistant tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea STREAM e ile ea lekola mananeo a khutšoanyane bakeng sa tuberculosis e khakanyeng meriana e mengata.

english_text: Host-directed therapies aim to boost the immune response against TB bacteria.
sesotho_text: Diphekolo tse lebisitsoeng ho motho e ikemiseditse ho matlafatsa karabelo ea tšireletso ea 'mele khahlanong le bakteria ea TB.

english_text: Repurposed drugs from other disease areas are being tested for TB treatment.
sesotho_text: Meriana e fetohileng morero ho tsoa libakeng tse ling tsa bolwetse e lekoa bakeng sa phekolo ea TB.

english_text: TB biomarkers in blood could help predict who will develop active disease.
sesotho_text: Li-biomarker tsa TB maline li ka thusa ho bolela pele hore na ke mang ea tla ba le bolwetse bo sebetsang.

english_text: Improved TB diagnostics are needed to detect all forms of the disease accurately.
sesotho_text: Litlhahlobo tse ntlafetse tsa TB li hlokeha ho fumana mefuta yohle ea bolwetse ka nepo.

english_text: Community engagement in TB research ensures studies are relevant to affected populations.
sesotho_text: Ho kenyelletsa sechaba lipatlisisong tsa TB ho netefatsa hore lipatlisiso li amahanngoa le sechaba se angoa.

english_text: Open access to TB research data accelerates the development of new tools and treatments.
sesotho_text: Phihlello e bulehileng ho data ea lipatlisiso tsa TB e potlakisa ntlafatso ea lisebelisoa le diphekolo tse ncha.

english_text: The treatment success rate for drug-sensitive TB in South Africa has been improving.
sesotho_text: Khato ea katleho ea phekolo bakeng sa TB e amehang ke meriana Afrika Boroa e ntse e ntlafala.

english_text: TB programme data should be reviewed regularly to identify gaps and improve services.
sesotho_text: Data ea lenaneo la TB e lokela ho hlahlojoa ka mehla ho tseba maqeba le ho ntlafatsa litshebeletso.

english_text: Supervision and mentoring of healthcare workers improves TB programme quality.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahloja le ho ruta basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle ho ntlafatsa boleng ba lenaneo la TB.

english_text: Integrated TB and primary healthcare services reduce patient travel and improve access.
sesotho_text: Litshebeletso tse kopaneng tsa TB le tsa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle ea motheo li fokotsa ho tsamaea ha bakuli le ho ntlafatsa phihlello.

english_text: Decentralised TB services bring diagnosis and treatment closer to patients' homes.
sesotho_text: Litshebeletso tsa TB tse abeloang li tlisa tlhahlobo le phekolo haufi le malapa a bakuli.

english_text: Adequate drug supply management prevents TB medicine stockouts.
sesotho_text: Taolo e lekaneng ea phano ea meriana e thibela ho fela ha meriana ea TB.

english_text: Laboratory quality assurance ensures accurate and reliable TB test results.
sesotho_text: Netefatso ea boleng ba laboratori e netefatsa liphetho tsa liteko tsa TB tse nepahetseng le tse tšepahalang.

english_text: TB programme reviews help identify best practices that can be scaled up nationally.
sesotho_text: Litlhahlobo tsa lenaneo la TB li thusa ho tseba mekhoa e metle e ka atolosoang naheng yohle.

english_text: Civil society organisations play a vital role in TB advocacy and community mobilisation.
sesotho_text: Mekhatlo ea sechaba sa baahi e bua karolo ea bohlokoa ho boipiletso ba TB le ho matlafatsa sechaba.

english_text: Multisectoral action involving health, education, and social welfare is needed to end TB.
sesotho_text: Meketso ea likarolo tse ngata e kenyelletsa bophelo bo botle, thuto, le tšireletso ea sechaba e hlokeha ho felisa TB.

english_text: Know the symptoms of TB — cough, fever, night sweats, and weight loss — and seek care early.
sesotho_text: Tseba matšoao a TB — ho kohoa, feberu, molapo oa bosiu, le ho lahleheloa ke boima — mme batla tlhokomelo kapele.

english_text: TB is curable — do not give up on your treatment.
sesotho_text: TB e ka folisoa — u se ke ua tlohela phekolo ea hau.

english_text: Talking openly about TB in your community helps reduce fear and stigma.
sesotho_text: Ho bua ka bokhutšoanyane ka TB sechabeng sa hau ho thusa ho fokotsa tšabo le kekello.

english_text: Share TB information with your family and neighbours to protect your community.
sesotho_text: Arolelana tsebo ea TB le lelapa la hau le baahisane ho sireletsa sechaba sa hau.

english_text: TB affects everyone — rich and poor, young and old.
sesotho_text: TB e angoa bohle — bafumi le bafutsana, bacha le ba baholo.

english_text: Together we can end tuberculosis by testing early, treating completely, and supporting each other.
sesotho_text: Hammoho re ka felisa tuberculosis ka ho lekoa kapele, ho phekola ka botlalo, le ho tshehetsa e mong le e mong.

english_text: If you have been coughing for more than two weeks, please visit your nearest clinic.
sesotho_text: Haeba u kohile nako e fetang libeke tse peli, ka kopo etela kliniki ea hau e haufi.

english_text: TB treatment is free, effective, and available near you.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea TB ha e lefisoe, e sebetsa, mme e fumaneha haufi le hau.

english_text: You are not alone — healthcare workers and community supporters are here to help you.
sesotho_text: Ha u mong — basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle le batshehetsi ba sechaba ba le mona ho u thusa.

english_text: Completing your TB treatment protects not only you but also your family and community.
sesotho_text: Ho phetela phekolo ea TB ea hau ho sireletsa eseng wena feela empa le lelapa la hau le sechaba.

english_text: Primary TB infection occurs when a person is first exposed to Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Tšoaetso ea pele ea TB e etsahala ha motho a hlahisoa Mycobacterium tuberculosis lekhetlo la pele.

english_text: Post-primary TB, also called reactivation TB, occurs when latent infection becomes active.
sesotho_text: TB ea ka mor'a ea pele, e bitsoa hape TB ea ho vuseletsa, e etsahala ha tšoaetso e patileng e sebetsa.

english_text: TB can reactivate decades after the initial infection.
sesotho_text: TB e ka vuseletsa lilemo tse mashome ka mor'a tšoaetso ea pele.

english_text: Immunosuppressive medications such as TNF inhibitors increase the risk of TB reactivation.
sesotho_text: Meriana ea ho laola tšireletso ea 'mele joalo ka li-inhibitor tsa TNF e eketsa kotsi ea ho vuseletsa ha TB.

english_text: Organ transplant recipients are at increased risk of TB due to immunosuppressive therapy.
sesotho_text: Batho ba fumanang litho tse fetisitsoeng ba leng kotsing e eketsehileng ea TB ka lebaka la phekolo ea ho laola tšireletso ea 'mele.

english_text: TB can cause cavities in the lungs that are visible on chest X-ray.
sesotho_text: TB e ka baka likhoba matšoafong tse bonahalang ho X-ray ea sefuba.

english_text: Calcified lymph nodes on chest X-ray may indicate previous TB infection that has healed.
sesotho_text: Li-lymph node tse nang le calcium ho X-ray ea sefuba li ka bontša tšoaetso ea TB ea pele e folileng.

english_text: Bronchiectasis can be a long-term complication of severe pulmonary tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Bronchiectasis e ka ba bothata ba nako e telele ba tuberculosis e matla ea matšoafo.

english_text: TB can cause scarring of the lungs that leads to chronic respiratory problems.
sesotho_text: TB e ka baka ho phatloha ha matšoafo ho lebisang ho mathata a ho hema a nako e telele.

english_text: Early treatment of TB prevents permanent lung damage and improves long-term health outcomes.

english_text: TB bacteria have a waxy cell wall that makes them resistant to many common antibiotics.

english_text: The slow growth rate of TB bacteria is one reason why treatment takes several months.

english_text: TB bacteria can remain dormant in the body for years before becoming active.

english_text: A weakened immune system is the most common trigger for latent TB to become active.

english_text: Granulomas are small clusters of immune cells that form around TB bacteria to contain them.

english_text: When granulomas break down, TB bacteria can escape and cause active disease.

english_text: TB bacteria can develop resistance when patients take irregular or incomplete doses.

english_text: TB lymphadenitis presents as painless swollen lymph nodes that may discharge pus.

english_text: Renal TB can cause blood in the urine, flank pain, and frequent urination.

english_text: TB of the adrenal glands can cause Addison's disease and adrenal insufficiency.

english_text: Ocular TB can affect any part of the eye and may cause vision loss if untreated.

english_text: Cutaneous TB presents as skin lesions and is a rare form of extrapulmonary disease.

english_text: TB peritonitis causes abdominal pain, swelling, and fever due to infection of the abdominal lining.

sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe ka melemo ea ho ema bonyane lilomo tse peli lipakeng tsa likhutsana.

english_text: I was told that family planning supports women's empowerment.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore ho rererela lelapa ho tshehetsa matla a basali.

english_text: I was told that men should also be involved in family planning decisions.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore le banna ba lokela ho kenyeletsoa liqetong tsa ho rererela lelapa.

english_text: I was advised to discuss family planning with my partner.
sesotho_text: Ke keletsoeng ho buisana le molekane oa ka ka ho rererela lelapa.

english_text: I was told that family planning is not only for women.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore ho rererela lelapa ha se bakeng sa basali feela.

sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore litšebeletso tsa ho rererela lelapa li fumaneha likiliniking tsohle tsa sechaba.

sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe ho khutla klinikeng haeba ke ikutloa mathata afe kafe.

sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe ho sebelisa thibelo ea ho mitsa ea kamehla ka mor'a ho nka thibelo ea ho mitsa ea tšohanyetso.

english_text: It is important to understand your medical condition.
sesotho_text: Ho bohlokoa ho utloisisa boemo ba hao ba bongaka.

english_text: Knowing about your illness helps you manage it better.
sesotho_text: Ho tseba ka bolwetse ba hao bo a thusa ho bo laola hantle.

english_text: You have the right to ask your doctor questions about your health.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho botsa ngaka ea hao lipotso ka bophelo ba hao.

english_text: You have the right to receive clear information about your diagnosis.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho amohela tlhahisoleseling e hlakisitsoeng ka tlhahlobo ea hao.

english_text: You have the right to be involved in decisions about your treatment.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho kenyeletsoa liqetong ka phekolo ea hao.

english_text: You have the right to refuse treatment after being fully informed.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho hana phekolo ka mor'a ho tsebisoa ka botlalo.

english_text: You have the right to confidentiality about your health information.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea sephiri ka tlhahisoleseling ea bophelo ba hao.

english_text: Your medical information cannot be shared without your consent.
sesotho_text: Tlhahisoleseling ea hao ea bongaka ha e khone ho aroleloa ntle le tumelo ea hao.

english_text: You have the right to access your own medical records.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho fihlela lirekoto tsa hao tsa bongaka.

english_text: You have the right to a second opinion from another doctor.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho fumana maikutlo a bobeli ho tsoa ngakeng e nngwe.

english_text: It is important to tell your doctor about all your symptoms.
sesotho_text: Ho bohlokoa ho bolella ngaka ea hao matšoao a hao ohle.

english_text: Always tell your doctor about all the medications you are taking.
sesotho_text: Bolella ngaka ea hao kamehla ka meriana yohle eo o e nkang.

english_text: Tell your doctor about any traditional or herbal medicines you use.
sesotho_text: Bolella ngaka ea hao ka meriana efe kafe ea setso kapa ea limela eo o e sebelisang.

english_text: Tell your doctor if you are allergic to any medication.
sesotho_text: Bolella ngaka ea hao haeba o na le allergy ho moriana ofe kafe.

english_text: Always inform the nurse if your condition changes between visits.
sesotho_text: Tsebisa mooki kamehla haeba boemo ba hao bo fetohile lipakeng tsa litsebeliso.

english_text: It is important to attend all your scheduled medical appointments.
sesotho_text: Ho bohlokoa ho tla li-appointment tsohle tsa hao tsa bongaka tse reretseng.

english_text: Missing appointments can delay your treatment and recovery.
sesotho_text: Ho lahlehela li-appointment ho ka lieha phekolo ea hao le ho fola.

english_text: Regular check-ups help detect health problems early.
sesotho_text: Litlhahlobo tsa kamehla li thusa ho fumana mathata a bophelo kapele.

english_text: Early detection of illness leads to better treatment outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho fumana bolwetse kapele ho lebisa liphetho tse ntle tsa phekolo.

english_text: Prevention is better than cure.
sesotho_text: Ho thibela ho feta ho alafa.

english_text: A healthy lifestyle reduces the risk of many diseases.
sesotho_text: Mokhoa oa bophelo o motle o fokotsa kotsi ea mahlwetse a mangata.

english_text: Regular physical activity improves your overall health.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele ea kamehla e ntlafatsa bophelo ba hao ka bophara.

english_text: A balanced diet supports your immune system and recovery.
sesotho_text: Phepo e lekaneng e tshehetsa tšireletso ea 'mele oa hao le ho fola.

english_text: Drinking enough water every day is important for your health.
sesotho_text: Ho noa metsi a lekaneng letsatsi le leng le le leng ho bohlokoa bakeng sa bophelo ba hao.

english_text: Getting enough sleep helps your body heal and stay healthy.
sesotho_text: Ho robala ka lekaneng ho thusa 'mele oa hao ho fola le ho lula o phela hantle.

english_text: Reducing stress improves your mental and physical health.
sesotho_text: Ho fokotsa khatello ea maikutlo ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba hao ba kelello le ba 'mele.

english_text: Avoiding alcohol reduces the risk of liver disease and other conditions.
sesotho_text: Ho hana joala ho fokotsa kotsi ea bolwetse ba sebete le maemo a mang.

english_text: Stopping smoking improves your lung health and overall wellbeing.
sesotho_text: Ho emisa ho tsuba ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba matšoafo a hao le boiketlo ba hao ka bophara.

english_text: Maintaining a healthy weight reduces the risk of chronic diseases.
sesotho_text: Ho boloka boima bo botle bo fokotsa kotsi ea mahlwetse a tsoelang pele.

english_text: Regular hand washing prevents the spread of infections.
sesotho_text: Ho hlatsoa matsoho ka mehla ho thibela ho atatela ha tšoaetso.

english_text: Good hygiene protects you and your family from illness.
sesotho_text: Bohloekileng bo botle bo sireletsa uena le lelapa la hao ho bolwetse.

english_text: Vaccinations protect you from serious and preventable diseases.
sesotho_text: Liente li a sireletsa ho mahlwetse a matla le a thibelehang.

english_text: It is important to keep your vaccinations up to date.
sesotho_text: Ho bohlokoa ho boloka liente tsa hao li ntlafetse.

english_text: Screening tests help detect diseases before symptoms appear.
sesotho_text: Litlhahlobo tsa ho hlahloba li thusa ho fumana mahlwetse pele matšoao a hlaha.

english_text: Regular blood pressure checks can prevent heart disease and stroke.
sesotho_text: Ho lekola khatello ea mali ka mehla ho ka thibela bolwetse ba pelo le stroke.

english_text: Regular blood sugar checks help manage and prevent diabetes.
sesotho_text: Ho lekola tsoekere ea mali ka mehla ho thusa ho laola le ho thibela tsoekere.

english_text: Regular cholesterol checks reduce the risk of heart disease.
sesotho_text: Ho lekola cholesterol ka mehla ho fokotsa kotsi ea bolwetse ba pelo.

english_text: Cancer screening saves lives through early detection.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahloba kankere ho boloka bophelo ka ho fumana kapele.

english_text: Eye examinations help detect vision problems and other conditions.
sesotho_text: Litlhahlobo tsa mahlo li thusa ho fumana mathata a pono le maemo a mang.

english_text: Dental check-ups prevent tooth decay and gum disease.
sesotho_text: Litlhahlobo tsa meno li thibela ho bola ha meno le bolwetse ba meno.

english_text: Mental health is as important as physical health.
sesotho_text: Bophelo ba kelello bo bohlokoa joalo ka bophelo ba 'mele.

english_text: It is important to seek help if you are feeling depressed or anxious.
sesotho_text: Ho bohlokoa ho batla thuso haeba o ikutloa o khutsanyehile kapa o tšohile.

english_text: Talking about your feelings can improve your mental health.
sesotho_text: Ho bua ka maikutlo a hao ho ka ntlafatsa bophelo ba hao ba kelello.

english_text: Support from family and friends is important for recovery.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso ho tsoa lelapeng le baratwi bo bohlokoa bakeng sa ho fola.

english_text: Community support groups can help you manage your condition.
sesotho_text: Lisehlopha tsa tshehetso ea sechaba li ka thusa ho laola boemo ba hao.

english_text: Health education helps you make informed decisions about your health.
sesotho_text: Thuto ea bophelo bo botle e thusa ho etsa liqeto tse tsebisitsoeng ka bophelo ba hao.

english_text: Understanding your medication helps you take it correctly.
sesotho_text: Ho utloisisa moriana oa hao ho thusa ho o nka ka nepo.

english_text: Following your treatment plan improves your health outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho latela leano la phekolo ea hao ho ntlafatsa liphetho tsa bophelo ba hao.

english_text: Completing your full course of treatment prevents drug resistance.
sesotho_text: Ho phetela khoroso yohle ea phekolo ho thibela ho hana ha moriana.

english_text: Never share your medication with other people.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa arolelana moriana oa hao le batho ba bang.

english_text: Never stop your medication without consulting your doctor.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa emisa moriana oa hao ntle le ho buisana le ngaka ea hao.

english_text: Always take your medication at the same time every day.
sesotho_text: Nka moriana oa hao ka nako e tšoanang letsatsi le leng le le leng kamehla.

english_text: Store your medication in a cool dry place away from sunlight.
sesotho_text: Boloka moriana oa hao sebakeng se batang se omileng hole le leseli la letsatsi.

english_text: Keep all medications out of reach of children.
sesotho_text: Boloka meriana yohle hole le bana.

english_text: Check the expiry date of your medication before taking it.
sesotho_text: Hlahloba letsatsi la ho fela ha moriana oa hao pele ho o nka.

english_text: Dispose of expired medication safely and responsibly.
sesotho_text: Lahla moriana o felileng ka polokeho le boikarabello.

english_text: Report any side effects of your medication to the clinic.
sesotho_text: Bua ka litlamorao tse ling tsohle tsa moriana oa hao klinikeng.

english_text: Ask the pharmacist if you are unsure how to take your medication.
sesotho_text: Botsa pharmacist haeba ha o tsebe ho nka moriana oa hao.

english_text: Read the information leaflet that comes with your medication.
sesotho_text: Bala pampiri ea tlhahisoleseling e tlang le moriana oa hao.

english_text: Understanding your treatment empowers you to take control of your health.
sesotho_text: Ho utloisisa phekolo ea hao ho o mpha matla a ho laola bophelo ba hao.

english_text: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least twenty seconds.
sesotho_text: Hlatsoa matsoho a hao ka sesepa le metsi bonyane metsotso e mashome a mabeli.

english_text: Wash your hands before eating and after using the toilet.
sesotho_text: Hlatsoa matsoho a hao pele ho ja le ka mor'a ho sebelisa ntlo ea thokomelo.

english_text: Wash your hands after coughing or sneezing.
sesotho_text: Hlatsoa matsoho a hao ka mor'a ho kohoa kapa ho thiimela.

english_text: Wash your hands after touching animals or animal waste.
sesotho_text: Hlatsoa matsoho a hao ka mor'a ho ama liphoofolo kapa molapo oa tsona.

english_text: Wash your hands after handling raw meat or poultry.
sesotho_text: Hlatsoa matsoho a hao ka mor'a ho sebetsa le nama e hloekileng kapa manong.

english_text: Use an alcohol-based hand sanitiser when soap is not available.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa sanitiser ea matsoho e thehiloeng ho joala ha sesepa se sa fumanehe.

english_text: Cover your mouth and nose when you cough or sneeze.
