sesotho_text: Koahela molomo le nko ha o kohoa kapa o thiimela.

english_text: Use a tissue when you cough or sneeze and dispose of it immediately.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa tissue ha o kohoa kapa o thiimela mme o e lahle hang hang.

english_text: Avoid touching your face with unwashed hands.
sesotho_text: Hana ho ama sefahleho sa hao ka matsoho a sa hlatsoang.

english_text: Avoid sharing personal items such as towels and toothbrushes.
sesotho_text: Hana ho arolelana lintho tsa botho joalo ka lithaole le likolobetso tsa meno.

english_text: Keep your home clean and well ventilated.
sesotho_text: Boloka ntlo ea hao e hloekileng le e nang le moea o lekaneng.

english_text: Open windows to allow fresh air into your home.
sesotho_text: Bula lifensetere ho lumella moea o mocha ho kena ntlong ea hao.

english_text: Clean and disinfect frequently touched surfaces regularly.
sesotho_text: Hlotsa le disinfect meaho e amoang hangata ka mehla.

english_text: Wash your clothes and bedding regularly.
sesotho_text: Hlatsoa liaparo tsa hao le liaparo tsa bolao ka mehla.

english_text: Bathe or shower every day to maintain personal hygiene.
sesotho_text: Khapa kapa shower letsatsi le leng le le leng ho boloka bohloekileng ba botho.

english_text: Brush your teeth at least twice a day.
sesotho_text: Kolobetsa meno a hao bonyane habeli ka letsatsi.

english_text: Use clean and safe drinking water at all times.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa metsi a hloekileng a bolokehileng a ho noa nako tsohle.

english_text: Boil water if you are unsure whether it is safe to drink.
sesotho_text: Besa metsi haeba ha o tsebe haeba a bolokehile ho noa.

english_text: Store drinking water in a clean covered container.
sesotho_text: Boloka metsi a ho noa setsing se hloekileng se koahetseng.

english_text: Wash fruits and vegetables before eating them.
sesotho_text: Hlatsoa lienyane le merogo pele ho li ja.

english_text: Cook meat and poultry thoroughly before eating.
sesotho_text: Phehla nama le manong ka botlalo pele ho ja.

english_text: Avoid eating food that has been left out for more than two hours.
sesotho_text: Hana ho ja lijo tse siileng kantle ho fetang lihora tse peli.

english_text: Refrigerate leftovers promptly to prevent food poisoning.
sesotho_text: Kenya lijo tse setseng frijeng hang hang ho thibela ho hlohlona ha lijo.

english_text: Avoid sharing food or drinks with someone who is sick.
sesotho_text: Hana ho arolelana lijo kapa lino le motho ea kulang.

english_text: Stay at home when you are sick to prevent spreading illness.
sesotho_text: Lula lapeng ha o kula ho thibela ho atatela ha bolwetse.

english_text: Wear a mask if you have a respiratory illness.
sesotho_text: Apara mask haeba o na le bolwetse ba ho hema.

english_text: Dispose of waste properly to prevent the spread of disease.
sesotho_text: Lahla molapo ka nepo ho thibela ho atatela ha bolwetse.

english_text: Use a toilet or latrine and do not defecate in the open.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa ntlo ea thokomelo kapa latrine mme o se ke oa ithokomela kantle.

english_text: Wash your hands after using the toilet or latrine.
sesotho_text: Hlatsoa matsoho a hao ka mor'a ho sebelisa ntlo ea thokomelo kapa latrine.

english_text: Keep your toilet or latrine clean and covered.
sesotho_text: Boloka ntlo ea hao ea thokomelo kapa latrine e hloekileng le e koahetseng.

english_text: Use insect repellent to protect against mosquito bites.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa sesebelisoa sa ho lelekisa likhoasane ho sireletsa ho lomoa ke tsona.

english_text: Sleep under a mosquito net to prevent malaria.
sesotho_text: Robala tlasa nete ea likhoasane ho thibela malaria.

english_text: Wear long sleeves and trousers in areas with many mosquitoes.
sesotho_text: Apara mahalapa a matelele le sekhahla sebakeng se nang le likhoasane tse ngata.

english_text: Remove standing water around your home to prevent mosquito breeding.
sesotho_text: Ntša metsi a emiseng haufi le ntlo ea hao ho thibela ho hola ha likhoasane.

english_text: Wear shoes to protect your feet from soil-transmitted infections.
sesotho_text: Apara lieta ho sireletsa maoto a hao ho tšoaetso tse fetisanang ka mobu.

english_text: Avoid walking barefoot in areas with animal waste.
sesotho_text: Hana ho tsamaea o sa apere lieta sebakeng se nang le molapo oa liphoofolo.

english_text: Protect your skin from cuts and wounds to prevent infection.
sesotho_text: Sireletsa letlalo la hao ho likhato le maqeba ho thibela tšoaetso.

english_text: Clean and cover all wounds immediately to prevent infection.
sesotho_text: Hlotsa le koahela maqeba ohle hang hang ho thibela tšoaetso.

english_text: Seek medical attention for wounds that do not heal.
sesotho_text: Batla tlhokomelo ea bongaka bakeng sa maqeba a sa foleng.

english_text: Avoid contact with the blood or body fluids of other people.
sesotho_text: Hana ho ama mali kapa metsi a 'mele a batho ba bang.

english_text: Use gloves when handling blood or body fluids.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa likhohlo ha o sebetsa le mali kapa metsi a 'mele.

english_text: Dispose of sharp objects safely to prevent needle-stick injuries.
sesotho_text: Lahla lintho tse bohale ka polokeho ho thibela likotsi tsa ho hlabua ke linalete.

english_text: Do not reuse syringes or needles.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa sebelisa hape li-syringe kapa linalete.

english_text: Use condoms consistently to prevent sexually transmitted infections.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa li-condom kamehla ho thibela tšoaetso tse fetisanang ka thobalano.

english_text: Get tested for sexually transmitted infections regularly.
sesotho_text: Hlahlojoa bakeng sa tšoaetso tse fetisanang ka thobalano ka mehla.

english_text: Inform your sexual partner if you have a sexually transmitted infection.
sesotho_text: Tsebisa molekane oa hao oa thobalano haeba o na le tšoaetso e fetisanang ka thobalano.

english_text: Seek treatment for sexually transmitted infections immediately.
sesotho_text: Batla phekolo bakeng sa tšoaetso tse fetisanang ka thobalano hang hang.

english_text: Avoid sexual contact until your sexually transmitted infection is treated.
sesotho_text: Hana ho kopana ka thobalano ho fihlela tšoaetso ea hao e fetisanang ka thobalano e alafoa.

english_text: Reduce your number of sexual partners to lower your risk of infection.
sesotho_text: Fokotsa palo ea baratwi ba hao ba thobalano ho fokotsa kotsi ea tšoaetso.

english_text: Discuss your sexual health openly with your healthcare provider.
sesotho_text: Buisana ka bophelo ba hao ba thobalano ka bolokolohi le mofani oa hao oa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Do not stigmatise people living with infectious diseases.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa nyatsa batho ba phelang le mahlwetse a tšoaetsang.

english_text: Treat people with infectious diseases with dignity and respect.
sesotho_text: Phethela batho ba nang le mahlwetse a tšoaetsang ka tlotlo le hlompho.

english_text: Support family members and friends who are living with illness.
sesotho_text: Tshehetsa maloko a lelapa le metsoalle ba phelang le bolwetse.

english_text: Encourage people in your community to seek medical care early.
sesotho_text: Khothaletsa batho sechababeng sa hao ho batla tlhokomelo ea bongaka kapele.

english_text: Share health information with your family and community.
sesotho_text: Arolelana tlhahisoleseling ea bophelo bo botle le lelapa la hao le sechaba.

english_text: Attend community health education sessions at your local clinic.
sesotho_text: Tla li-session tsa thuto ea bophelo bo botle ea sechaba klinikeng ea hao ea haufi.

english_text: Ask your community health worker for health advice and support.
sesotho_text: Botsa mosebetsi oa bophelo ba sechaba oa hao keletso ea bophelo le tshehetso.

english_text: Report disease outbreaks in your community to the health authorities.
sesotho_text: Bua ka ho atatela ha mahlwetse sechababeng sa hao ho ba ba nang le matla a bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Follow public health guidelines during disease outbreaks.
sesotho_text: Latela litaelo tsa bophelo ba sechaba nakong ea ho atatela ha mahlwetse.

english_text: Cooperate with health workers during community health campaigns.
sesotho_text: Sebetsa hammoho le basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle nakong ea likhampheini tsa bophelo ba sechaba.

english_text: Eating a balanced diet is essential for good health.
sesotho_text: Ho ja phepo e lekaneng ho bohlokoa bakeng sa bophelo bo botle.

english_text: A balanced diet includes foods from all the major food groups.
sesotho_text: Phepo e lekaneng e kenyelletsa lijo ho tsoa lihlopheng tsohle tse kholo tsa lijo.

english_text: Eat plenty of fruits and vegetables every day.
sesotho_text: Ja lienyane le merogo e ngata letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: Choose whole grains over refined grains for better nutrition.
sesotho_text: Khetha lijo tsa mabele a phethahetseng ho e-na le a hlophisitsoeng bakeng sa phepo e ntle.

english_text: Include protein-rich foods such as meat, fish, eggs, and legumes.
sesotho_text: Kenyelletsa lijo tse nang le protein e ngata joalo ka nama, tlhapi, mae, le linaoa.

english_text: Eat dairy products or calcium-rich foods for strong bones.
sesotho_text: Ja lihlahisoa tsa lebese kapa lijo tse nang le calcium e ngata bakeng sa marapo a matla.

english_text: Limit your intake of foods high in sugar and salt.
sesotho_text: Fokotsa ho nka lijo tse nang le tsoekere e ngata le letsoai.

english_text: Avoid processed and fast foods as much as possible.
sesotho_text: Hana lijo tse entsoeng ka mokhoa oa indasteri le lijo tsa potlako kamoo ho khonehang.

english_text: Cook with healthy oils such as olive oil or sunflower oil.
sesotho_text: Phehla ka oli e ntle joalo ka oli ea olive kapa ea sunflower.

english_text: Avoid frying food and choose grilling or steaming instead.
sesotho_text: Hana ho frae lijo mme u khethe ho grilla kapa ho phehla ka moea.

english_text: Eat smaller portions more frequently throughout the day.
sesotho_text: Ja likarolo tse nyenyane hangata letsatsing la hao.

english_text: Do not skip meals especially breakfast.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa tlohela lijo haholo-holo sarapotso.

english_text: Drink at least eight glasses of water every day.
sesotho_text: Noa bonyane ligilase tse robeli tsa metsi letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: Avoid sugary drinks such as cool drinks and fruit juices.
sesotho_text: Hana lino tse nang le tsoekere joalo ka li-cool drink le lijuisi tsa lienyane.

english_text: Limit your intake of caffeinated drinks such as tea and coffee.
sesotho_text: Fokotsa ho nka lino tse nang le caffeine joalo ka tee le kofi.

english_text: Avoid alcohol or drink only in moderation.
sesotho_text: Hana joala kapa noa feela ka tekanyo.

english_text: Read food labels to understand what you are eating.
sesotho_text: Bala lilebele tsa lijo ho utloisisa se o se jang.

english_text: Choose foods that are low in saturated fat and cholesterol.
sesotho_text: Khetha lijo tse tlase ho mafura a saturated le cholesterol.

english_text: Increase your fibre intake by eating more vegetables and whole grains.
sesotho_text: Eketsa ho nka fibre ka ho ja merogo e mengata le mabele a phethahetseng.

english_text: Fibre helps prevent constipation and reduces the risk of bowel cancer.
sesotho_text: Fibre e thusa ho thibela ho tšoaroa le ho fokotsa kotsi ea kankere ea mala.

english_text: Iron-rich foods such as red meat and spinach prevent anaemia.
sesotho_text: Lijo tse nang le tšepe joalo ka nama e khubelu le spinach li thibela anaemia.

english_text: Vitamin C helps your body absorb iron from plant-based foods.
sesotho_text: Vitamin C e thusa 'mele oa hao ho nka tšepe ho tsoa lijong tse thehiloeng ho limela.

english_text: Folate-rich foods such as leafy greens are important during pregnancy.
sesotho_text: Lijo tse nang le folate joalo ka merogo e tala e bohlokoa nakong ea ho mitsa.

english_text: Vitamin D from sunlight and food is important for bone health.
sesotho_text: Vitamin D ho tsoa leseling la letsatsi le lijong e bohlokoa bakeng sa bophelo ba marapo.

english_text: Calcium-rich foods such as milk and cheese strengthen your bones.
sesotho_text: Lijo tse nang le calcium joalo ka lebese le chisi li matlafatsa marapo a hao.

english_text: Zinc-rich foods support your immune system and wound healing.
sesotho_text: Lijo tse nang le zinc li tshehetsa tšireletso ea 'mele oa hao le ho fola ha maqeba.

english_text: Omega-3 fatty acids from fish support heart and brain health.
sesotho_text: Li-omega-3 fatty acid ho tsoa tlhaping li tshehetsa bophelo ba pelo le boko.

english_text: Antioxidant-rich foods protect your body from cell damage.
sesotho_text: Lijo tse nang le li-antioxidant li sireletsa 'mele oa hao ho kotsi ea lisele.

english_text: A healthy diet supports your immune system and helps fight infection.
sesotho_text: Phepo e ntle e tshehetsa tšireletso ea 'mele oa hao le ho thusa ho loa le tšoaetso.

english_text: Good nutrition speeds up recovery from illness.
sesotho_text: Phepo e ntle e potlakisa ho fola ho tsoa bolwetseng.

english_text: Malnutrition weakens the immune system and increases the risk of infection.
sesotho_text: Ho hloka phepo ho fokotsa tšireletso ea 'mele le ho eketsa kotsi ea tšoaetso.

english_text: Obesity increases the risk of diabetes, heart disease, and cancer.
sesotho_text: Ho ba boima bo feteletseng ho eketsa kotsi ea tsoekere, bolwetse ba pelo, le kankere.

english_text: Physical activity combined with a healthy diet helps maintain a healthy weight.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele hammoho le phepo e ntle e thusa ho boloka boima bo botle.

english_text: Avoid eating late at night to support healthy digestion.
sesotho_text: Hana ho ja bosiu bo le bebe ho tshehetsa ho phehla ha lijo hantle.

english_text: Chew your food slowly and thoroughly for better digestion.
sesotho_text: Hlafuna lijo tsa hao butle le ka botlalo bakeng sa ho phehla hantle.

english_text: Eat in a calm environment without distractions.
sesotho_text: Ja sebakeng se khutsolang ntle le ho tsieleha.

english_text: Plan your meals in advance to make healthier food choices.
sesotho_text: Rererela lijo tsa hao pele ho etsa likhetho tse ntle tsa lijo.

english_text: Prepare meals at home to control the ingredients and portions.
sesotho_text: Lokisa lijo lapeng ho laola lintho tse sebelisoang le likarolo.

english_text: Involve your family in preparing healthy meals.
sesotho_text: Kenyelletsa lelapa la hao ho lokisa lijo tse ntle.

english_text: Teach your children about healthy eating from an early age.
sesotho_text: Ruta bana ba hao ka ho ja hantle ho tloha bonyenyane.

english_text: Grow your own vegetables if possible to improve food security.
sesotho_text: Hola merogo ea hao haeba ho khonehile ho ntlafatsa ts'ireletso ea lijo.

english_text: Access community food programmes if you are struggling to afford food.
sesotho_text: Fihlela mananeo a lijo a sechaba haeba o na le bothata ba ho lefella lijo.

english_text: Ask the clinic dietitian for personalised nutrition advice.
sesotho_text: Botsa dietitian ea kliniki keletso ea phepo e hlokehalang bakeng sa hao.

english_text: Follow the nutrition plan given to you by your healthcare provider.
sesotho_text: Latela leano la phepo le fanoeng ho uena ke mofani oa hao oa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Inform your doctor if you are struggling to afford nutritious food.
sesotho_text: Tsebisa ngaka ea hao haeba o na le bothata ba ho lefella lijo tse nang le phepo.

english_text: Social grants and food assistance programmes are available to those in need.
sesotho_text: Liphallelo tsa sechaba le mananeo a thuso ea lijo li fumaneha ho ba ba hlokang.

english_text: Good nutrition is a right and not a privilege.
sesotho_text: Phepo e ntle ke tokelo e seng molemo o khethehileng.

english_text: A well-nourished body heals faster and fights disease better.
sesotho_text: Mele o nang le phepo e lekaneng o fola kapele mme o loa le bolwetse hantle.

english_text: Nutrition and medication work together to improve your health.
sesotho_text: Phepo le moriana li sebetsa hammoho ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba hao.

english_text: Do not take your medication on an empty stomach unless instructed.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa nka moriana oa hao maleng a se nang letho ntle le ho laeloa.

english_text: Some medications must be taken with food to reduce side effects.
sesotho_text: Meriana e meng e tlameha ho nkoa le lijo ho fokotsa litlamorao.

english_text: Some medications must be taken on an empty stomach to be absorbed properly.
sesotho_text: Meriana e meng e tlameha ho nkoa maleng a se nang letho ho nkoa hantle.

english_text: Ask your pharmacist about the best way to take your medication.
sesotho_text: Botsa pharmacist ea hao ka mokhoa o motle ka ho fetisisa oa ho nka moriana oa hao.

english_text: Certain foods can interact with your medication and reduce its effectiveness.
sesotho_text: Lijo tse ling li ka kopana le moriana oa hao mme li fokotse bokgoni ba ona.

english_text: Grapefruit can interact with some medications and should be avoided.
sesotho_text: Grapefruit e ka kopana le meriana e meng mme e lokela ho hanoa.

english_text: Dairy products can reduce the absorption of some antibiotics.
sesotho_text: Lihlahisoa tsa lebese li ka fokotsa ho nkoa ha li-antibiotic tse ling.

english_text: High-fat meals can affect how some medications are absorbed.
sesotho_text: Lijo tse nang le mafura a mangata li ka angoa ho nkoa ha meriana e meng.

english_text: Alcohol interacts with many medications and should be avoided.
sesotho_text: Joala le kopana le meriana e mengata mme le lokela ho hanoa.

english_text: Always inform your doctor about your diet when discussing your medication.
sesotho_text: Tsebisa ngaka ea hao kamehla ka phepo ea hao ha o buisana ka moriana oa hao.

english_text: A healthy diet is one of the most powerful tools for managing your health.
sesotho_text: Phepo e ntle ke e le ngoe ea lisebelisoa tse matla ka ho fetisisa tsa ho laola bophelo ba hao.

english_text: Regular physical activity improves your heart health.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele ea kamehla e ntlafatsa bophelo ba pelo ea hao.

english_text: Exercise helps control blood sugar levels in people with diabetes.
sesotho_text: Ho itlama ho thusa ho laola maemo a tsoekere ea mali ho batho ba nang le tsoekere.

english_text: Physical activity helps lower high blood pressure.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele e thusa ho fokotsa khatello e phahameng ea mali.

english_text: Exercise helps maintain a healthy weight.
sesotho_text: Ho itlama ho thusa ho boloka boima bo botle.

english_text: Regular physical activity improves your mental health and mood.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele ea kamehla e ntlafatsa bophelo ba hao ba kelello le maikutlo.

english_text: Exercise reduces the risk of depression and anxiety.
sesotho_text: Ho itlama ho fokotsa kotsi ea khutsanyetso le ho tšoha.

english_text: Physical activity improves your sleep quality.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele e ntlafatsa boleng ba boroko ba hao.

english_text: Exercise strengthens your muscles and bones.
sesotho_text: Ho itlama ho matlafatsa mochine le marapo a hao.

english_text: Regular physical activity reduces the risk of falls in older adults.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele ea kamehla e fokotsa kotsi ea ho wa ho batho ba baholo.

english_text: Exercise improves your energy levels and reduces fatigue.
sesotho_text: Ho itlama ho ntlafatsa maemo a matla a hao le ho fokotsa ho lapala.

english_text: Physical activity boosts your immune system.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele e matlafatsa tšireletso ea 'mele oa hao.

english_text: Exercise reduces the risk of heart disease and stroke.
sesotho_text: Ho itlama ho fokotsa kotsi ea bolwetse ba pelo le stroke.

english_text: Regular physical activity reduces the risk of certain cancers.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele ea kamehla e fokotsa kotsi ea kankere tse ling.

english_text: Exercise improves your flexibility and balance.
sesotho_text: Ho itlama ho ntlafatsa ho otlolla le tekanyo ea hao.

english_text: Physical activity helps manage chronic pain.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele e thusa ho laola mahloko a tsoelang pele.

english_text: Aim for at least thirty minutes of moderate exercise most days.
sesotho_text: Leka bonyane metsotso e mashome a mararo ea ho itlama ka tekanyo matsatsi a mangata.

english_text: Walking is a simple and effective form of physical activity.
sesotho_text: Ho tsamaea ke mokhoa o bonolo le o sebetsang oa mesebetsi ea 'mele.

english_text: Cycling, swimming, and dancing are all good forms of exercise.
sesotho_text: Ho palama baesekele, ho nea le ho bina ke mekhoa e ntle ea ho itlama.

english_text: Household chores and gardening also count as physical activity.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea lapeng le ho lema le yona e bala joalo ka mesebetsi ea 'mele.

english_text: Start slowly and gradually increase the intensity of your exercise.
sesotho_text: Qala butle mme o eketse bohale ba ho itlama ha hao butle butle.

english_text: Warm up before exercising and cool down afterwards.
sesotho_text: Itokisetse pele ho itlama mme o khutse ka mor'a moo.

english_text: Drink water before, during, and after exercise.
sesotho_text: Noa metsi pele, nakong, le ka mor'a ho itlama.

english_text: Wear comfortable and supportive footwear when exercising.
sesotho_text: Apara lieta tse lokelang le tse tshehetsoang ha o itlama.

english_text: Avoid exercising in extreme heat to prevent heat exhaustion.
sesotho_text: Hana ho itlama mochesong o feteletseng ho thibela ho lapala ha mocheso.

english_text: Listen to your body and rest if you feel pain during exercise.
sesotho_text: Mamela 'mele oa hao mme o khutse haeba o ikutloa mahloko nakong ea ho itlama.

english_text: Consult your doctor before starting a new exercise programme.
sesotho_text: Buisana le ngaka ea hao pele ho qala lenaneo le lecha la ho itlama.

english_text: Exercise is safe and beneficial for most people with chronic conditions.
sesotho_text: Ho itlama ho bolokehile mme ho na le molemo ho batho ba bangata ba nang le maemo a tsoelang pele.

english_text: Physical activity is recommended for people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele e khothaletsoa bakeng sa batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Exercise helps people with TB regain their strength during recovery.
sesotho_text: Ho itlama ho thusa batho ba nang le TB ho khutlisa matla a bona nakong ea ho fola.

english_text: Physical activity supports mental health and reduces stress.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele e tshehetsa bophelo ba kelello le ho fokotsa khatello ea maikutlo.

english_text: Reduce the amount of time you spend sitting each day.
sesotho_text: Fokotsa nako eo o e sebelisang o lula letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: Take short breaks to stand and move during long periods of sitting.
sesotho_text: Nka maphomelo a makhutšoanyane ho ema le ho tsamaea nakong e telele ea ho lula.

english_text: Encourage your children to be physically active every day.
sesotho_text: Khothaletsa bana ba hao ho ba le mesebetsi ea 'mele letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: Limit screen time and encourage outdoor play for children.
sesotho_text: Fokotsa nako ea ho sheba skrine mme u khothaletse ho bapala kantle bakeng sa bana.

english_text: Physical activity is important at every stage of life.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele e bohlokoa molapo o mong le o mong oa bophelo.

english_text: Older adults should include balance and strength exercises.
sesotho_text: Batho ba baholo ba lokela ho kenyelletsa maitlamo a tekanyo le a matla.

english_text: Pregnant women can continue moderate exercise with medical advice.
sesotho_text: Basali ba mitsoeng ba ka tsoela pele ho itlama ka tekanyo ka keletso ea bongaka.

english_text: Physical activity after delivery supports postnatal recovery.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele ka mor'a ho belega e tshehetsa ho fola ha ka mor'a ho belega.

english_text: Exercise with a friend or family member for motivation and safety.
sesotho_text: Itlame le motsoalle kapa leloko la lelapa bakeng sa khothaletso le polokeho.

english_text: Join a community exercise group or sports club.
sesotho_text: Kenela sehlopha sa ho itlama sa sechaba kapa klapo ea lipapali.

english_text: Set realistic exercise goals and celebrate your progress.
sesotho_text: Beha maano a ho itlama a khonehang mme u keteke tsoelo-pele ea hao.

english_text: Physical activity does not have to be expensive or complicated.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele ha e hloke ho ba tšohle kapa ho raraana.

english_text: Consistency is more important than intensity when exercising.
sesotho_text: Ho tsoela pele ho bohlokoa ho feta bohale ha o itlama.

english_text: Make physical activity a part of your daily routine.
sesotho_text: Etsa mesebetsi ea 'mele karolo ea mekhoa ea hao ea letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: Avoid smoking as it reduces your capacity for physical activity.
sesotho_text: Hana ho tsuba hobane ho fokotsa bokgoni ba hao ba mesebetsi ea 'mele.

english_text: Alcohol reduces your motivation and ability to exercise.
sesotho_text: Joala le fokotsa khothaletso ea hao le bokgoni ba ho itlama.

english_text: A healthy lifestyle combines good nutrition, exercise, and rest.
sesotho_text: Mokhoa oa bophelo o motle o kopanya phepo e ntle, ho itlama, le ho khutsa.

english_text: Sleep is an essential part of a healthy lifestyle.
sesotho_text: Boroko ke karolo ea bohlokoa ea mokhoa oa bophelo o motle.

english_text: Adults need seven to nine hours of sleep every night.
sesotho_text: Batho ba baholo ba hloka lihora tse supileng ho isa tse robeli tsa boroko bosiu bo bong le bo bong.

english_text: Create a regular sleep routine to improve your sleep quality.
sesotho_text: Theha mekhoa ea kamehla ea boroko ho ntlafatsa boleng ba boroko ba hao.

english_text: Avoid screens and caffeine before bedtime.
sesotho_text: Hana li-screen le caffeine pele ho nako ea ho robala.

english_text: A comfortable and dark sleeping environment improves sleep.
sesotho_text: Sebaka sa ho robala se lokelang le se lefifi se ntlafatsa boroko.

english_text: Chronic sleep deprivation increases the risk of many health problems.
sesotho_text: Ho hloka boroko ho tsoelang pele ho eketsa kotsi ea mathata a mangata a bophelo.

english_text: Stress management is an important part of a healthy lifestyle.
sesotho_text: Ho laola khatello ea maikutlo ke karolo ea bohlokoa ea mokhoa oa bophelo o motle.

english_text: Deep breathing, meditation, and yoga can help reduce stress.
sesotho_text: Ho hema ka botebo, ho nahanisisa, le yoga li ka thusa ho fokotsa khatello ea maikutlo.

english_text: Talking to someone you trust can help relieve stress.
sesotho_text: Ho bua le motho eo o mo tšepang ho ka thusa ho fokotsa khatello ea maikutlo.

english_text: Seek professional help if stress is affecting your daily life.
sesotho_text: Batla thuso ea setsebi haeba khatello ea maikutlo e angoa bophelo ba hao ba letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: A positive attitude supports your health and recovery.
sesotho_text: Maikutlo a matle a tshehetsa bophelo ba hao le ho fola.

english_text: Social connections and relationships are important for your wellbeing.
sesotho_text: Likopano le likamano tsa sechaba li bohlokoa bakeng sa boiketlo ba hao.

english_text: Volunteering and helping others can improve your mental health.
sesotho_text: Ho ikela mabitleng le ho thusa ba bang ho ka ntlafatsa bophelo ba hao ba kelello.

english_text: Taking care of your health is an investment in your future.
sesotho_text: Ho hlokomela bophelo ba hao ke ho beha chelete bokamosong ba hao.

english_text: A chronic disease is a long-term condition that requires ongoing management.
sesotho_text: Bolwetse ba tsoelang pele ke boemo ba nako e telele bo hlokang taolo e tsoelang pele.

english_text: Common chronic diseases include diabetes, hypertension, and asthma.
sesotho_text: Mahlwetse a tloaelehileng a tsoelang pele a kenyelletsa tsoekere, khatello e phahameng ea mali, le asthma.

english_text: Chronic diseases can be managed effectively with the right treatment.
sesotho_text: Mahlwetse a tsoelang pele a ka laoloa ka nepo ka phekolo e nepahetseng.

english_text: Following your treatment plan helps prevent complications.
sesotho_text: Ho latela leano la phekolo ea hao ho thusa ho thibela mathata.

english_text: Regular monitoring of your condition helps detect changes early.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahloba boemo ba hao ka mehla ho thusa ho fumana liphetoho kapele.

english_text: Self-management is an important part of living with a chronic disease.
sesotho_text: Ho itaola ke karolo ea bohlokoa ea ho phela le bolwetse ba tsoelang pele.

english_text: Learning about your condition empowers you to manage it better.
sesotho_text: Ho ithuta ka boemo ba hao bo o mpha matla a ho bo laola hantle.

english_text: Diabetes is a condition where the body cannot regulate blood sugar properly.
sesotho_text: Tsoekere ke boemo moo 'mele o ke keng oa laola tsoekere ea mali ka nepo.

english_text: Type 2 diabetes can often be prevented with a healthy lifestyle.
sesotho_text: Tsoekere ea mofuta oa bobeli e ka thibeloa hangata ka mokhoa oa bophelo o motle.

english_text: Managing diabetes requires a healthy diet, exercise, and medication.
sesotho_text: Ho laola tsoekere ho hloka phepo e ntle, ho itlama, le moriana.

english_text: Monitor your blood sugar levels regularly as advised by your doctor.
sesotho_text: Hlahloba maemo a tsoekere ea mali ka mehla joalo ka ha ngaka ea hao e laela.

english_text: High blood sugar over time can damage your kidneys, eyes, and nerves.
sesotho_text: Tsoekere e phahameng ea mali nako e telele e ka senya lipitso, mahlo, le methapo ea hao.

english_text: Foot care is very important for people with diabetes.
sesotho_text: Tlhokomelo ea maoto e bohlokoa haholo bakeng sa batho ba nang le tsoekere.

english_text: Check your feet every day for cuts, sores, or changes in colour.
sesotho_text: Hlahloba maoto a hao letsatsi le leng le le leng bakeng sa likhato, maqeba, kapa liphetoho tsa mmala.

english_text: Wear comfortable shoes to protect your feet if you have diabetes.
sesotho_text: Apara lieta tse lokelang ho sireletsa maoto a hao haeba o na le tsoekere.

english_text: Hypertension is a condition where your blood pressure is too high.
sesotho_text: Khatello e phahameng ea mali ke boemo moo khatello ea mali ea hao e phahame haholo.

english_text: High blood pressure often has no symptoms and is called a silent killer.
sesotho_text: Khatello e phahameng ea mali hangata ha e na matšoao mme e bitsoa molaehi o khutsitseng.

english_text: Regular blood pressure checks are important for early detection.
sesotho_text: Ho lekola khatello ea mali ka mehla ho bohlokoa bakeng sa ho fumana kapele.

english_text: Managing hypertension requires medication, diet, and lifestyle changes.
sesotho_text: Ho laola khatello e phahameng ea mali ho hloka moriana, phepo, le liphetoho tsa mokhoa oa bophelo.

english_text: Reduce your salt intake to help lower your blood pressure.
sesotho_text: Fokotsa ho nka letsoai ho thusa ho fokotsa khatello ea mali ea hao.

english_text: Avoid stress and get regular exercise to manage hypertension.
sesotho_text: Hana khatello ea maikutlo mme u itlame ka mehla ho laola khatello e phahameng ea mali.

english_text: Uncontrolled hypertension increases the risk of heart attack and stroke.
sesotho_text: Khatello e phahameng ea mali e sa laoloang e eketsa kotsi ea tlhaselo ea pelo le stroke.

english_text: Take your blood pressure medication every day without missing doses.
sesotho_text: Nka moriana oa khatello ea mali letsatsi le leng le le leng ntle le ho lahlehela li-dose.

english_text: Asthma is a chronic lung condition that causes difficulty breathing.
sesotho_text: Asthma ke boemo ba matšoafo ba tsoelang pele bo bakang bothata ba ho hema.

english_text: Asthma can be triggered by dust, smoke, pollen, and cold air.
sesotho_text: Asthma e ka qalisoa ke lerole, mousi, pollen, le moea o batang.

english_text: Identify and avoid your asthma triggers to prevent attacks.
sesotho_text: Tseba le ho hana lintho tse qalisang asthma ea hao ho thibela litlhaselo.

english_text: Always carry your reliever inhaler with you.
sesotho_text: Nka inhaler ea hao ea ho fokotsa mahloko le uena kamehla.

english_text: Use your preventer inhaler every day as prescribed.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa inhaler ea hao ea ho thibela letsatsi le leng le le leng joalo ka ha ho laetsoe.

english_text: Seek emergency care immediately if your asthma attack is severe.
sesotho_text: Batla tlhokomelo ea tšohanyetso hang hang haeba tlhaselo ea hao ea asthma e matla.

english_text: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease is a serious lung condition.
sesotho_text: Bolwetse ba matšoafo ba thibelo ba tsoelang pele ke boemo ba matšoafo bo bobe.

english_text: Smoking is the leading cause of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
sesotho_text: Ho tsuba ke sesosa se seholo sa bolwetse ba matšoafo ba thibelo ba tsoelang pele.

english_text: Stopping smoking is the most important step in managing lung disease.
sesotho_text: Ho emisa ho tsuba ke mohato o bohlokoa ka ho fetisisa ho laoleng bolwetse ba matšoafo.

english_text: Heart disease is a leading cause of death worldwide.
sesotho_text: Bolwetse ba pelo ke sesosa se seholo sa lefu lefatšeng lohle.

english_text: A healthy diet and regular exercise reduce the risk of heart disease.
sesotho_text: Phepo e ntle le ho itlama ka mehla li fokotsa kotsi ea bolwetse ba pelo.

english_text: Chest pain, shortness of breath, and dizziness may indicate heart disease.
sesotho_text: Mahloko a sefuba, ho hloka moya, le ho potoloha li ka bontša bolwetse ba pelo.

english_text: Seek emergency care immediately if you experience chest pain.
sesotho_text: Batla tlhokomelo ea tšohanyetso hang hang haeba o ikutloa mahloko a sefuba.

english_text: Stroke occurs when blood flow to the brain is interrupted.
sesotho_text: Stroke e etsahala ha phallo ea mali ho boko e khaotsa.

english_text: The signs of stroke include sudden weakness, confusion, and difficulty speaking.
sesotho_text: Matšoao a stroke a kenyelletsa ho fokotsehela ka tšohanyetso, ho tsieleha, le bothata ba ho bua.

english_text: Call for emergency help immediately if you suspect a stroke.
sesotho_text: Letsetsa thuso ea tšohanyetso hang hang haeba o nahana hore ho na le stroke.

english_text: Epilepsy is a condition that causes recurrent seizures.
sesotho_text: Epilepsy ke boemo bo bakang ho thothomela ho phindang.

english_text: Take your epilepsy medication every day to prevent seizures.
sesotho_text: Nka moriana oa epilepsy letsatsi le leng le le leng ho thibela ho thothomela.

english_text: Inform your employer and family about your epilepsy.
sesotho_text: Tsebisa mong'a mosebetsi oa hao le lelapa la hao ka epilepsy ea hao.

english_text: Avoid activities that could be dangerous if you have a seizure.
sesotho_text: Hana mesebetsi e ka bang kotsi haeba o na le ho thothomela.

english_text: Mental health conditions such as depression are treatable.
sesotho_text: Maemo a bophelo ba kelello joalo ka khutsanyetso a ka alafoa.

english_text: Seek help early if you are experiencing symptoms of depression.
sesotho_text: Batla thuso kapele haeba o ikutloa matšoao a khutsanyetso.

english_text: Anxiety disorders are common and can be effectively treated.
sesotho_text: Maemo a ho tšoha ke a tloaelehileng mme a ka alafoa ka nepo.

english_text: Do not be ashamed to seek help for mental health problems.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa hlajoa ke maswabi ho batla thuso bakeng sa mathata a bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: Mental health treatment may include counselling and medication.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea bophelo ba kelello e ka kenyelletsa keletso le moriana.

english_text: Substance abuse is a health condition that requires treatment.
sesotho_text: Ho sebelisa litšebelisoa ka ho feteletseng ke boemo ba bophelo bo hlokang phekolo.

english_text: Seek help if you are struggling with alcohol or drug use.
sesotho_text: Batla thuso haeba o na le bothata ba ho sebelisa joala kapa lithethefatsi.

english_text: Rehabilitation programmes are available to support recovery.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a ho khutlisa bophelo a fumaneha ho tshehetsa ho fola.

english_text: Kidney disease can be prevented by managing diabetes and hypertension.
sesotho_text: Bolwetse ba lipitso bo ka thibeloa ka ho laola tsoekere le khatello e phahameng ea mali.

english_text: Drink enough water to support healthy kidney function.
sesotho_text: Noa metsi a lekaneng ho tshehetsa tšebetso e ntle ea lipitso.

english_text: Avoid taking too many painkillers as they can damage your kidneys.
sesotho_text: Hana ho nka lithethefatsi tse ngata haholo hobane li ka senya lipitso tsa hao.

english_text: Liver disease can be caused by alcohol, hepatitis, and fatty liver.
sesotho_text: Bolwetse ba sebete bo ka bakoa ke joala, hepatitis, le sebete se nang le mafura.

english_text: Avoid alcohol to protect your liver from damage.
sesotho_text: Hana joala ho sireletsa sebete sa hao ho kotsi.

english_text: Get vaccinated against hepatitis B to protect your liver.
sesotho_text: Entisoa bakeng sa hepatitis B ho sireletsa sebete sa hao.

english_text: Cancer can affect any part of the body.
sesotho_text: Kankere e ka angoa karolo efe kafe ea 'mele.

english_text: Early detection of cancer greatly improves treatment outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho fumana kankere kapele ho ntlafatsa haholo liphetho tsa phekolo.

english_text: Attend cancer screening programmes regularly.
sesotho_text: Tla mananenong a ho hlahloba kankere ka mehla.

english_text: A healthy lifestyle reduces the risk of many cancers.
sesotho_text: Mokhoa oa bophelo o motle o fokotsa kotsi ea likankere tse ngata.

english_text: Seek medical attention immediately if you notice any unusual lumps or changes.
sesotho_text: Batla tlhokomelo ea bongaka hang hang haeba o hona likhulo kapa liphetoho tse sa tloaelehang.

english_text: Osteoporosis is a condition where bones become weak and brittle.
sesotho_text: Osteoporosis ke boemo moo marapo a fokotsehela le ho qhaqhoa habonolo.

english_text: Calcium and vitamin D are important for bone health.
sesotho_text: Calcium le vitamin D li bohlokoa bakeng sa bophelo ba marapo.

english_text: Weight-bearing exercise helps maintain bone density.
sesotho_text: Ho itlama ka ho ikhela boima bo thusa ho boloka botenya ba marapo.

english_text: Arthritis causes pain and stiffness in the joints.
sesotho_text: Arthritis e baka mahloko le ho thatafala ha maqhoa.

english_text: Physiotherapy and medication can help manage arthritis.
sesotho_text: Physiotherapy le moriana li ka thusa ho laola arthritis.

english_text: Maintain a healthy weight to reduce pressure on your joints.
sesotho_text: Boloka boima bo botle ho fokotsa khatello maqhoeng a hao.

english_text: Anaemia is a condition where you do not have enough red blood cells.
sesotho_text: Anaemia ke boemo moo o se nang lisele tse khubelu tsa mali tse lekaneng.

english_text: Iron-rich foods and supplements help treat iron deficiency anaemia.
sesotho_text: Lijo tse nang le tšepe le lithupelo li thusa ho alafa anaemia ea ho hloka tšepe.

english_text: Seek medical attention if you feel persistently tired and weak.
sesotho_text: Batla tlhokomelo ea bongaka haeba o ikutloa o lapetse le ho fokotsehela ho tsoelang pele.

english_text: Thyroid disorders can affect your weight, energy, and mood.
sesotho_text: Maemo a thyroid a ka angoa boima ba hao, matla, le maikutlo.

english_text: Regular thyroid function tests help monitor your condition.
sesotho_text: Litlhahlobo tsa tšebetso ea thyroid tsa kamehla li thusa ho hlahloba boemo ba hao.

english_text: Take your thyroid medication at the same time every day.
sesotho_text: Nka moriana oa thyroid ka nako e tšoanang letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: Skin conditions such as eczema and psoriasis require ongoing management.
sesotho_text: Maemo a letlalo joalo ka eczema le psoriasis a hloka taolo e tsoelang pele.

english_text: Protect your skin from the sun to prevent skin cancer.
sesotho_text: Sireletsa letlalo la hao ho letsatsi ho thibela kankere ea letlalo.

english_text: Use moisturiser regularly to manage dry skin conditions.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa moisturiser ka mehla ho laola maemo a letlalo le omileng.

english_text: Eye conditions such as glaucoma and cataracts can cause vision loss.
sesotho_text: Maemo a mahlo joalo ka glaucoma le cataracts a ka baka ho lahleheloa ke pono.

english_text: Regular eye examinations help detect eye conditions early.
sesotho_text: Litlhahlobo tsa mahlo tsa kamehla li thusa ho fumana maemo a mahlo kapele.

english_text: Wear sunglasses to protect your eyes from UV radiation.
sesotho_text: Apara ligilase tsa letsatsi ho sireletsa mahlo a hao ho radiation ea UV.

english_text: Hearing loss can be prevented by avoiding loud noise exposure.
sesotho_text: Ho lahleheloa ke kutlo ho ka thibeloa ka ho hana ho amoa modumo o moholo.

english_text: Wear ear protection in noisy environments.
sesotho_text: Apara tšireletso ea matsebe libakeng tse nang le medumo e meholo.

english_text: Seek medical attention if you notice changes in your hearing.
sesotho_text: Batla tlhokomelo ea bongaka haeba o hona liphetoho kutlong ea hao.

english_text: Oral health affects your overall health and wellbeing.
sesotho_text: Bophelo ba molomo bo angoa bophelo ba hao ka bophara le boiketlo.

english_text: Brush and floss your teeth daily to prevent gum disease.
sesotho_text: Kolobetsa le floss meno a hao letsatsi le leng le le leng ho thibela bolwetse ba meno.

english_text: Gum disease has been linked to heart disease and diabetes.
sesotho_text: Bolwetse ba meno bo amantsoe le bolwetse ba pelo le tsoekere.

english_text: Visit the dentist regularly for check-ups and cleaning.
sesotho_text: Etela ngaka ea meno ka mehla bakeng sa litlhahlobo le ho hlotsa.

english_text: Every person has the right to access healthcare services.
sesotho_text: Motho e mong le e mong o na le tokelo ea ho fihlela litšebeletso tsa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Healthcare services in public facilities are available to everyone.
sesotho_text: Litšebeletso tsa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle litheong tsa sechaba li fumaneha ho bohle.

english_text: You have the right to be treated with dignity and respect.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho phethoa ka tlotlo le hlompho.

english_text: You have the right to receive care regardless of your background.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho amohela tlhokomelo ntle le ho sheba morao oa hao.

english_text: You have the right to receive care regardless of your HIV status.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho amohela tlhokomelo ntle le ho sheba boemo ba hao ba HIV.

english_text: You have the right to receive care regardless of your gender.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho amohela tlhokomelo ntle le ho sheba bong ba hao.

english_text: You have the right to receive care regardless of your age.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho amohela tlhokomelo ntle le ho sheba lilomo tsa hao.

english_text: You have the right to receive care regardless of your disability.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho amohela tlhokomelo ntle le ho sheba bokooa ba hao.

english_text: You have the right to an interpreter if you do not speak the local language.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea mofetoleli haeba ha o bue puo ea sebaka.

english_text: You have the right to have your cultural beliefs respected.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho hlomphuoa ha litumelo tsa hao tsa setso.

english_text: You have the right to privacy during your medical examination.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea sephiri nakong ea tlhahlobo ea hao ea bongaka.

english_text: You have the right to a clean and safe healthcare environment.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea sebaka sa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle se hloekileng le se bolokehileng.

english_text: You have the right to emergency care even if you cannot pay.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea tlhokomelo ea tšohanyetso le ha o ke ke oa lefa.

english_text: You have the right to be informed about the cost of your treatment.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho tsebisoa ka theko ea phekolo ea hao.

english_text: You have the right to complain if you are not satisfied with your care.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho ngongorehela haeba ha o khotsofale ka tlhokomelo ea hao.

english_text: You can submit a complaint to the clinic manager or health department.
sesotho_text: O ka romela ngongorehelo ho motsamaisi oa kliniki kapa lefapheng la bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Your complaint will be investigated and you will receive a response.
sesotho_text: Ngongorehelo ea hao e tla hlahlojoa mme o tla amohela karabo.

english_text: You have the right to be protected from abuse by healthcare workers.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho sireleltsoa ho tlhekefetso ke basebetsi ba tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Report any abuse or mistreatment by healthcare workers immediately.
sesotho_text: Bua ka tlhekefetso efe kafe kapa ho phethoa hampe ke basebetsi ba tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle hang hang.

english_text: You have the right to be involved in your own care plan.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho kenyeletsoa leaning la tlhokomelo ea hao.

english_text: You have the right to accept or refuse any proposed treatment.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho amohela kapa ho hana phekolo efe kafe e khothaletsitsoeng.

english_text: Informed consent must be obtained before any procedure.
sesotho_text: Tumelo e tsebisitsoeng e tlameha ho fumanoa pele ho ts'ebetso efe kafe.

english_text: You must be given enough information to make an informed decision.
sesotho_text: O tlameha ho fumanoa tlhahisoleseling e lekaneng ho etsa qeto e tsebisitsoeng.

english_text: You have the right to withdraw your consent at any time.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho khutlisa tumelo ea hao nako efe kafe.

english_text: Children and adolescents also have rights in healthcare settings.
sesotho_text: Bana le bacha le bona ba na le litokelo libakeng tsa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Adolescents have the right to access sexual and reproductive health services.
sesotho_text: Bacha ba na le tokelo ea ho fihlela litšebeletso tsa bophelo ba thobalano le ba ho ba le bana.

english_text: Confidentiality is maintained for adolescents seeking healthcare.
sesotho_text: Sephiri se bolokoa bakeng sa bacha ba batlang tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Older adults have the right to dignified and respectful care.
sesotho_text: Batho ba baholo ba na le tokelo ea tlhokomelo e nang le tlotlo le hlompho.

english_text: People with disabilities have the right to accessible healthcare.
sesotho_text: Batho ba nang le bokooa ba na le tokelo ea tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle e fihlehang.

english_text: Healthcare facilities should be accessible to people with disabilities.
sesotho_text: Litheong tsa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle li lokela ho fihlehela batho ba nang le bokooa.

english_text: Sign language interpreters should be available for deaf patients.
sesotho_text: Bafetoleli ba puo ea matsoho ba lokela ho fumaneha bakeng sa bakuloi ba sa utloeng.

english_text: Braille materials should be available for visually impaired patients.
sesotho_text: Lisebelisoa tsa Braille li lokela ho fumaneha bakeng sa bakuloi ba sa boneng hantle.

english_text: Mental health patients have the same rights as all other patients.
sesotho_text: Bakuloi ba bophelo ba kelello ba na le litokelo tse tšoanang le bakuloi bohle ba bang.

english_text: Involuntary treatment can only be applied under specific legal conditions.
sesotho_text: Phekolo e sa rateheng e ka sebelisoa feela maemong a khethehileng a molao.

english_text: Community health workers provide health services at the community level.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba bophelo ba sechaba ba fana ka litšebeletso tsa bophelo bo botle maemong a sechaba.

english_text: Community health workers can help you navigate the health system.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba bophelo ba sechaba ba ka thusa ho tsamaea sisteme ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Mobile clinics bring healthcare services to remote communities.
sesotho_text: Likliniki tsa ho tsamaea li tlisa litšebeletso tsa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle sechababeng tse hole.

english_text: Outreach programmes provide services to people who cannot access facilities.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a ho fihla batho a fana ka litšebeletso ho batho ba ke keng ba fihlela litheong.

english_text: Telemedicine allows you to consult a doctor remotely.
sesotho_text: Telemedicine e lumela ho buisana le ngaka hole.

english_text: Emergency medical services are available for life-threatening conditions.
sesotho_text: Litšebeletso tsa bongaka tsa tšohanyetso li fumaneha bakeng sa maemo a tšohanyetso a kotsi ea bophelo.

english_text: Know the location of your nearest emergency room.
sesotho_text: Tseba sebaka sa kamore ea tšohanyetso e haufi le hao ka ho fetisisa.

english_text: Keep the emergency services number saved on your phone.
sesotho_text: Boloka nomoro ea litšebeletso tsa tšohanyetso mohaling oa hao.

english_text: Ambulance services are available for medical emergencies.
sesotho_text: Litšebeletso tsa ambulance li fumaneha bakeng sa litšohanyetso tsa bongaka.

english_text: Do not use emergency services for non-emergency conditions.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa sebelisa litšebeletso tsa tšohanyetso bakeng sa maemo a sa leng a tšohanyetso.

english_text: Primary healthcare clinics handle most common health conditions.
sesotho_text: Likliniki tsa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle ea motheo li sebetsa le maemo a tloaelehileng a bophelo.

english_text: Referral hospitals provide specialised care for complex conditions.
sesotho_text: Lisepetlele tsa referral li fana ka tlhokomelo e khethehileng bakeng sa maemo a raraaneng.

english_text: Follow the referral process to access specialist care.
sesotho_text: Latela ts'ebetso ea referral ho fihlela tlhokomelo ea setsebi.

english_text: Bring your referral letter to all specialist appointments.
sesotho_text: Tlisa lengolo la hao la referral li-appointment tsohle tsa setsebi.

english_text: The national health insurance aims to provide universal health coverage.
sesotho_text: Inshorense ea bophelo bo botle ea naha e ikemiseditse ho fana ka koahelo ea bophelo bo botle ho bohle.

english_text: Health insurance helps cover the cost of medical care.
sesotho_text: Inshorense ea bophelo bo botle e thusa ho koahela theko ea tlhokomelo ea bongaka.

english_text: Apply for a medical aid or health insurance if you can afford it.
sesotho_text: Etsa kopo ea thuso ea bongaka kapa inshorense ea bophelo bo botle haeba o khona ho e lefella.

english_text: Social grants are available to support people with disabilities.
sesotho_text: Liphallelo tsa sechaba li fumaneha ho tshehetsa batho ba nang le bokooa.

english_text: Apply for a disability grant if your condition prevents you from working.
sesotho_text: Etsa kopo ea phallelo ea bokooa haeba boemo ba hao bo o thibela ho sebetsa.

english_text: The clinic social worker can help you access social support services.
sesotho_text: Mosebetsi oa sechaba oa kliniki o ka thusa ho fihlela litšebeletso tsa tshehetso ea sechaba.

english_text: Non-governmental organisations provide additional health and social support.
sesotho_text: Mekhatlo e sa laoloeng ke mmuso e fana ka tshehetso e eketsehileng ea bophelo le ea sechaba.

english_text: Faith-based organisations also provide health and social services.
sesotho_text: Mekhatlo e thehiloeng ho tumelo le yona e fana ka litšebeletso tsa bophelo le tsa sechaba.

english_text: Know your rights and use the health services available to you.
sesotho_text: Tseba litokelo tsa hao mme u sebelise litšebeletso tsa bophelo bo botle tse fumanehang ho uena.

english_text: Advocate for better health services in your community.
sesotho_text: Lwela litšebeletso tse ntle tsa bophelo bo botle sechababeng sa hao.

english_text: Health is a human right and everyone deserves quality care.
sesotho_text: Bophelo bo botle ke tokelo ea botho mme bohle ba lokeloa ke tlhokomelo ea boleng.

english_text: Taking care of your health is your responsibility and your right.
sesotho_text: Ho hlokomela bophelo ba hao ke boikarabello ba hao le tokelo ea hao.

english_text: Empower yourself with health knowledge and share it with others.
sesotho_text: Ikematlafatsa ka tsebo ea bophelo bo botle mme u e arolelane le ba bang.

english_text: A healthy community starts with informed and empowered individuals.
sesotho_text: Sechaba se phela hantle se qala ka batho ba tsebisitsoeng le ba nang le matla.

english_text: Work together with your healthcare team to achieve the best outcomes.
sesotho_text: Sebetsa hammoho le sehlopha sa hao sa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle ho fihlela liphetho tse ntle ka ho fetisisa.

english_text: Your health journey is a partnership between you and your healthcare provider.
sesotho_text: Leeto la bophelo ba hao ke kopano lipakeng tsa uena le mofani oa hao oa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Trust your healthcare team and communicate openly with them.
sesotho_text: Tšepa sehlopha sa hao sa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle mme u buisane le sona ka bolokolohi.

english_text: Ask questions until you fully understand your condition and treatment.
sesotho_text: Botsa lipotso ho fihlela o utloisisa ka botlalo boemo ba hao le phekolo.

english_text: Never leave a consultation without understanding your next steps.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa tloha keletso ntle le ho utloisisa mehato ea hao e latelang.

english_text: Your health is your most valuable asset — protect and invest in it.
sesotho_text: Bophelo ba hao ke thepa ea hao e bohlokoa ka ho fetisisa — sireletsa le ho beha chelete ho yona.

english_text: Small daily health habits lead to long-term wellbeing.
sesotho_text: Mekhoa e menyenyane ea bophelo bo botle ea letsatsi le leng le le leng e lebisa boiketlo ba nako e telele.

english_text: Every positive health choice you make today benefits your future.
sesotho_text: Khetho le leng le le leng le letle la bophelo bo botle eo o le etsang kajeno le nts'etsa bokamoso ba hao pele.

english_text: You are capable of managing your health with the right support.
sesotho_text: O khona ho laola bophelo ba hao ka tshehetso e nepahetseng.

english_text: Believe in your ability to improve and maintain your health.
sesotho_text: Lumela bokgoneng ba hao ba ho ntlafatsa le ho boloka bophelo ba hao.

english_text: Health education is a lifelong journey of learning and growth.
sesotho_text: Thuto ea bophelo bo botle ke leeto la bophelo bohle la ho ithuta le ho hola.

english_text: Using a condom correctly every time you have sex prevents HIV and STIs.
sesotho_text: Ho sebelisa condom ka nepo nako le nako ha o kopana ka thobalano ho thibela HIV le li-STI.

english_text: Condoms are available free of charge at all public health clinics.
sesotho_text: Li-condom li fumaneha mahala likiliniking tsohle tsa bophelo bo botle tsa sechaba.

english_text: Both male and female condoms are available at the clinic.
sesotho_text: Li-condom tsa banna le tsa basali li fumaneha klinikeng.

english_text: Use a new condom every time you have sexual intercourse.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa condom e ncha nako le nako ha o kopana ka thobalano.

english_text: Check the expiry date on the condom before using it.
sesotho_text: Hlahloba letsatsi la ho fela la condom pele ho e sebelisa.

english_text: Do not use oil-based lubricants with latex condoms.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa sebelisa li-lubricant tse thehiloeng ho oli le li-condom tsa latex.

english_text: Water-based lubricants are safe to use with condoms.
sesotho_text: Li-lubricant tse thehiloeng ho metsi li bolokehile ho sebelisa le li-condom.

english_text: PrEP is a medication that prevents HIV in HIV-negative people.
sesotho_text: PrEP ke moriana o thibelang HIV ho batho ba sa nang HIV.

english_text: Ask your clinic about PrEP if you are at high risk of HIV.
sesotho_text: Botsa kliniki ea hao ka PrEP haeba o le kotsing e phahameng ea HIV.

english_text: PEP is an emergency medication taken after possible HIV exposure.
sesotho_text: PEP ke moriana oa tšohanyetso o nkoang ka mor'a ho ka amoa HIV.

english_text: PEP must be started within seventy-two hours of exposure.
sesotho_text: PEP e tlameha ho qalisoa ka hare ho lihora tse mashome a supileng le metso e mebeli ea ho amoa.

english_text: PEP must be taken for twenty-eight days without missing doses.
sesotho_text: PEP e tlameha ho nkoa matsatsi a mashome a mabeli le metso e robeli ntle le ho lahlehela li-dose.

english_text: Seek medical attention immediately after a possible HIV exposure.
sesotho_text: Batla tlhokomelo ea bongaka hang hang ka mor'a ho ka amoa HIV.

english_text: Get tested for HIV and STIs regularly if you are sexually active.
sesotho_text: Hlahlojoa bakeng sa HIV le li-STI ka mehla haeba o kopana ka thobalano.

english_text: Knowing your HIV status protects you and your partner.
sesotho_text: Ho tseba boemo ba hao ba HIV bo sireletsa uena le molekane oa hao.

english_text: Encourage your partner to get tested for HIV together.
sesotho_text: Khothaletsa molekane oa hao ho hlahlojoa bakeng sa HIV hammoho.

english_text: Disclosure of your HIV status to your partner is important.
sesotho_text: Ho tsebisa molekane oa hao boemo ba hao ba HIV ho bohlokoa.

english_text: Support is available for people who need help with disclosure.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso e fumaneha ho batho ba hlokang thuso ka ho tsebisa.

english_text: Sexually transmitted infections increase the risk of HIV transmission.
sesotho_text: Tšoaetso tse fetisanang ka thobalano li eketsa kotsi ea ho fetisela HIV.

english_text: Treat all sexually transmitted infections promptly and completely.
sesotho_text: Alafa tšoaetso tsohle tse fetisanang ka thobalano kapele le ka botlalo.

english_text: Symptoms of STIs include discharge, sores, burning, and pain.
sesotho_text: Matšoao a li-STI a kenyelletsa seretse, maqeba, ho chesa, le mahloko.

english_text: Some STIs have no symptoms and can only be detected by testing.
sesotho_text: Li-STI tse ling ha li na matšoao mme li ka fumanoa feela ka tlhahlobo.

english_text: Regular STI testing is recommended for sexually active people.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlojoa bakeng sa li-STI ka mehla ho khothaletsoa bakeng sa batho ba kopanang ka thobalano.

english_text: Inform your sexual partner if you are diagnosed with an STI.
sesotho_text: Tsebisa molekane oa hao oa thobalano haeba o hlahlojoe ka STI.

english_text: Both partners must be treated for an STI at the same time.
sesotho_text: Baratwi ba babeli ba tlameha ho alafioa bakeng sa STI ka nako e tšoanang.

english_text: Avoid sexual contact until both partners have completed STI treatment.
sesotho_text: Hana ho kopana ka thobalano ho fihlela baratwi ba babeli ba phetela phekolo ea STI.

english_text: Reducing the number of sexual partners reduces the risk of STIs.
sesotho_text: Ho fokotsa palo ea baratwi ba thobalano ho fokotsa kotsi ea li-STI.

english_text: Mutual faithfulness between tested partners reduces HIV risk.
sesotho_text: Botsepeli bo tšoanang lipakeng tsa baratwi ba hlahlojotsoeng bo fokotsa kotsi ea HIV.

english_text: Alcohol and drug use increase the risk of unsafe sexual behaviour.
sesotho_text: Ho sebelisa joala le lithethefatsi ho eketsa kotsi ea boitšoaro ba thobalano bo sa bolokehang.

english_text: Avoid making sexual decisions when under the influence of alcohol.
sesotho_text: Hana ho etsa liqeto tsa thobalano ha o tlasa tšusumetso ea joala.

english_text: Sexual violence increases the risk of HIV and STI transmission.
sesotho_text: Tlhekefetso ea thobalano e eketsa kotsi ea ho fetisela HIV le li-STI.

english_text: Seek medical care immediately after sexual violence.
sesotho_text: Batla tlhokomelo ea bongaka hang hang ka mor'a tlhekefetso ea thobalano.

english_text: Post-exposure prophylaxis is available after sexual violence.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea thibelo ka mor'a ho amoa e fumaneha ka mor'a tlhekefetso ea thobalano.

english_text: Report sexual violence to the police and seek legal support.
sesotho_text: Bua ka tlhekefetso ea thobalano mapoliseng mme u batle tshehetso ea molao.

english_text: Support is available for survivors of sexual violence.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso e fumaneha bakeng sa ba pholositsoeng ho tlhekefetso ea thobalano.

english_text: Cervical cancer is caused by the human papillomavirus.
sesotho_text: Kankere ea molala oa mphe e bakoa ke human papillomavirus.

english_text: The HPV vaccine protects against cervical cancer.
sesotho_text: Ente ea HPV e sireletsa ho kankere ea molala oa mphe.

english_text: Girls should receive the HPV vaccine before becoming sexually active.
sesotho_text: Banana ba lokela ho amohela ente ea HPV pele ba qala ho kopana ka thobalano.

english_text: Regular cervical screening detects abnormal cells before they become cancer.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahloba molala oa mphe ka mehla ho fumana lisele tse sa tloaelehang pele li fetoha kankere.

english_text: Women should have a cervical smear test every three years.
sesotho_text: Basali ba lokela ho ba le tlhahlobo ea molala oa mphe lilomong tse tharo le 'ngoe le e 'ngoe.

english_text: Hepatitis B is transmitted through sexual contact and blood.
sesotho_text: Hepatitis B e fetisoa ka ho kopana ka thobalano le mali.

english_text: Vaccination against hepatitis B protects your liver.
sesotho_text: Ho entisoa bakeng sa hepatitis B ho sireletsa sebete sa hao.

english_text: Herpes is a lifelong viral infection that can be managed with medication.
sesotho_text: Herpes ke tšoaetso ea vaerase ea bophelo bohle e ka laoloang ka moriana.

english_text: Gonorrhoea and chlamydia are bacterial infections that are treatable.
sesotho_text: Gonorrhoea le chlamydia ke tšoaetso tsa baekteria tse ka alafoang.

english_text: Syphilis is a serious STI that can be cured with antibiotics.
sesotho_text: Syphilis ke STI e matla e ka folisioang ka li-antibiotic.

english_text: Untreated syphilis can cause serious damage to the heart and brain.
sesotho_text: Syphilis e sa alafoang e ka baka kotsi e matla ho pelo le boko.

english_text: Trichomoniasis is a common STI that is easily treated.
sesotho_text: Trichomoniasis ke STI e tloaelehileng e alafoang habonolo.

english_text: All STIs are treatable and most are curable with the right medication.
sesotho_text: Li-STI tsohle li ka alafioa mme tse ngata li ka folisoa ka moriana o nepahetseng.

english_text: Do not be ashamed to seek treatment for a sexually transmitted infection.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa hlajoa ke maswabi ho batla phekolo bakeng sa tšoaetso e fetisanang ka thobalano.

english_text: Healthcare workers treat all STI patients with confidentiality and respect.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle ba phethela bakuloi bohle ba li-STI ka sephiri le hlompho.

english_text: Sexual health is an important part of your overall health and wellbeing.
sesotho_text: Bophelo ba thobalano ke karolo ea bohlokoa ea bophelo ba hao ka bophara le boiketlo.

english_text: Open communication with your partner about sexual health is important.
sesotho_text: Ho buisana ka bolokolohi le molekane oa hao ka bophelo ba thobalano ho bohlokoa.

english_text: Healthy relationships are built on trust, respect, and communication.
sesotho_text: Likamano tse ntle li thehiloe ho tšepo, hlompho, le puisano.

english_text: Gender-based violence is a public health issue that requires urgent action.
sesotho_text: Tlhekefetso e thehiloeng ho bong ke bothata ba bophelo ba sechaba bo hlokang ketso ea potlako.

english_text: Seek help if you are experiencing violence in your relationship.
sesotho_text: Batla thuso haeba o ikutloa tlhekefetso kamanong ea hao.

english_text: Support services for gender-based violence are available at the clinic.
sesotho_text: Litšebeletso tsa tshehetso bakeng sa tlhekefetso e thehiloeng ho bong li fumaneha klinikeng.

english_text: Every person deserves to be in a safe and healthy relationship.
sesotho_text: Motho e mong le e mong o lokeloa ke ho ba kamanong e bolokehileng le e phela hantle.

english_text: Your sexual health decisions affect your long-term health and wellbeing.
sesotho_text: Liqeto tsa hao tsa bophelo ba thobalano li angoa bophelo ba hao ba nako e telele le boiketlo.

english_text: Mental health is a state of wellbeing in which you can cope with daily life.
sesotho_text: Bophelo ba kelello ke boemo ba boiketlo moo o khonang ho sebetsana le bophelo ba letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: One in four people will experience a mental health problem in their lifetime.
sesotho_text: Motho e mong ho batho ba bane o tla ikutloa bothata ba bophelo ba kelello bophelong ba hae.

english_text: Mental health problems are common and nothing to be ashamed of.
sesotho_text: Mathata a bophelo ba kelello a tloaelehile mme ha ho letho la ho hlajoa ke maswabi.

english_text: Depression is more than just feeling sad — it is a medical condition.
sesotho_text: Khutsanyetso e feta ho ikutloa o masoabi feela — ke boemo ba bongaka.

english_text: Symptoms of depression include persistent sadness, loss of interest, and fatigue.
sesotho_text: Matšoao a khutsanyetso a kenyelletsa masoabi a tsoelang pele, ho lahleheloa ke khahliso, le ho lapala.

english_text: Anxiety is a feeling of excessive worry and fear that affects daily life.
sesotho_text: Ho tšoha ke maikutlo a ho khathallela le ho tšaba ho feteletseng a angoa bophelo ba letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: Symptoms of anxiety include restlessness, racing heart, and difficulty sleeping.
sesotho_text: Matšoao a ho tšoha a kenyelletsa ho se khutse, pelo e otlang ka potlako, le bothata ba ho robala.

english_text: Post-traumatic stress disorder can develop after a traumatic event.
sesotho_text: Maemo a khatello ea maikutlo ka mor'a kotsi a ka hlaha ka mor'a tikoloho e bohloko.

english_text: Schizophrenia is a serious mental illness that affects thinking and behaviour.
sesotho_text: Schizophrenia ke bolwetse ba kelello bo bobe bo angoa ho nahana le boitšoaro.

english_text: Bipolar disorder causes extreme mood swings between highs and lows.
sesotho_text: Bipolar disorder e baka ho fetohafetohoa ha maikutlo ho tloha ho phahama ho ea tlase.

english_text: Mental health conditions are caused by a combination of factors.
sesotho_text: Maemo a bophelo ba kelello a bakoa ke kopano ea lintlha tse fapaneng.

english_text: Stress, trauma, genetics, and substance abuse can affect mental health.
sesotho_text: Khatello ea maikutlo, kotsi, bo-ralikhele, le ho sebelisa litšebelisoa ka ho feteletseng li ka angoa bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: Mental health problems can affect anyone regardless of age or background.
sesotho_text: Mathata a bophelo ba kelello a ka angoa motho e mong le e mong ntle le ho sheba lilomo kapa morao.

english_text: Children and adolescents can also experience mental health problems.
sesotho_text: Bana le bacha le bona ba ka ikutloa mathata a bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: Older adults are at increased risk of depression and cognitive decline.
sesotho_text: Batho ba baholo ba le kotsing e eketsehileng ea khutsanyetso le ho fokotsehela ha kelello.

english_text: People living with chronic illness are at higher risk of depression.
sesotho_text: Batho ba phelang le mahlwetse a tsoelang pele ba le kotsing e phahameng ea khutsanyetso.

english_text: Substance abuse and mental health problems often occur together.
sesotho_text: Ho sebelisa litšebelisoa ka ho feteletseng le mathata a bophelo ba kelello hangata a etsahala hammoho.

english_text: Seek help early if you notice changes in your mood or behaviour.
sesotho_text: Batla thuso kapele haeba o hona liphetoho maikutlong kapa boitšoarong ba hao.

english_text: Talk to your doctor or nurse if you are struggling with your mental health.
sesotho_text: Bua le ngaka ea hao kapa mooki haeba o na le bothata ba bophelo ba hao ba kelello.

english_text: Mental health treatment includes counselling, medication, and support groups.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea bophelo ba kelello e kenyelletsa keletso, moriana, le lisehlopha tsa tshehetso.

english_text: Counselling helps you understand and manage your thoughts and feelings.
sesotho_text: Keletso e thusa ho utloisisa le ho laola menahano le maikutlo a hao.

english_text: Cognitive behavioural therapy is an effective treatment for depression and anxiety.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea boitšoaro ba kelello ke phekolo e sebetsang bakeng sa khutsanyetso le ho tšoha.

english_text: Medication can help correct chemical imbalances in the brain.
sesotho_text: Moriana o ka thusa ho balelisa ho se lekalekane ha likhemikale bokong.

english_text: Take your mental health medication every day as prescribed.
sesotho_text: Nka moriana oa bophelo ba kelello letsatsi le leng le le leng joalo ka ha ho laetsoe.

english_text: Do not stop your mental health medication without consulting your doctor.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa emisa moriana oa bophelo ba kelello ntle le ho buisana le ngaka ea hao.

english_text: Recovery from mental illness is possible with the right treatment and support.
sesotho_text: Ho fola ho tsoa bolwetseng ba kelello ho khonehile ka phekolo e nepahetseng le tshehetso.

english_text: Support from family and friends is vital for mental health recovery.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso ho tsoa lelapeng le metsoalleng e bohlokoa haholo bakeng sa ho fola ha bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: Reduce stigma by treating people with mental illness with respect.
sesotho_text: Fokotsa koluoa ka ho phethela batho ba nang le bolwetse ba kelello ka hlompho.

english_text: Do not use hurtful language when talking about mental health.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa sebelisa puo e bohloko ha o bua ka bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: Educate yourself and others about mental health conditions.
sesotho_text: Ithuta le ho ruta ba bang ka maemo a bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: Self-care is an important part of maintaining good mental health.
sesotho_text: Ho itlhokomela ke karolo ea bohlokoa ea ho boloka bophelo bo botle ba kelello.

english_text: Practice relaxation techniques such as deep breathing and meditation.
sesotho_text: Itlwaetse mekhoa ea ho khutsa joalo ka ho hema ka botebo le ho nahanisisa.

english_text: Spend time in nature to improve your mood and reduce stress.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa nako tlholehing ho ntlafatsa maikutlo a hao le ho fokotsa khatello ea maikutlo.

english_text: Physical activity is one of the most effective ways to improve mental health.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele ke e le ngoe ea mekhoa e sebetsang ka ho fetisisa ea ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: Maintain social connections to protect your mental health.
sesotho_text: Boloka likopano tsa sechaba ho sireletsa bophelo ba hao ba kelello.

english_text: Limit alcohol and drug use to protect your mental health.
sesotho_text: Fokotsa ho sebelisa joala le lithethefatsi ho sireletsa bophelo ba hao ba kelello.

english_text: Set realistic goals and celebrate small achievements.
sesotho_text: Beha maano a khonehang mme u keteke liphetho tse nyenyane.

english_text: Be kind to yourself and avoid negative self-talk.
sesotho_text: Ba molemo ho uena mme u hane ho itšohla.

english_text: Seek help if you are having thoughts of harming yourself.
sesotho_text: Batla thuso haeba o na le menahano ea ho itšenya.

english_text: Suicide is preventable with the right support and intervention.
sesotho_text: Ho itsebetsa ho ka thibeloa ka tshehetso e nepahetseng le ho kenella.

english_text: Crisis support lines are available if you need immediate help.
sesotho_text: Mehala ea tshehetso ea crisis e fumaneha haeba o hloka thuso ea potlako.

english_text: You are not alone — help is available and recovery is possible.
sesotho_text: Ha o le mong — thuso e fumaneha mme ho fola ho khonehile.

english_text: Mental health awareness reduces stigma and encourages help-seeking.
sesotho_text: Temoso ea bophelo ba kelello e fokotsa koluoa le ho khothaletsa ho batla thuso.

english_text: Workplaces should support employees with mental health problems.
sesotho_text: Libaka tsa mosebetsi li lokela ho tshehetsa basebetsi ba nang le mathata a bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: Schools should provide mental health support for learners.
sesotho_text: Likolo li lokela ho fana ka tshehetso ea bophelo ba kelello bakeng sa baithuti.

english_text: Communities play an important role in supporting mental health.
sesotho_text: Sechaba se bapala karolo ea bohlokoa ho tshehetsa bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: Traditional healers and faith leaders can complement mental health care.
sesotho_text: Lingaka tsa setso le baetapele ba tumelo ba ka tlatsa tlhokomelo ea bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: Integrate mental health care into your overall healthcare routine.
sesotho_text: Kenyelletsa tlhokomelo ea bophelo ba kelello mekhoaneng ea hao yohle ea tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Mental health and physical health are closely connected.
sesotho_text: Bophelo ba kelello le bophelo ba 'mele li amanane haufi.

english_text: Addressing mental health improves outcomes for all chronic conditions.
sesotho_text: Ho sebetsana le bophelo ba kelello ho ntlafatsa liphetho bakeng sa maemo ohle a tsoelang pele.

english_text: Invest in your mental health as you would invest in your physical health.
sesotho_text: Beha chelete bophelong ba hao ba kelello joalo ka ha o beha chelete bophelong ba hao ba 'mele.

english_text: A mentally healthy community is a productive and thriving community.
sesotho_text: Sechaba se phela hantle ka kelello ke sechaba se sebetsang le se holang.

english_text: Speak up about mental health and help break the silence.
sesotho_text: Bua ka bophelo ba kelello mme u thuse ho qoba khutsiso.

english_text: Your mental health matters and you deserve support and care.
sesotho_text: Bophelo ba hao ba kelello bo bohlokoa mme o lokeloa ke tshehetso le tlhokomelo.

english_text: Reaching out for help is a sign of strength not weakness.
sesotho_text: Ho batla thuso ke sesupo sa matla e seng ho fokotsehela.

english_text: Every step towards better mental health is worth celebrating.
sesotho_text: Mohato o mong le o mong o eang ho bophelo bo botle ba kelello o lokeloa ke ho ketekoa.

english_text: You have the power to improve your mental health one day at a time.
sesotho_text: O na le matla a ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba hao ba kelello letsatsi le le leng ka nako.

english_text: Mental health is a journey and every journey begins with a single step.
sesotho_text: Bophelo ba kelello ke leeto mme leeto le leng le le leng le qala ka mohato o le mong.

english_text: Together we can build a world where mental health is valued and protected.
sesotho_text: Hammoho re ka haha lefatše moo bophelo ba kelello bo hlomphuoa le ho sireleltsoa.

english_text: Community health workers are trained to provide basic health services.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba bophelo ba sechaba ba rutiloe ho fana ka litšebeletso tsa motheo tsa bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Community health workers can visit you at home for health support.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba bophelo ba sechaba ba ka etela lapeng bakeng sa tshehetso ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Ask your community health worker about health services in your area.
sesotho_text: Botsa mosebetsi oa hao oa bophelo ba sechaba ka litšebeletso tsa bophelo bo botle sebakeng sa hao.

english_text: Community health campaigns provide free testing and treatment.
sesotho_text: Likhampheini tsa bophelo ba sechaba li fana ka tlhahlobo le phekolo mahala.

english_text: Attend community health days to access free health services.
sesotho_text: Tla matsatsing a bophelo ba sechaba ho fihlela litšebeletso tsa bophelo bo botle mahala.

english_text: Health promotion activities educate communities about disease prevention.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea ho khothaletsa bophelo bo botle e ruta sechaba ka ho thibela mahlwetse.

english_text: School health programmes provide health education and services to learners.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a bophelo bo botle a likolo a fana ka thuto ea bophelo le litšebeletso ho baithuti.

english_text: Workplace wellness programmes support the health of employees.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a boiketlo ba sebaka sa mosebetsi a tshehetsa bophelo ba basebetsi.

english_text: Faith communities play an important role in health promotion.
sesotho_text: Sechaba sa tumelo se bapala karolo ea bohlokoa ho khothaletseng bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Traditional leaders can support health campaigns in their communities.
sesotho_text: Baetapele ba setso ba ka tshehetsa likhampheini tsa bophelo bo botle sechababeng sa bona.

english_text: Community gardens improve food security and nutrition.
sesotho_text: Lipolase tsa sechaba li ntlafatsa ts'ireletso ea lijo le phepo.

english_text: Clean water and sanitation are essential for community health.
sesotho_text: Metsi a hloekileng le bohloekileng ke tsa bohlokoa bakeng sa bophelo ba sechaba.

english_text: Advocate for clean water and proper sanitation in your community.
sesotho_text: Lwela metsi a hloekileng le bohloekileng bo nepahetseng sechababeng sa hao.

english_text: Environmental health affects the health of the entire community.
sesotho_text: Bophelo ba tikoloho bo angoa bophelo ba sechaba ka bophara.

english_text: Report environmental health hazards to the local authorities.
sesotho_text: Bua ka likotsi tsa bophelo ba tikoloho ho ba ba nang le matla ba sebaka.

english_text: Air pollution increases the risk of respiratory diseases.
sesotho_text: Tšilafalo ea moea e eketsa kotsi ea mahlwetse a ho hema.

english_text: Reduce indoor air pollution by improving ventilation in your home.
sesotho_text: Fokotsa tšilafalo ea moea ka hare ho ntlo ka ho ntlafatsa phallo ea moea ntlong ea hao.

english_text: Avoid burning waste near homes and communities.
sesotho_text: Hana ho chesa molapo haufi le matlo le sechaba.

english_text: Safe roads and public spaces reduce the risk of injuries.
sesotho_text: Litsela tse bolokehileng le libaka tsa sechaba li fokotsa kotsi ea likotsi.

english_text: Road traffic accidents are a major cause of death and disability.
sesotho_text: Likotsi tsa sephethephethe tsa tsela ke sesosa se seholo sa lefu le bokooa.

english_text: Wear a seatbelt every time you travel in a vehicle.
sesotho_text: Apara seatbelt nako le nako ha o tsamaea koloing.

english_text: Do not use your phone while driving.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa sebelisa mohala oa hao ha o khanna.

english_text: Never drink and drive.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa noa mme u khanne.

english_text: Pedestrians should use designated crossings and walkways.
sesotho_text: Baeti ba maoto ba lokela ho sebelisa libaka tse khethiloeng tsa ho tšela le ho tsamaea.

english_text: Cyclists should wear helmets and use designated lanes.
sesotho_text: Bapalami ba baesekele ba lokela ho apara lihelmet le ho sebelisa litsela tse khethiloeng.

english_text: Drowning prevention requires supervision near water at all times.
sesotho_text: Ho thibela ho fifela ho hloka ho lebelloa haufi le metsi nako tsohle.

english_text: Teach children to swim to reduce the risk of drowning.
sesotho_text: Ruta bana ho nea ho fokotsa kotsi ea ho fifela.

english_text: Fire safety education prevents burns and fire-related deaths.
sesotho_text: Thuto ea polokeho ea mollo e thibela ho chesa le lifu tse amanang le mollo.

english_text: Install smoke detectors in your home.
sesotho_text: Kenya li-smoke detector ntlong ea hao.

english_text: Keep a first aid kit at home and know how to use it.
sesotho_text: Boloka sete ea thuso ea pele lapeng mme u tsebe ho e sebelisa.

english_text: Learn basic first aid skills to help in an emergency.
sesotho_text: Ithuta bokgoni ba motheo ba thuso ea pele ho thusa nakong ea tšohanyetso.
